  installed_capacity_mw_dc decimal(10,3) [note: 'For solar PV resources, the total DC capacity of the solar panels before inversion. Null for non-solar resources. Used to calculate DC-to-AC ratio for solar performance analysis.']
  interconnection_date date [note: 'Date when the renewable resource was first interconnected to the grid and authorized to deliver energy. Used for depreciation schedules, regulatory reporting, and capacity factor analysis.']
  inverter_manufacturer varchar [note: 'Manufacturer of the inverter equipment for solar PV resources (e.g., \'SMA\', \'Fronius\', \'SolarEdge\'). Applicable to solar PV only. Null for wind and hydro.']
  inverter_model varchar [note: 'Model designation of the inverter equipment for solar PV resources. Applicable to solar PV only. Null for wind and hydro.']
  latitude decimal(10,7) [note: 'Geographic latitude coordinate of the renewable resource location in decimal degrees. Used for GIS mapping, solar irradiance modeling, wind resource assessment, and transmission planning.']
  longitude decimal(10,7) [note: 'Geographic longitude coordinate of the renewable resource location in decimal degrees. Used for GIS mapping, solar irradiance modeling, wind resource assessment, and transmission planning.']
  modified_by_user varchar [note: 'User ID or system account that last modified this renewable resource record. Used for audit trail and data stewardship accountability.']
  modified_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this renewable resource record was last modified. Used for data lineage, change tracking, and audit trail.']
  nem_eligible_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the renewable resource is eligible for Net Energy Metering programs, allowing bidirectional energy flow and credit for excess generation. True if eligible, False otherwise. Primarily applicable to distributed solar resources.']
  operational_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the renewable resource. In-service indicates active generation capability, standby indicates ready but not generating, out-of-service indicates temporary unavailability, under construction for assets not yet commissioned, retired for permanently decommissioned, mothballed for long-term suspension.']
  owner_operator_type varchar [note: 'Classification of ownership and operational responsibility. Utility-owned indicates direct ownership and operation, third-party PPA indicates independent power producer with power purchase agreement, customer-owned NEM indicates behind-the-meter distributed generation, joint venture indicates shared ownership.']
  panel_model varchar [note: 'Manufacturer and model designation of solar panels installed (e.g., \'SunPower Maxeon 3-400W\'). Applicable to solar PV resources only. Null for wind and hydro.']
  pi_historian_tag_prefix varchar [note: 'Tag prefix used in OSIsoft PI Historian for real-time telemetry data streams from this renewable resource. Enables linkage between master data and operational time-series data for performance monitoring and analytics.']
  ppa_contract_number varchar [note: 'Unique identifier for the Power Purchase Agreement governing the sale of energy and/or capacity from this renewable resource. References the contractual terms, pricing structure, and delivery obligations. Confidential business information.']
  rec_tracking_system_code varchar [note: 'Unique identifier assigned by the regional REC tracking system (e.g., PJM-GATS, WREGIS, M-RETS) for tracking and trading renewable energy certificates generated by this resource. Used for renewable portfolio standard (RPS) compliance and REC monetization.']
  record_active_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this renewable resource record is currently active in the system. True for active records, False for logically deleted or archived records. Used for soft-delete pattern and historical record retention.']
  reservoir_capacity_acre_feet decimal(12,2) [note: 'Total storage capacity of the hydro reservoir in acre-feet. Applicable to pumped storage and reservoir-based hydro. Null for run-of-river hydro, solar, and wind.']
  resource_code varchar [note: 'Externally-known unique business identifier for the renewable resource, used in operational systems and regulatory reporting. Typically follows utility naming convention for generation assets.']
  resource_name varchar [note: 'Human-readable name of the renewable generation resource (e.g., \'Sunrise Solar Farm Unit 1\', \'Coastal Wind Turbine 12\').']
  resource_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the renewable generation technology. Solar PV (photovoltaic), solar thermal (concentrating solar power), wind onshore, wind offshore, run-of-river hydro, or pumped storage hydro.']
  resource_zone varchar [note: 'Geographic or operational zone designation for the renewable resource, used for resource planning and dispatch optimization. May align with ISO/RTO pricing zones or internal planning regions.']
  retirement_date date [note: 'Date when the renewable resource was permanently retired from service. Null for active resources. Used for asset lifecycle tracking and regulatory reporting.']
  rotor_diameter_m decimal(6,2) [note: 'Diameter of the wind turbine rotor (blade tip to blade tip) in meters. Determines swept area and energy capture capability. Applicable to wind resources only. Null for solar and hydro.']
  scada_integration_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the renewable resource is integrated with the utility\'s SCADA system for real-time telemetry, monitoring, and control. True if integrated, False otherwise. Supports grid operations and outage management.']
  turbine_model varchar [note: 'Manufacturer and model designation of wind turbine (e.g., \'GE 2.5-120\', \'Vestas V150-4.2MW\'). Applicable to wind resources only. Null for solar and hydro.']
  water_head_m decimal(8,2) [note: 'Vertical distance (head) between the upstream water level and the turbine in meters. Key parameter for hydro generation capacity and efficiency. Applicable to hydro resources only. Null for solar and wind.']

  Note: 'Master records for renewable generation resource characteristics specific to solar, wind, and hydro units. Captures resource type (solar PV, solar thermal, wind onshore, wind offshore, run-of-river hydro, pumped storage), panel/turbine model, installed capacity (MW-DC/MW-AC for solar), hub height (wind), rotor diameter (wind), water head (hydro), resource zone, interconnection agreement number, NEM eligibility flag, and DERMS integration flag. Supports IRP renewable portfolio planning and REC tracking.'
}

Table generation.capacity_resource {
  capacity_resource_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique identifier for the capacity resource registered in RTO/ISO capacity markets. Primary key.']
  generating_unit_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the physical generating unit that this capacity resource represents.']
  plant_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the generation plant where this capacity resource is located.']
  accredited_capacity_mw_icap decimal(12,3) [note: 'The installed capacity (ICAP) value in megawatts (MW) accredited by the RTO/ISO, representing the maximum capacity the resource can provide under reference conditions.']
  accredited_capacity_mw_ucap decimal(12,3) [note: 'The unforced capacity (UCAP) value in megawatts (MW), which is ICAP adjusted for the resource\'s expected forced outage rate (EFORd), representing the expected available capacity.']
  bonus_amount_usd decimal(15,2) [note: 'The bonus payment amount in USD earned by the resource for exceeding performance requirements during shortage events or peak periods.']
  capacity_interconnection_rights varchar [note: 'The type of interconnection rights held by this capacity resource: firm (full deliverability), non-firm (energy-only), or conditional (subject to transmission constraints).']
  capacity_obligation_mw decimal(12,3) [note: 'The capacity obligation in megawatts (MW) that this resource has committed to provide in the capacity market for the delivery period.']
  capacity_product_type varchar [note: 'The capacity product type offered by this resource: base capacity, annual capacity, extended summer capacity, or capacity performance (CP) product.']
  capacity_revenue_forecast_usd decimal(15,2) [note: 'The forecasted capacity revenue in USD for this resource for the current delivery year, used for financial planning and budgeting.']
  capacity_transfer_rights varchar [note: 'Indicates whether the capacity obligation can be transferred to another resource or market participant.']
  capacity_zone varchar [note: 'The geographic capacity zone or locational deliverability area (LDA) where this resource is registered for capacity obligations.']
  cleared_capacity_mw decimal(12,3) [note: 'The capacity in megawatts (MW) that cleared in the most recent capacity auction for this resource.']
  cleared_capacity_price_usd_per_mw_day decimal(12,2) [note: 'The cleared capacity price in USD per MW-day that this resource received in the capacity auction.']
  delivery_year varchar [note: 'The delivery year (or planning year) for which this capacity resource is committed, typically in format YYYY/YYYY (e.g., 2024/2025).']
  effective_date date [note: 'The date when this capacity resource registration became effective in the RTO/ISO capacity market.']
  effective_load_carrying_capability_mw decimal(12,3) [note: 'The effective load carrying capability (ELCC) in megawatts (MW) for renewable and intermittent resources, representing the equivalent firm capacity contribution based on probabilistic reliability analysis.']
  fuel_type varchar [note: 'The primary fuel type or energy source for this capacity resource. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: coal|natural_gas|nuclear|hydro|wind|solar|oil|biomass|storage — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  last_performance_assessment_date date [note: 'The date of the most recent performance assessment conducted for this capacity resource.']
  must_offer_obligation boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this capacity resource has a must-offer obligation requiring it to offer its capacity into the energy market during the delivery period.']
  net_performance_payment_usd decimal(15,2) [note: 'The net performance payment in USD for the assessment period, calculated as bonuses minus penalties.']
  next_performance_assessment_date date [note: 'The scheduled date for the next performance assessment of this capacity resource.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Additional notes, comments, or special conditions related to this capacity resource registration, qualification, or performance.']
  penalty_amount_usd decimal(15,2) [note: 'The penalty amount in USD assessed against the resource for failing to meet capacity obligations during performance assessment intervals.']
  performance_assessment_interval varchar [note: 'The frequency at which this capacity resource\'s performance is assessed against its capacity obligation.']
  performance_score decimal(5,2) [note: 'The performance score (typically 0-100) representing how well the resource met its capacity obligations during performance assessment periods.']
  qualification_status varchar [note: 'The current qualification status of the capacity resource in the RTO/ISO capacity market.']
  qualification_test_date date [note: 'The date when the capacity qualification test was performed to verify the resource\'s capability.']
  qualification_test_result_mw decimal(12,3) [note: 'The measured capacity output in megawatts (MW) achieved during the qualification test.']
  qualification_test_status varchar [note: 'The outcome status of the capacity qualification test.']
  rec_eligible boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this capacity resource is eligible to generate Renewable Energy Certificates (RECs) based on its fuel type and certification.']
  record_created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp when this capacity resource record was first created in the system.']
  record_updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp when this capacity resource record was last updated in the system.']
  registration_status varchar [note: 'The current registration status of the capacity resource in the RTO/ISO system.']
  resource_name varchar [note: 'The business name or designation of the capacity resource as registered with the RTO/ISO.']
  resource_type varchar [note: 'The type of capacity resource: generation (traditional power plant), demand response (load reduction), energy efficiency, or storage (battery/pumped hydro).']
  rto_iso_name varchar [note: 'The name of the RTO or ISO where this capacity resource is registered. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PJM|MISO|NYISO|ISO-NE|CAISO|ERCOT|SPP — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  rto_iso_registration_number varchar [note: 'The unique registration identifier assigned by the RTO/ISO for this capacity resource in their capacity market system.']
  seasonal_capacity_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this is a seasonal capacity resource with availability limited to specific seasons (e.g., summer-only peaking units).']
  termination_date date [note: 'The date when this capacity resource registration was or will be terminated, deactivated, or retired from the capacity market.']

  Note: 'Master records for generating units registered as capacity resources in RTO/ISO capacity markets (PJM RPM, MISO PRA, NYISO ICAP, ISO-NE FCA). Captures capacity zone, accredited capacity (MW-ICAP, MW-UCAP), capacity product type (base capacity, CP), qualification test results, effective load carrying capability (ELCC) for renewables, capacity obligation (MW), performance assessment intervals, bonus/penalty amounts, and associated RTO/ISO registration ID. Distinct from capacity market bidding (owned by trading domain) — this product tracks the physical unit\'s qualification and accreditation status only. Supports capacity revenue forecasting and FERC market compliance.'
}

Table generation.startup_shutdown_event {
  startup_shutdown_event_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique identifier for the startup or shutdown event record.']
  ems_dispatch_instruction_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the dispatch instruction associated with the event.']
  generating_unit_id varchar [note: 'Identifier of the generating unit that experienced the startup or shutdown.']
  initiating_technician_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to workforce.technician. Business justification: Startup/shutdown logs capture the technician who initiated the event, essential for cost allocation and incident analysis.']
  plant_id varchar [note: 'Identifier of the plant where the generating unit is located.']
  preceding_startup_shutdown_event_id varchar [note: 'Self-referencing FK on startup_shutdown_event (preceding_startup_shutdown_event_id)']
  scada_system_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to technology.scada_system. Business justification: Enables correlation of startup/shutdown events with SCADA logs for incident analysis and regulatory reporting.']
  site_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to property.site. Business justification: Event Impact Analysis tracks environmental emissions and cost per site; the link allows aggregation of startup/shutdown metrics for regulatory reporting.']
  cost_center_code varchar [note: 'Internal cost center responsible for the startup/shutdown expense.']
  currency_code varchar [note: 'Three‑letter ISO currency code for monetary amounts.']
  duration_minutes varchar [note: 'Total duration of the event in minutes, calculated from start and end timestamps.']
  emission_factor_code varchar [note: 'Code of the emission factor methodology applied to calculate emissions for this event.']
  emissions_co2_tons decimal(12,3) [note: 'Carbon dioxide emissions generated during the startup or shutdown event.']
  emissions_nox_tons decimal(12,3) [note: 'Nitrogen oxides emissions generated during the event.']
  emissions_so2_tons decimal(12,3) [note: 'Sulfur dioxide emissions generated during the event.']
  end_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Exact timestamp when the unit completed the startup or shutdown process.']
  event_reference_code varchar [note: 'Business identifier code assigned to the event for external tracking and reporting.']
  event_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the primary event occurrence (typically the start of the startup or shutdown).']
  event_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the event (e.g., hot start, cold start, normal shutdown, emergency trip).']
  fuel_consumed_mmbtu decimal(12,3) [note: 'Amount of fuel used during the startup, measured in million British thermal units.']
  fuel_type varchar [note: 'Primary fuel used during the startup (e.g., coal, natural gas, oil).']
  initiating_cause varchar [note: 'Primary cause that triggered the startup or shutdown.']
  is_emergency boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether the event was an emergency shutdown or startup.']
  is_estimated boolean [note: 'Indicates whether any numeric values (fuel, emissions, cost) are estimated rather than measured.']
  is_reportable_to_ferc boolean [note: 'Indicates if the event must be reported to the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission.']
  net_startup_cost_usd decimal(15,2) [note: 'Net cost after adjustments, representing the final amount charged for the startup.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free‑form text for additional comments or observations about the event.']
  ramp_rate_mw_per_min decimal(8,2) [note: 'Maximum ramp rate achieved during the startup, expressed in megawatts per minute.']
  record_created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when the event record was first created in the system.']
  record_source_system varchar [note: 'System of record that supplied the event data.']
  record_updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent update to the event record.']
  regulatory_reporting_flag boolean [note: 'Flag indicating inclusion of this event in regulatory reporting packages.']
  reporting_period date [note: 'Month (first day) for which the event is reported to regulators.']
  start_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Exact timestamp when the unit began the startup or shutdown process.']
  startup_cost_adjustment_usd decimal(15,2) [note: 'Any adjustments (credits or penalties) applied to the base startup cost.']
  startup_cost_usd decimal(15,2) [note: 'Direct cost incurred for the unit startup, expressed in US dollars.']
  startup_shutdown_event_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the startup/shutdown event.']
  startup_time_hours decimal(6,2) [note: 'Total time taken for the unit to reach full load from start of startup.']
  unit_status_after varchar [note: 'Operational status of the unit immediately after the event.']
  unit_status_before varchar [note: 'Operational status of the unit immediately before the event.']

  Note: 'Transactional records for each generating unit startup and shutdown event capturing event type (hot start, warm start, cold start, normal shutdown, emergency trip), initiating cause, start/end timestamps, fuel consumed during startup (MMBtu), startup cost ($), ramp rate achieved (MW/min), emissions during startup, associated dispatch instruction reference, and unit status transitions. Supports startup cost allocation for LCOE, emissions reporting during non-steady-state operation, and unit commitment optimization. Critical for FERC Form 1 O&M cost allocation and EPA startup/shutdown exemption tracking.'
}

Table generation.allocation {
  allocation_id varchar [pk, note: 'Primary key for the generation_allocation association']
  contract_id varchar [note: 'Identifier of the contract governing the allocation']
  metering_service_point_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the metering service point']
  plant_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the generation plant']
  end_date date [note: 'Date when the allocation ends or is superseded']
  percent decimal [note: 'Percentage of the plant\'s output allocated to the service point']
  start_date date [note: 'Date when the allocation becomes effective']

  Note: 'Represents the contractual allocation of electricity generation capacity from a plant to a metering service point. Each record captures the percentage of output allocated, the governing contract, and the effective start and end dates of the allocation.. Existence Justification: A generation plant can allocate portions of its output to multiple service points, and a service point can receive electricity from multiple plants. These allocations are managed through contracts that record allocation percentages, contract identifiers, and effective dates. The relationship is actively created, updated, and deleted by business users as part of the power distribution planning process.'
}

Table generation.audit_plant_assignment {
  audit_plant_assignment_id varchar [pk, note: 'Primary key for the audit_plant_assignment association']
  plant_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the generation plant']
  safety_audit_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the safety audit']

  Note: 'Represents the assignment of a safety audit to a generation plant. Each record links one plant to one safety audit and captures the audit\'s timing, type, and status as they apply to that specific plant.. Existence Justification: Safety audits in the utility can be conducted across multiple generation plants, and each plant may be subject to many audits over its lifecycle. The audit process is managed as a distinct activity that references the plants it covers, and the relationship is actively created and maintained by safety teams.'
}

Table transmission.line {
  line_id varchar [pk, note: 'Primary key for line']
  asset_registry_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to asset.registry. Business justification: Asset Management requires each transmission line to be recorded as an asset for depreciation, maintenance planning, and regulatory reporting.']
  balancing_area_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to gridops.balancing_area. Business justification: Required for NERC/ISO interchange scheduling reports that assign each transmission line to a balancing area for market settlement.']
  ci_account_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to engagement.ci_account. Business justification: Dedicated Transmission Service Agreement requires linking each dedicated line to the customer account that owns it for billing and compliance reporting.']
  cost_center_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: OPEX budgeting report requires each transmission line to be charged to a specific cost center for maintenance and operation costs.']
  customer_account_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to customer.customer_account. Business justification: Industrial customers often have dedicated transmission lines; linking lines to the owning account enables billing, capacity allocation, and reliability planning.']
  from_transmission_substation_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to transmission.transmission_substation. Business justification: A transmission line connects two substations; add FK to the originating substation.']
  product_rate_schedule_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to product.rate_schedule. Business justification: Transmission Service Rate Assignment: each line is assigned a rate schedule for billing and FERC reporting, required by the Transmission Service Rate Determination process.']
  right_of_way_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to transmission.right_of_way. Business justification: Each line runs within a right‑of‑way corridor; link line to its corridor.']
  scada_system_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to technology.scada_system. Business justification: SCADA system monitors each transmission line; required for real‑time monitoring reports and outage analysis.']
  telecom_circuit_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to technology.telecom_circuit. Business justification: Telemetry circuits provide data links for line monitoring; required for SCADA data feed and regulatory reporting.']
  ampacity_amps decimal(8,2) [note: 'Maximum continuous current the line can carry, in amperes.']
  asset_class varchar [note: 'High‑level classification of the asset within the utility\'s asset hierarchy.']
  capacity_mw decimal(8,2) [note: 'Maximum power transfer capability of the line in megawatts.']
  circuit_designation varchar [note: 'Circuit identifier (e.g., A, B, C) used in system schematics.']
  condition_code varchar [note: 'Standardized code representing the line\'s physical condition.']
  conductor_size_mm2 decimal(6,2) [note: 'Cross‑sectional area of the conductor in square millimetres.']
  conductor_type varchar [note: 'Material and construction type of the conductor.']
  construction_year varchar [note: 'Calendar year the line was originally constructed.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when the line record was first created in the system.']
  depreciation_end_date date [note: 'Date when depreciation of the line asset ends (typically end of useful life).']
  depreciation_start_date date [note: 'Date when depreciation of the line asset begins.']
  environmental_sensitivity_flag boolean [note: 'True if the line traverses environmentally sensitive areas requiring special compliance.']
  ferc_jurisdiction_flag boolean [note: 'True if the line falls under Federal Energy Regulatory Commission jurisdiction.']
  gis_route_geometry varchar [note: 'Well‑Known Text representation of the line\'s geographic route.']
  in_service_date date [note: 'Date the line entered commercial service.']
  last_inspection_date date [note: 'Date of the most recent condition inspection.']
  length_miles decimal(8,2) [note: 'Total length of the transmission line segment in miles.']
  line_code varchar [note: 'External business code or tag used to reference the line in operational systems.']
  line_name varchar [note: 'Human‑readable name or designation of the transmission line.']
  line_type varchar [note: 'Physical configuration of the line.']
  nerc_bes_classification varchar [note: 'Indicates whether the line is part of the Bulk Electric System as defined by NERC.']
  next_inspection_due_date date [note: 'Planned date for the next scheduled inspection.']
  operational_status varchar [note: 'Current operational state of the line.']
  out_of_service_date date [note: 'Date the line was retired or taken out of service (null if still active).']
  ownership_percentage decimal(5,2) [note: 'Utility\'s ownership share of the line expressed as a percent.']
  protection_scheme varchar [note: 'Primary protection methodology applied to the line.']
  regulatory_compliance_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the line meets all applicable regulatory requirements.']
  right_of_way_type varchar [note: 'Legal type of the corridor in which the line is situated.']
  rto_iso_region varchar [note: 'Regional transmission organization or independent system operator region for market scheduling.']
  thermal_rating_mva decimal(8,2) [note: 'Maximum continuous thermal rating of the line in megavolt‑amperes.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent update to the line record.']
  voltage_kv decimal(5,2) [note: 'Nominal voltage class of the line expressed in kilovolts.']

  Note: 'Master record for each high-voltage bulk electric system (BES) transmission line segment owned or operated by the utility. Captures line identifier, voltage class (kV), circuit designation, conductor type and size, thermal rating (MVA), length (miles), in-service date, NERC BES classification, FERC jurisdiction flag, RTO/ISO region, GIS route geometry, ownership percentage, and operational status. Serves as the SSOT for transmission line identity and physical characteristics. Referenced by topology, line_rating, outage, protection_relay, right_of_way, and contingency products.'
}

Table transmission.transmission_substation {
  transmission_substation_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique system-generated identifier for the transmission substation.']
  asset_location_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to asset.location. Business justification: GIS location of each substation is stored centrally for mapping, emergency response, and crew dispatch.']
  asset_registry_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to asset.registry. Business justification: Substations are capital assets tracked in the Asset Registry for lifecycle, depreciation, and compliance reporting.']
  ci_account_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to engagement.ci_account. Business justification: Customer‑owned substation management mandates associating the substation record with the owning CI account for asset‑customer accountability.']
  cost_center_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Substation OPEX allocation uses a cost center; the Substation Cost Allocation Report links each substation to its cost center.']
  crew_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to workforce.crew. Business justification: Emergency response plans reference a designated crew for each substation; crew_id enables rapid mobilization.']
  customer_account_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to customer.customer_account. Business justification: Some high‑voltage substations are owned/leased by a primary industrial customer; the FK supports asset ownership tracking and cost recovery.']
  emergency_response_plan_id varchar [note: 'Identifier of the emergency response plan associated with the substation.']
  environmental_permit_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to regulatory.environmental_permit. Business justification: Substation construction requires an EPA environmental permit; linking substation to environmental_permit_id tracks permit compliance.']
  facility_id varchar [note: 'Official facility identifier assigned by the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission.']
  finance_capex_project_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to finance.finance_capex_project. Business justification: Substation capital improvements are managed as Capex Projects; linking enables project cost roll‑up and reporting.']
  gis_boundary_id varchar [note: 'Identifier of the GIS polygon that defines the substation footprint.']
  parcel_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to property.parcel. Business justification: Regulatory reporting and tax assessment require linking each substation to the parcel it occupies, enabling FERC and local tax filings.']
  scada_system_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to technology.scada_system. Business justification: Substation SCADA provides status and control; essential for substation performance dashboards and regulatory compliance.']
  site_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to property.site. Business justification: Operational planning and emergency response group substations by site, required by the utility’s Integrated Operations Center for coordinated outage management.']
  address varchar [note: 'Full street address of the substation, including city, state, zip, and country.']
  area_sqft decimal(12,2) [note: 'Total footprint area of the substation in square feet.']
  asset_classification_code varchar [note: 'Code representing the asset classification hierarchy.']
  asset_condition_rating varchar [note: 'Numeric rating (1‑5) of the asset\'s condition.']
  asset_condition_status varchar [note: 'Current condition of the substation asset.']
  asset_depreciation_method varchar [note: 'Method used to calculate depreciation for the substation asset.']
  asset_depreciation_start_date date [note: 'Date depreciation calculations began for the substation.']
  asset_lifecycle_stage varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle stage of the substation asset.']
  commissioning_date date [note: 'Date the substation was officially commissioned for service.']
  construction_year varchar [note: 'Calendar year the substation was constructed.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when the substation record was first created in the lakehouse.']
  criticality_rating varchar [note: 'Rating (1‑5) indicating the substation\'s importance to grid reliability.']
  decommission_date date [note: 'Date the substation was retired or removed from service, if applicable.']
  emergency_contact_phone varchar [note: 'Phone number for the emergency contact responsible for the substation.']
  gis_polygon_reference varchar [note: 'Identifier of the GIS polygon that defines the substation footprint.']
  gps_latitude double [note: 'Geographic latitude coordinate of the substation location.']
  gps_longitude double [note: 'Geographic longitude coordinate of the substation location.']
  high_voltage_kv decimal(10,2) [note: 'Nominal high‑side voltage rating of the substation in kilovolts.']
  in_service_date date [note: 'Date the substation entered commercial operation.']
  last_inspection_date date [note: 'Date of the most recent inspection of the substation.']
  low_voltage_kv decimal(10,2) [note: 'Nominal low‑side voltage rating of the substation in kilovolts.']
  maintenance_contract_expiry date [note: 'Expiration date of the active maintenance contract.']
  maintenance_contract_status varchar [note: 'Current status of the substation\'s maintenance contract.']
  nerc_cip_classification varchar [note: 'Critical Infrastructure Protection classification per NERC standards.']
  next_inspection_due date [note: 'Scheduled date for the next required inspection.']
  number_of_bays varchar [note: 'Count of bays (circuit breaker slots) available in the substation.']
  operational_status varchar [note: 'Current operational state of the substation.']
  operator_entity varchar [note: 'Entity responsible for day‑to‑day operation of the substation.']
  owner_entity varchar [note: 'Legal entity that owns the substation.']
  risk_score decimal(5,2) [note: 'Quantitative risk score derived from asset condition, location, and criticality.']
  rto_node_code varchar [note: 'Identifier of the node used for RTO/ISO market scheduling and LMP settlement.']
  site_type varchar [note: 'Physical environment of the substation.']
  substation_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the substation based on its primary function.']
  transformer_capacity_mva decimal(12,2) [note: 'Total installed transformer capacity at the substation measured in megavolt‑amperes.']
  transmission_substation_name varchar [note: 'Human‑readable name of the transmission substation.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent update to the substation record.']

  Note: 'Master record for each transmission-level substation facility including high-side and low-side voltage levels, substation type (switching, transformer, converter), GPS coordinates, GIS polygon reference, NERC CIP classification (high/medium/low impact), FERC facility ID, RTO/ISO node identifier, installed transformer capacity (MVA), number of bays, in-service date, and operational status. Serves as the SSOT for substation identity and topology within the transmission domain.'
}

Table transmission.transmission_transformer {
  transmission_transformer_id varchar [pk, note: 'System-generated unique identifier for the transmission transformer record.']
  asset_location_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to asset.location. Business justification: Precise transformer coordinates are needed by field crews; linking to Asset.Location provides a single source of truth.']
  asset_registry_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to asset.registry. Business justification: Transformers are high‑value assets; linking to the registry enables maintenance schedules, reliability analysis, and financial tracking.']
  fixed_asset_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to finance.fixed_asset. Business justification: Transformers are capital assets; depreciation runs and asset registers require a FK to the Fixed Asset record.']
  purchase_order_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to supply.purchase_order. Business justification: Asset acquisition workflow records the purchase order that procured each transformer, supporting asset lifecycle and audit compliance.']
  scada_system_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to technology.scada_system. Business justification: Transformers are monitored via SCADA for temperature, load, and fault detection; needed for reliability reporting.']
  transmission_substation_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the substation where the transformer is located.']
  age_years decimal(5,2) [note: 'Calculated age of the transformer in years since installation.']
  asset_type varchar [note: 'Broad classification of the transformer within asset hierarchy.']
  condition_rating decimal(3,1) [note: 'Overall condition rating on a 0‑10 scale, where higher values indicate better condition.']
  cooling_type varchar [note: 'Cooling method used for the transformer oil (e.g., ONAN, ONAF, OFAF, OFWF).']
  criticality varchar [note: 'Criticality level for reliability planning (critical, non‑critical, unknown).']
  decommission_date date [note: 'Date the transformer was removed from service, if applicable.']
  design_type varchar [note: 'Indicates whether the transformer follows a standard design, a custom specification, or is a prototype.']
  has_bushing_inspection boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the transformer has a documented bushing inspection program (yes/no).']
  impedance_percent decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percent impedance of the transformer, representing voltage drop under load.']
  in_service_date date [note: 'Date the transformer was placed into service.']
  installation_date date [note: 'Date the transformer was physically installed at the substation.']
  last_maintenance_date date [note: 'Date of the most recent maintenance activity.']
  last_test_date date [note: 'Date of the most recent routine test or inspection.']
  latitude decimal(9,6) [note: 'Geographic latitude of the transformer location.']
  longitude decimal(9,6) [note: 'Geographic longitude of the transformer location.']
  losses_watts decimal(10,2) [note: 'Typical iron and copper losses under rated load, measured in watts.']
  maintenance_interval_months varchar [note: 'Planned interval between routine maintenance activities, expressed in months.']
  manufacturer varchar [note: 'Name of the company that manufactured the transformer.']
  manufacturer_part_number varchar [note: 'Part number used by the manufacturer for ordering and warranty.']
  model_number varchar [note: 'Manufacturer\'s model designation for the transformer.']
  mva_rating_emergency decimal(10,2) [note: 'Short‑term emergency power rating of the transformer in megavolt-amperes.']
  mva_rating_normal decimal(10,2) [note: 'Continuous power rating of the transformer in megavolt-amperes under normal operating conditions.']
  nerc_bes_flag varchar [note: 'Indicates whether the transformer is part of the NERC‑defined Bulk Electric System (yes/no).']
  next_maintenance_due date [note: 'Scheduled date for the next planned maintenance.']
  oil_volume_liters decimal(10,2) [note: 'Total volume of insulating oil contained in the transformer, measured in liters.']
  ownership_type varchar [note: 'Indicates whether the transformer is owned by the utility (internal) or leased/third‑party (external).']
  primary_voltage_kv decimal(6,2) [note: 'Rated primary side voltage of the transformer in kilovolts.']
  rated_short_circuit_current_ka decimal(6,2) [note: 'Maximum short‑circuit current the transformer can safely withstand, expressed in kilo‑amperes.']
  secondary_voltage_kv decimal(6,2) [note: 'Rated secondary side voltage of the transformer in kilovolts.']
  serial_number varchar [note: 'Manufacturer‑assigned serial number for traceability.']
  tag_number varchar [note: 'Unique alphanumeric tag assigned to the transformer for field identification.']
  tap_changer_type varchar [note: 'Type of tap changer installed (step‑up, step‑down, automatic, regulating).']
  thermal_rating_c decimal(5,1) [note: 'Maximum allowable operating temperature of the transformer windings.']
  transmission_transformer_status varchar [note: 'Current operational status of the transformer.']
  warranty_expiration_date date [note: 'Date when the manufacturer\'s warranty on the transformer expires.']

  Note: 'Master record for each power transformer installed at a transmission substation. Captures transformer tag number, manufacturer, model, MVA rating (normal/emergency), primary and secondary voltage (kV), impedance (%), cooling type (ONAN/ONAF/OFAF), oil volume, tap changer type, NERC BES flag, in-service date, last test date, and condition rating. Linked to substation and Maximo EAM asset record. Distinct from distribution transformers owned by the distribution domain.'
}

  version_number varchar [note: 'Surrogate key linking to a separate versioning table for historical snapshots.']
  voltage_level_kv decimal(10,2) [note: 'Nominal voltage rating of the branch in kilovolts.']

  Note: 'Represents the network connectivity model (bus-branch model) of the bulk electric system used by EMS, power flow solvers, and state estimation. Each record defines a directed branch (from-bus to to-bus) with associated transmission line or transformer, impedance parameters (R, X, B in per-unit), line charging, transformer tap ratio, and topology version effective date. Includes time-stamped power flow solution snapshots capturing system MW, MVAR, losses, convergence status, and interchange conditions for post-event analysis and NERC reliability assessments. Supports SCADA-driven real-time network model updates, RTO/ISO contingency analysis, and IRP planning inputs. Sourced from GE PowerOn EMS and OSIsoft PI Historian.'
}

  Note: 'Time-stamped operational snapshot of power flow conditions across the transmission network captured from the EMS/SCADA state estimator. Supports post-event analysis, NERC reliability assessments, and IRP planning inputs. Sourced from OSIsoft PI Historian via GE PowerOn EMS.'

  created_by varchar [note: 'User or system identifier that created the contingency record.']

  Note: 'Master record for each defined N-1 or N-2 contingency scenario used in transmission planning and real-time security assessment. Captures contingency name, type (single, double, common mode), elements removed, NERC TPL category, planning horizon, violation thresholds, and last study date. Includes violation detail records from analysis runs capturing thermal overloads, voltage deviations, or stability limit violations with violated element, pre/post-contingency loading (% of rating), violation severity, EMS case identifier, and recommended corrective action. Supports NERC TPL compliance documentation, real-time operator alerts, and corrective action plan tracking.'
}

  load_forecast_mwh decimal(12,2) [note: 'Projected peak load used in the study, expressed in megawatt‑hours.']
  nerc_tpl_category varchar [note: 'NERC Transmission Planning Process category addressed by the study.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free‑form field for any supplemental information.']
  planning_horizon_years varchar [note: 'Number of future years the study evaluates.']
  planning_study_status varchar [note: 'Operational status of the study record.']
  regulatory_compliance_flag boolean [note: 'True if the study meets all applicable regulatory requirements.']
  risk_assessment_score decimal(5,2) [note: 'Quantitative risk rating assigned to the study outcomes.']
  software_tool varchar [note: 'Primary simulation or analysis software used (e.g., PSS/E, PowerWorld).']
  study_description varchar [note: 'Detailed textual description of the study purpose and scope.']
  study_document_path varchar [note: 'File system or repository path to the full study documentation.']
  study_id_code varchar [note: 'External or legacy identifier code for the study.']
  study_name varchar [note: 'Human‑readable name of the planning study.']
  study_owner_contact varchar [note: 'Contact information (e.g., email or phone) for the study owner.']
  study_owner_department varchar [note: 'Internal department responsible for the study.']
  study_scope varchar [note: 'Geographic or system scope of the study (regional, local, or Bulk Electric System).']
  study_type varchar [note: 'Category of the planning study (e.g., NERC TPL, IRP, interconnection feasibility, system impact, facilities).']
  study_year varchar [note: 'Calendar year in which the study was conducted.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time the study record was last modified.']
  version_number varchar [note: 'Incremental version of the study record.']

  Note: 'Master record for each transmission planning study conducted to assess system adequacy, reliability, or interconnection impacts. Captures study name, study type (NERC TPL, IRP, interconnection feasibility, system impact, facilities), study year, planning horizon (years), study scope (regional, local, BES), software tool used (PSS/E, PowerWorld), key assumptions (load forecast, generation mix), study findings summary, NERC TPL category addressed, and approval status. Supports IRP filings and FERC interconnection queue management.'
}

  Note: 'Represents the assignment of transmission line segments to capital expenditure projects, capturing the allocated budget and schedule for each line within a project.. Existence Justification: A transmission line can cross multiple land parcels, and a single parcel can contain sections of multiple transmission lines.   Note: 'Master record for each pad-mount, pole-mount, or vault distribution transformer on the medium-to-low voltage network.   outage_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the outage as planned, unplanned, or momentary.']

  record_audit_updated timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent update to the outage record.']
  region_code varchar [note: 'Three‑letter code representing the utility service region where the outage occurred.']
  saidi_contribution decimal(10,4) [note: 'Customer‑minutes of interruption contributed by this event to the System Average Interruption Duration Index.']
  saifi_contribution decimal(10,4) [note: 'Customer interruptions contributed by this event to the System Average Interruption Frequency Index.']
  updated_by varchar [note: 'User or system account that performed the latest update.']
  created_by varchar [note: 'User or system account that created the outage record.']

  Note: 'Transactional record for each discrete electric distribution outage event (planned or unplanned) managed in GE PowerOn OMS. Captures outage event identifier, outage type (planned/unplanned/momentary), cause code (weather/equipment failure/animal/vegetation/third-party/unknown), affected feeder(s), protective device that operated, estimated and actual customers affected, outage start and restoration timestamps, outage duration (minutes), crew dispatch reference, customer notification status, associated work order reference, SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI contribution values (customer minutes interrupted per event), IEEE 1366 major event day exclusion flag, and storm event association. Includes detail-level affected customer/service point records with individual customer minutes interrupted (CMI). Primary source for calculating SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI reliability indices, PUC reliability reporting, storm restoration performance tracking, and customer outage history. Retains all raw data needed for IEEE 1366 reliability index computation.'
}

  Note: 'Transactional record for planned or emergency switching operations executed on the distribution network. Table distribution.gas_leak {

Table gridops.balancing_area {
  balancing_area_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for the balancing authority area (BAA) record in the lakehouse silver layer. Primary key for this master resource entity.']
  abbreviation varchar [note: 'Short-form abbreviation or acronym for the balancing authority area used in SCADA displays, EMS dispatch screens, and operational communications (e.g., MISO, PJM, SPP).']
  agc_enabled boolean [note: 'Indicates whether Automatic Generation Control (AGC) is active for this balancing area. AGC continuously adjusts generator output to maintain ACE within NERC BAL-001 limits. Critical flag for EMS dispatch configuration.']
  area_sq_miles decimal(12,2) [note: 'Total geographic area of the balancing authority service territory in square miles. Used in infrastructure density analysis, storm response planning, and regulatory filings with state PUCs.']
  area_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the operational jurisdiction type. Distinguishes between a full NERC-registered balancing authority, a sub-control area operating under a parent BA, or a reserve sharing group. Drives dispatch logic and reliability obligation scope in the EMS.']
  balancing_area_name varchar [note: 'Full legal or operational name of the balancing authority area as registered with NERC and recognized by FERC. Used in regulatory filings, RTO/ISO coordination, and operational reporting.']
  cip_classification varchar [note: 'NERC Critical Infrastructure Protection (CIP) impact classification for this balancing area as a bulk electric system (BES) cyber system. Drives cybersecurity control requirements under NERC CIP-002 through CIP-014 standards.']
  control_area_ace_limit_mw decimal(10,2) [note: 'The maximum allowable Area Control Error (ACE) in megawatts for this balancing area, as defined in the NERC BAL-001 standard. ACE is the real-time difference between actual and scheduled interchange plus frequency bias. This limit drives EMS automatic generation control (AGC) setpoints.']
  country_code varchar [note: 'ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the primary country in which this balancing area operates (e.g., USA, CAN, MEX). Relevant for cross-border balancing areas and NERC international coordination.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp when this balancing area master record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports data lineage, audit trail, and regulatory record retention requirements.']
  demand_response_capacity_mw decimal(10,2) [note: 'Total enrolled demand response (DR) capacity in megawatts (MW) available within this balancing area for dispatch during peak demand or grid emergency events. Includes both direct load control and interruptible load programs.']
  der_capacity_mw decimal(10,2) [note: 'Total nameplate capacity of distributed energy resources (DER) — including rooftop solar, battery storage, and small-scale generation — interconnected within this balancing area. Used in DERMS integration and load forecasting.']
  effective_date date [note: 'The date on which this balancing area record became operationally effective, including any boundary changes, restructuring events, or RTO/ISO membership transitions. Supports temporal analysis of balancing area configuration history.']
  eia_ba_code varchar [note: 'The EIA-assigned balancing authority code used in mandatory EIA Form 930 (Hourly Electric Grid Monitor) and EIA Form 411 submissions. Enables linkage between operational data and public EIA reporting.']
  ems_system_code varchar [note: 'The native identifier for this balancing area as configured in the GE PowerOn Advanced Energy Management System (EMS). Used for cross-referencing real-time operational data from the EMS with the lakehouse silver layer record.']
  expiration_date date [note: 'The date on which this balancing area record ceases to be effective, typically due to decommissioning, merger with another balancing authority, or transfer of operational control. Null for currently active areas.']
  frequency_bias_mw_per_hz decimal(10,4) [note: 'The frequency bias setting for this balancing area expressed in megawatts per hertz (MW/Hz). This value is used in the ACE calculation formula and must be reported to NERC annually under BAL-003. Configured in the EMS AGC module.']
  geographic_region varchar [note: 'Descriptive geographic region or service territory description for the balancing area (e.g., Midwest, Pacific Northwest, Southeast). Used for operational reporting, regulatory filings, and GIS-based analysis in Esri ArcGIS.']
  installed_capacity_mw decimal(12,2) [note: 'Total nameplate installed generation capacity in megawatts (MW) within the balancing area boundary. Represents the principal quantitative measure of the resource and is used in IRP filings, NERC reliability assessments, and reserve margin calculations.']
  interchange_scheduling_method varchar [note: 'The method used to schedule energy interchange transactions across the balancing area boundary. E-Tag indicates use of the NERC e-Tag system for electronic tagging of interchange. RTO-managed indicates the RTO/ISO controls interchange scheduling.']
  interconnection varchar [note: 'The North American AC synchronous interconnection to which this balancing area belongs. Determines frequency regulation obligations, emergency assistance protocols, and NERC reliability standards applicability.']
  last_updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp of the most recent modification to this balancing area master record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change tracking, data quality monitoring, and incremental lakehouse processing.']
  latitude_centroid decimal(9,6) [note: 'Decimal latitude of the geographic centroid of the balancing area boundary polygon, in WGS84 coordinate reference system. Used for GIS visualization in Esri ArcGIS and spatial analytics.']
  lmp_pricing_node_code varchar [note: 'The RTO/ISO-assigned pricing node code for the primary Locational Marginal Price (LMP) settlement point associated with this balancing area. Used in Allegro ETRM for energy trading settlement and DAM/RTM position management.']
  load_serving_entity_count varchar [note: 'Number of load serving entities (LSEs) operating within this balancing area. Used in resource adequacy planning, reserve sharing agreements, and NERC reliability assessments.']
  longitude_centroid decimal(9,6) [note: 'Decimal longitude of the geographic centroid of the balancing area boundary polygon, in WGS84 coordinate reference system. Used for GIS visualization in Esri ArcGIS and spatial analytics.']
  market_participation boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this balancing area participates in a wholesale energy market (Day-Ahead Market or Real-Time Market) operated by an RTO/ISO. True for market-participating areas; False for vertically integrated utilities operating outside organized markets.']
  nerc_baa_code varchar [note: 'The official NERC-assigned alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this balancing authority area within the North American bulk electric system. Used in NERC compliance filings, EIA-411 submissions, and interchange scheduling.']
  nerc_registration_date date [note: 'The date on which this balancing authority area was formally registered with NERC as a functional entity. Establishes the start of NERC reliability standard compliance obligations.']
  nominal_frequency_hz decimal(6,3) [note: 'The nominal AC system frequency in hertz (Hz) for this balancing area (typically 60.000 Hz for North American interconnections). Used as the reference frequency for ACE calculations and frequency regulation compliance.']
  operating_reserve_requirement_mw decimal(10,2) [note: 'The minimum operating reserve requirement in megawatts (MW) that must be maintained within this balancing area at all times, per NERC BAL-002 and applicable RTO/ISO tariff requirements. Includes both spinning and non-spinning reserves.']
  operational_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the balancing area. Active indicates the area is fully operational and participating in real-time dispatch and frequency regulation. Transitioning indicates a merger, transfer, or restructuring is in progress.']
  peak_load_mw decimal(12,2) [note: 'Historical or projected annual peak demand in megawatts (MW) for the balancing area. Used in reserve margin calculations, IRP planning, and NERC reliability assessments submitted to FERC and state PUCs.']
  primary_frequency_regulation_mhz decimal(10,4) [note: 'The primary frequency response obligation assigned to this balancing area, expressed in megahertz (MHz) of frequency deviation response capability. Used in NERC BAL-003 compliance tracking and EMS frequency regulation dispatch.']
  renewable_capacity_mw decimal(10,2) [note: 'Total nameplate capacity of renewable energy sources (wind, solar, hydro, geothermal) in megawatts (MW) within the balancing area. Used in REC tracking, IRP filings, and state renewable portfolio standard (RPS) compliance reporting.']
  reserve_margin_pct decimal(6,3) [note: 'The required or actual planning reserve margin expressed as a percentage of peak load. Represents the buffer of generation capacity above peak demand required to maintain reliability. Reported in IRP filings and NERC assessments.']
  rto_iso_membership varchar [note: 'Name of the RTO or ISO within which this balancing area operates or is a member (e.g., PJM Interconnection, MISO, SPP, CAISO, ERCOT, NYISO, ISO-NE). Null if the utility operates as an independent balancing authority outside an RTO/ISO.']
  saidi_target_minutes decimal(8,2) [note: 'The annual SAIDI performance target in minutes for this balancing area, representing the average total duration of interruptions per customer. Reported to state PUCs and used in reliability benchmarking.']
  saifi_target decimal(8,4) [note: 'The annual SAIFI performance target for this balancing area, representing the average number of interruptions per customer per year. Reported to state PUCs and used in reliability benchmarking alongside SAIDI.']
  scada_area_code varchar [note: 'The SCADA system area code assigned to this balancing area in the operational technology environment. Used to correlate real-time telemetry from OSIsoft PI Historian with the balancing area master record for operational intelligence.']
  spinning_reserve_requirement_mw decimal(10,2) [note: 'The minimum spinning (synchronized) reserve requirement in megawatts (MW) for this balancing area. Spinning reserves must be online and capable of responding within 10 minutes per NERC BAL-002 standards.']
  state_codes varchar [note: 'Comma-separated list of two-letter US state abbreviations (e.g., OH,IN,MI) representing the states within or overlapping the balancing area boundary. Determines which state PUC jurisdictions apply for rate case filings and regulatory compliance.']
  tie_line_count varchar [note: 'Number of high-voltage transmission tie lines connecting this balancing area to adjacent balancing areas. Used in interchange scheduling, contingency analysis, and NERC CIP-014 physical security assessments.']
  time_zone varchar [note: 'The IANA time zone identifier for the primary operating time zone of this balancing area (e.g., America/Chicago, America/New_York). Used for scheduling, dispatch, and market settlement time alignment.']
  transmission_operator_code varchar [note: 'The NERC-assigned identifier of the Transmission Operator (TOP) responsible for operating the transmission facilities within this balancing area. May differ from the balancing authority in restructured markets.']
  transmission_voltage_kv decimal(8,2) [note: 'The primary bulk electric system transmission voltage level in kilovolts (kV) for this balancing area (e.g., 345 kV, 500 kV, 765 kV). Defines the BES threshold and NERC CIP applicability scope.']

  Note: 'Master record for each balancing authority area (BAA) or control area managed by the utility, defining geographic and electrical boundaries, interchange schedules, and reliability obligations under NERC standards. Serves as the top-level operational jurisdiction for EMS dispatch and frequency regulation activities.'
}

Table gridops.control_zone {
  control_zone_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for the electrical control zone record within the balancing area. Primary key for this entity.']
  balancing_area_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to gridops.balancing_area. Business justification: Control zones belong to a balancing area; adding balancing_area_id creates proper hierarchy and removes redundant code column.']
  cip_standard_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to regulatory.cip_standard. Business justification: Each control zone is subject to a specific CIP standard; the FK supports compliance tracking and audit readiness.']
  control_center_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to gridops.control_center. Business justification: A control center oversees multiple control zones; adding control_zone.control_center_id creates the necessary parent relationship and eliminates the silo for control_center.']
  scada_system_id varchar [note: 'Zone identifier as registered in the SCADA system (OSIsoft PI Historian / GE PowerOn). Used to correlate real-time telemetry data streams, alarm points, and control actions to this logical control zone.']
  ami_meter_count varchar [note: 'Number of Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI) smart meters deployed within this control zone. Used for demand response targeting, load disaggregation, and meter data management (MDM) reporting.']
  area_control_error_threshold_mw decimal(10,3) [note: 'Maximum allowable Area Control Error (ACE) in Megawatts (MW) for this control zone before corrective dispatch action is triggered. Defined per NERC BAL-001 compliance requirements for balancing authority performance.']
  bus_count varchar [note: 'Number of electrical buses (nodes) within this control zone as modeled in the EMS network topology. Used for state estimation, power flow analysis, and contingency analysis.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this control zone record was first created in the data lakehouse Silver layer. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and regulatory record retention requirements.']
  critical_infrastructure_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this control zone contains or serves Critical Infrastructure Protection (CIP) assets as defined by NERC CIP standards. Zones flagged true require enhanced cybersecurity controls and physical security measures.']
  customer_count varchar [note: 'Total number of end-use customers (residential and commercial) served within this control zone. Used for SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI reliability index calculations and outage impact assessments.']
  der_integration_enabled boolean [note: 'Indicates whether Distributed Energy Resources (DER) — including rooftop solar, battery storage, and small-scale generation — are actively managed within this control zone via the DERMS platform.']
  dispatch_priority varchar [note: 'Numeric priority rank assigned to this control zone for load dispatch and restoration sequencing. Lower values indicate higher priority. Used by EMS/DMS operators during contingency events and load shedding scenarios.']
  dms_zone_code varchar [note: 'Zone identifier as configured in the Distribution Management System (DMS) for feeder switching, fault isolation, and service restoration coordination. Distinct from the EMS zone ID as DMS operates at distribution voltage levels.']
  dr_program_eligible boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this control zone participates in Demand Response (DR) dispatch programs. Zones flagged true are included in DR event targeting, load curtailment calculations, and DERMS coordination.']
  effective_date date [note: 'Date on which this control zone became operationally active and was formally recognized in the EMS/DMS configuration. Used for regulatory reporting, rate case filings, and historical grid topology analysis.']
  ems_zone_code varchar [note: 'Zone identifier as configured in the Energy Management System (EMS) for state estimation, optimal power flow, and automatic generation control (AGC) dispatch. Enables cross-system traceability between the EMS and the data lakehouse.']
  feeder_count varchar [note: 'Number of distribution feeders managed within this control zone. Supports feeder load balancing, switching order management, and outage restoration planning in the DMS.']
  frequency_regulation_eligible boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this control zone is eligible to provide frequency regulation ancillary services to the balancing authority or RTO/ISO market. True if the zone has resources capable of automatic generation control (AGC) response.']
  geographic_region varchar [note: 'Name or code of the geographic service territory region in which this control zone is located. Used for regional load forecasting, regulatory reporting to state PUCs, and operational area assignment.']
  gis_zone_code varchar [note: 'Zone identifier in the Esri ArcGIS geospatial system. Links the logical control zone to its physical geographic boundary polygon for spatial analysis, outage impact mapping, and infrastructure planning.']
  installed_capacity_mw decimal(12,3) [note: 'Total installed generation capacity in Megawatts (MW) within or directly serving this control zone. Supports resource adequacy assessments and capacity reserve margin calculations.']
  interconnection_type varchar [note: 'North American electrical interconnection to which this control zone belongs: Eastern Interconnection, Western Interconnection, ERCOT (Texas), Alaska, or Hawaii. Determines synchronous grid boundaries and applicable NERC reliability standards.']
  last_configuration_review_date date [note: 'Date of the most recent formal review of this control zone\'s EMS/DMS configuration parameters, including voltage setpoints, protection relay settings, and dispatch parameters. Supports NERC FAC-002 compliance documentation.']
  load_forecast_model varchar [note: 'Type of load forecasting methodology applied to this control zone within the Energy Management System (EMS). Determines how short-term and long-term load forecasts are generated for dispatch coordination and resource planning.']
  load_shedding_eligible boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this control zone is eligible for controlled load shedding during grid emergency conditions. Zones containing critical infrastructure (hospitals, emergency services) are typically excluded.']
  nerc_cip_classification varchar [note: 'NERC CIP impact classification level for Bulk Electric System (BES) assets within this control zone. High and Medium classifications require mandatory cybersecurity and physical security controls per NERC CIP-002 through CIP-014.']
  net_energy_metering_eligible boolean [note: 'Indicates whether customers within this control zone are eligible for Net Energy Metering (NEM) programs, allowing bi-directional energy flow credit for distributed generation (e.g., rooftop solar). Affects load forecasting and grid hosting capacity analysis.']
  oms_zone_code varchar [note: 'Zone identifier as registered in the Outage Management System (OMS). Used to correlate outage events, crew dispatch, and restoration activities to this control zone for SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI reporting.']
  peak_load_mw decimal(12,3) [note: 'Maximum recorded or rated peak electrical load in Megawatts (MW) for this control zone. Used as the principal capacity measure for load forecasting, resource adequacy planning, and Integrated Resource Plan (IRP) filings.']
  reserve_margin_pct decimal(6,3) [note: 'Minimum required planning reserve margin percentage for this control zone as mandated by the applicable RTO/ISO or state Public Utility Commission (PUC). Expressed as a percentage of peak load.']
  retirement_date date [note: 'Date on which this control zone was retired or decommissioned from active grid operations. Null for currently active zones. Used for historical topology reconstruction and regulatory asset base (RAB) tracking.']
  rto_iso_code varchar [note: 'Code identifying the Regional Transmission Organization (RTO) or Independent System Operator (ISO) market in which this control zone participates for energy dispatch, ancillary services, and Locational Marginal Price (LMP) settlement.']
  saidi_target_minutes decimal(8,3) [note: 'Target System Average Interruption Duration Index (SAIDI) in minutes for this control zone as established in the utility\'s reliability performance plan or state PUC reliability standards. Benchmarks operational reliability performance.']
  saifi_target decimal(8,4) [note: 'Target System Average Interruption Frequency Index (SAIFI) — average number of interruptions per customer per year — for this control zone as defined in the utility\'s reliability plan or state PUC requirements.']
  state_code varchar [note: 'Two-letter US state code for the primary jurisdiction in which this control zone operates. Determines applicable state Public Utility Commission (PUC) regulations, rate cases, and reliability standards.']
  substation_count varchar [note: 'Number of substations included within this control zone. Used for operational complexity assessment, maintenance planning, and regulatory asset base (RAB) reporting.']
  tie_line_capacity_mw decimal(12,3) [note: 'Total rated transfer capacity in Megawatts (MW) of all tie lines connecting this control zone to adjacent zones or balancing areas. Used for interchange scheduling and Available Transfer Capability (ATC) calculations.']
  tou_pricing_applicable boolean [note: 'Indicates whether Time-of-Use (TOU) pricing rates are applicable to customers within this control zone. Drives load shape modeling and demand response program design for the zone.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent update to this control zone record in the data lakehouse. Used for change data capture (CDC), incremental processing, and audit trail maintenance.']
  voltage_control_mode varchar [note: 'Operational mode for voltage control within this zone as configured in the DMS/EMS. Automatic mode enables closed-loop voltage regulation; supervisory mode allows operator-directed control; manual mode requires direct field action.']
  voltage_level_kv decimal(10,3) [note: 'Nominal operating voltage level of the control zone in kilovolts (kV). Defines the voltage class for equipment ratings, protection coordination, and voltage control strategy within the zone.']
  weather_zone_code varchar [note: 'Code identifying the weather forecast zone associated with this control zone. Weather zone data drives temperature-sensitive load forecasting models and storm preparedness planning within the EMS.']
  zone_code varchar [note: 'Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the control zone within the Energy Management System (EMS) and Distribution Management System (DMS). Used in SCADA displays, switching orders, and operational reports.']
  zone_description varchar [note: 'Free-text operational description of the control zone including its geographic boundaries, key assets, operational characteristics, and any special operating conditions or constraints relevant to dispatch and reliability management.']
  zone_name varchar [note: 'Human-readable name of the control zone used in operational dashboards, load forecasting reports, and dispatch coordination communications.']
  zone_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the control zone within the EMS/DMS. Active zones participate in real-time dispatch and load forecasting. Commissioning zones are being brought into service. Decommissioned zones are retired from grid operations.']
  zone_type varchar [note: 'Operational classification of the control zone indicating its primary grid function: load (demand-side), generation (supply-side), transmission (bulk power), distribution (end-delivery), balancing (area control), or interchange (tie-point between areas).']

  Note: 'Defines electrical control zones within the balancing area, representing logical subdivisions of the grid used for load forecasting, voltage control, and dispatch coordination. Each zone maps to a set of buses, substations, and feeders managed under a unified operational strategy within the EMS/DMS.'
}
