Table workforce.union_agreement {
  union_agreement_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique identifier for the collective bargaining agreement (CBA) record. Primary key.']
  agreement_name varchar [note: 'Full legal name of the collective bargaining agreement, typically including union name and jurisdiction.']
  agreement_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known unique identifier for the collective bargaining agreement, typically formatted as CBA- followed by alphanumeric code.']
  agreement_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the collective bargaining agreement by scope and purpose: master (company-wide), local (facility-specific), supplemental (addendum to master), project (specific construction project), or interim (temporary).']
  arbitration_provision_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the agreement includes binding arbitration as the final step in grievance resolution. True if arbitration is included, False otherwise.']
  bargaining_unit varchar [note: 'Description of the employee group covered by this agreement, such as field technicians, lineworkers, meter readers, or substation operators.']
  base_wage_increase_pct decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage increase in base wages negotiated in this agreement, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 3.50 for 3.5% increase).']
  callout_minimum_hours decimal(4,2) [note: 'Minimum number of hours guaranteed for pay when an employee is called out for emergency or unscheduled work, regardless of actual hours worked.']
  callout_response_time_minutes varchar [note: 'Maximum number of minutes within which an employee must respond to a call-out notification, as specified in the agreement.']
  covered_employee_count varchar [note: 'Number of employees covered under this collective bargaining agreement at the time of ratification or most recent count.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this union agreement record was first created in the system.']
  document_reference_url varchar [note: 'URL or file path to the full legal text of the collective bargaining agreement document stored in the document management system.']
  dues_checkoff_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the employer agrees to deduct union dues from employee paychecks and remit to the union. True if dues checkoff is authorized, False otherwise.']
  effective_date date [note: 'Date when the collective bargaining agreement becomes binding and enforceable.']
  expiration_date date [note: 'Date when the collective bargaining agreement terminates or requires renegotiation. Nullable for open-ended agreements.']
  grievance_procedure_steps varchar [note: 'Detailed description of the formal grievance resolution process defined in the agreement, including escalation steps, timelines, and arbitration provisions.']
  health_benefits_summary varchar [note: 'Summary of health insurance, medical benefits, and wellness programs provided under this agreement, including employer contribution levels and coverage tiers.']
  jurisdiction_description varchar [note: 'Geographic or operational scope defining where this agreement applies, such as specific service territories, facilities, or operational divisions.']
  layoff_recall_provisions varchar [note: 'Detailed provisions governing workforce reductions, layoff procedures, bumping rights, and recall procedures based on seniority and qualifications.']
  management_rights_clause varchar [note: 'Statement of rights reserved to management that are not subject to collective bargaining, such as operational decisions, technology adoption, and business strategy.']
  modified_by_user varchar [note: 'Username or identifier of the system user who last modified this union agreement record.']
  modified_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this union agreement record was last modified or updated in the system.']
  negotiating_team_lead varchar [note: 'Name of the primary management representative who led negotiations for this agreement.']
  negotiation_end_date date [note: 'Date when formal negotiations concluded with agreement reached or impasse declared.']
  negotiation_start_date date [note: 'Date when formal negotiations for this agreement began between management and union representatives.']
  no_strike_clause_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the agreement includes a no-strike provision prohibiting work stoppages during the term of the agreement. True if no-strike clause exists, False otherwise.']
  overtime_multiplier decimal(4,2) [note: 'Multiplier applied to base wage for overtime hours, typically 1.5 for time-and-a-half or 2.0 for double-time.']
  overtime_threshold_hours decimal(5,2) [note: 'Number of hours worked in a period (daily or weekly) after which overtime rates apply, typically 8 hours per day or 40 hours per week.']
  pension_contribution_pct decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage of wages contributed by employer to pension or retirement plan on behalf of covered employees, as specified in the agreement.']
  ratification_date date [note: 'Date when union membership voted to approve and ratify the collective bargaining agreement.']
  safety_training_requirements varchar [note: 'Mandatory safety training and certification requirements specified in the agreement for covered employees, aligned with OSHA and NERC standards.']
  seniority_rules varchar [note: 'Description of how seniority is calculated, applied, and used for purposes such as shift bidding, layoff order, recall rights, and vacation scheduling.']
  shift_differential_pct decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage premium added to base wage for non-standard shifts such as evening, night, or weekend shifts.']
  sick_leave_accrual_rate decimal(18,2) [note: 'Rate at which sick leave accrues for covered employees, typically expressed as hours per pay period or days per year.']
  storm_pay_multiplier decimal(4,2) [note: 'Premium pay multiplier applied during declared storm or emergency restoration events, typically higher than standard overtime rates.']
  storm_pay_trigger_conditions varchar [note: 'Specific conditions or criteria that must be met to activate storm pay provisions, such as declaration of emergency by management or threshold of outages.']
  subcontracting_restrictions varchar [note: 'Limitations or conditions on the company\'s ability to subcontract work normally performed by bargaining unit members, including notification and consultation requirements.']
  union_agreement_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the collective bargaining agreement: draft (being prepared), active (in force), expired (past end date), terminated (ended early), under_negotiation (being renegotiated), or ratified (approved but not yet effective).']
  union_local_number varchar [note: 'Local chapter or lodge number of the union, identifying the specific regional or facility-based union organization.']
  union_name varchar [note: 'Full name of the labor union or trade organization party to this agreement, such as International Brotherhood of Electrical Workers (IBEW).']
  union_representative_name varchar [note: 'Name of the primary union representative or business agent who led negotiations on behalf of the union.']
  union_security_clause varchar [note: 'Type of union membership or dues requirement for employees in the bargaining unit: open_shop (voluntary), union_shop (must join), agency_shop (must pay fees), closed_shop (must be member before hire), or right_to_work (no requirement).']
  vacation_accrual_rate decimal(18,2) [note: 'Rate at which vacation time accrues for covered employees, typically expressed as hours per pay period or days per year based on seniority.']
  wage_scale_structure varchar [note: 'Description of the wage classification system and pay scales defined in the agreement, including job classifications, step progressions, and rate tables.']
  work_rules_summary varchar [note: 'Summary of key work rules and operational provisions defined in the agreement, including jurisdictional boundaries, crew composition requirements, and work assignment protocols.']

  Note: 'Master record for collective bargaining agreements (CBAs) governing unionized field workforce including IBEW (International Brotherhood of Electrical Workers) and other trade union contracts. Captures agreement name, union local number, effective and expiration dates, wage scales by classification, overtime rules, call-out provisions, storm pay provisions, grievance procedures, and jurisdictional work rules. Drives labor cost calculations and scheduling constraint enforcement.'
}

Table workforce.labor_rate {
  labor_rate_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique identifier for the labor rate record. Primary key.']
  facility_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to property.facility. Business justification: Costing models use facility‑specific labor rates to calculate project estimates and regulatory cost reporting.']
  union_agreement_id varchar [note: 'FK to workforce.union_agreement']
  burden_percentage decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage markup applied to direct labor rate to account for benefits, payroll taxes, insurance, and other overhead costs. Used for fully-loaded labor cost calculations in work order costing and rate case filings.']
  capex_opex_indicator varchar [note: 'Indicates whether labor costs for this craft are typically capitalized (CAPEX), expensed (OPEX), or split between both. Drives accounting treatment in work order settlement.']
  cost_center_default varchar [note: 'Default SAP cost center for charging labor costs associated with this craft classification. Used for work order cost allocation and financial reporting.']
  craft_classification_code varchar [note: 'Standardized code identifying the craft or trade classification (e.g., lineworker, electrician, meter technician, substation operator). Aligns with union job classifications and SAP HR organizational assignment codes.']
  craft_classification_name varchar [note: 'Full descriptive name of the craft or trade classification (e.g., Journeyman Lineworker, Senior Substation Electrician, Advanced Meter Technician).']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this labor rate record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.']
  currency_code varchar [note: 'Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary rates (typically USD for U.S. utilities).']
  double_time_rate decimal(12,4) [note: 'Hourly labor rate for double-time hours (typically 2x straight time rate). Applied for holidays, Sundays, or extended overtime per union agreement.']
  effective_end_date date [note: 'Date when this labor rate expires or is superseded by a new rate. Null indicates the rate is currently active with no defined end date.']
  effective_start_date date [note: 'Date when this labor rate becomes effective. Supports rate changes due to union negotiations, annual adjustments, or contract renewals.']
  employee_class varchar [note: 'Broad classification of employee role (field workforce, office staff, technical specialist, supervisory, executive). Used for workforce planning and cost allocation.']
  flsa_status varchar [note: 'FLSA classification determining overtime eligibility. Non-exempt employees are entitled to overtime pay; exempt employees are not.']
  gl_account_default varchar [note: 'Default general ledger account code for posting labor expenses. Aligns with FERC Uniform System of Accounts for regulated utility accounting.']
  last_modified_by varchar [note: 'User ID or system identifier of the person or process that last modified this labor rate record.']
  last_modified_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this labor rate record was last updated. Used for change tracking and audit compliance.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text notes providing additional context about the labor rate, such as special conditions, negotiation history, or application rules.']
  on_call_rate decimal(12,4) [note: 'Hourly or daily rate paid to employees on standby/on-call status, available for emergency dispatch. May be a flat rate or percentage of straight time rate.']
  overhead_percentage decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage markup for indirect overhead costs (supervision, facilities, administrative support) allocated to labor. Used in CAPEX/OPEX cost allocation and regulatory reporting.']
  overtime_rate decimal(12,4) [note: 'Hourly labor rate for overtime hours (typically 1.5x straight time rate). Applied for hours worked beyond standard shift or weekly threshold per union agreement and FLSA regulations.']
  pay_grade varchar [note: 'Pay grade or step level within the craft classification (e.g., Grade 1, Grade 2, Step A, Step B). Determines base compensation level per union agreement or company pay structure.']
  rate_approval_authority varchar [note: 'Entity or individual who approved the labor rate (e.g., HR Director, Union Negotiating Committee, Public Utility Commission).']
  rate_approval_date date [note: 'Date when the labor rate was formally approved by management, union ratification, or regulatory authority.']
  rate_source varchar [note: 'Source authority for the labor rate (union collective bargaining agreement, company compensation policy, market survey, contractor agreement, regulatory mandate).']
  rate_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the labor rate record (active and in use, pending approval, expired, superseded by newer rate, suspended).']
  rate_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the labor rate source and employment relationship (union employee, non-union employee, contractor, temporary worker, apprentice, management).']
  shift_differential_rate decimal(12,4) [note: 'Additional hourly premium for non-standard shifts (evening, night, weekend shifts). Added to base straight time rate.']
  storm_emergency_rate decimal(12,4) [note: 'Premium hourly rate applied during declared storm or emergency restoration events. Typically higher than standard overtime to incentivize rapid response for grid restoration.']
  straight_time_rate decimal(12,4) [note: 'Standard hourly labor rate for regular working hours (typically Monday-Friday, standard shift). Expressed in USD per hour.']
  work_location_type varchar [note: 'Primary work location type for this labor classification (field-based, office-based, hybrid, remote). Impacts travel time allowances and expense policies.']
  created_by varchar [note: 'User ID or system identifier of the person or process that created this labor rate record.']

  Note: 'Reference table of labor rates by craft classification, union agreement, pay grade, and effective date period. Captures straight-time rate, overtime rate, double-time rate, on-call rate, storm rate, and applicable burden/overhead percentages. Used for work order cost estimation, CAPEX/OPEX labor cost allocation, rate case labor cost support, and contractor vs. employee cost comparison. Sourced from SAP HR wage type configuration and union CBA schedules.'
}

Table workforce.absence {
  absence_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique identifier for the workforce absence record. Primary key.']
  absence_employee_id varchar [note: 'Identifier of the employee who is absent. Links to the employee master record in SAP HR.']

  absence_replacement_employee_technician_id varchar [note: 'Identifier of the employee assigned to cover the absent employee\'s shifts or work assignments. Nullable if no replacement assigned.']
  absence_technician_id varchar [note: 'Identifier of the employee who is absent. Links to the employee master record in SAP HR.']
  approver_technician_id varchar [note: 'Identifier of the supervisor or manager who approved or rejected the absence request.']

  accrual_deduction_hours decimal(8,2) [note: 'Number of hours deducted from the employee\'s leave accrual balance (e.g., vacation bank, sick leave bank) for this absence.']
  approval_date date [note: 'The date when the absence request was approved or rejected by the approver.']
  approval_status varchar [note: 'Current approval status of the absence request in the workflow. Pending indicates awaiting supervisor approval, approved indicates authorized absence, rejected indicates denied request, cancelled indicates approved absence later revoked, withdrawn indicates employee retracted the request.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this absence record was first created in the source system.']
  duration_days decimal(6,2) [note: 'Total duration of the absence measured in calendar days or working days depending on absence type configuration.']

  end_date date [note: 'The date when the absence period ends. Nullable for open-ended absences pending return confirmation.']
  fmla_case_number varchar [note: 'Case number assigned to FMLA leave requests for tracking compliance with the Family Medical Leave Act. Populated only for FMLA absence types.']
  impact_on_crew_coverage varchar [note: 'Assessment of the operational impact of this absence on crew coverage and service delivery. Critical indicates absence jeopardizes minimum crew requirements or emergency response capability.']
  intermittent_leave_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this absence is part of an approved intermittent leave arrangement (e.g., recurring FMLA leave taken in separate blocks rather than continuously).']
  last_modified_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this absence record was last updated in the source system.']
  medical_certification_date date [note: 'The date when medical certification documentation was received and validated.']
  medical_certification_received_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether required medical certification documentation has been received for absences requiring medical justification (e.g., FMLA, extended sick leave, workers compensation).']
  notification_method varchar [note: 'The method by which the employee or their representative notified the employer of the absence (e.g., phone call, email, mobile app, direct supervisor notification, emergency contact).']
  notification_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when the absence was first reported or notified to the employer.']
  paid_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the absence is paid (true) or unpaid (false). Determines payroll treatment.']
  payroll_processed_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the absence has been processed in payroll for wage deduction or paid leave disbursement.']
  reason_description varchar [note: 'Free-text description or notes providing additional context about the reason for the absence. May include details for reporting or documentation purposes.']
  replacement_required_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a replacement worker must be scheduled to cover the absent employee\'s duties. True for critical roles or minimum crew requirements.']
  return_to_work_clearance_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the employee received medical or safety clearance to return to work following injury, illness, or extended absence. Required for workers compensation and FMLA cases.']
  return_to_work_date date [note: 'The actual date when the employee returned to active work status following the absence. May differ from planned end_date.']
  scheduled_shift_end_time timestamp [note: 'The originally scheduled end time of the shift or work assignment that the employee missed due to the absence.']
  scheduled_shift_start_time timestamp [note: 'The originally scheduled start time of the shift or work assignment that the employee missed due to the absence.']
  source_system_code varchar [note: 'Code identifying the system of record where the absence was originally created (SAP_HR for SAP HR Absence Management, CLICKSOFTWARE for ClickSoftware WFM, ESS for Employee Self-Service portal, MANUAL for manual entry).']
  source_system_record_code varchar [note: 'The unique identifier of this absence record in the source system of record. Used for data lineage and reconciliation.']
  start_date date [note: 'The date when the absence period begins.']
  storm_response_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this absence occurred during a declared storm or emergency response period, impacting crew availability for critical restoration work.']
  submission_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when the employee or their representative submitted the absence request.']
  type_code varchar [note: 'Code representing the type of absence (e.g., VAC for vacation, SICK for sick leave, FMLA for Family Medical Leave Act, UNION for union leave, JURY for jury duty, MIL for military leave, WC for workers compensation leave, UNPAID for unpaid leave).']
  type_name varchar [note: 'Human-readable name of the absence type (e.g., Vacation, Sick Leave, FMLA Leave, Union Business, Jury Duty, Military Leave, Workers Compensation, Unpaid Leave).']
  union_code varchar [note: 'Code identifying the labor union to which the employee belongs. Relevant for union leave types and collective bargaining agreement compliance.']
  work_center_code varchar [note: 'Code identifying the work center or operational facility where the employee is normally assigned. Used for resource capacity planning.']
  workers_comp_claim_number varchar [note: 'Claim number assigned to workers compensation leave for tracking occupational injury or illness cases. Populated only for workers compensation absence types.']

  Note: 'Transactional record of planned and unplanned workforce absences including vacation, sick leave, FMLA, union leave, jury duty, military leave, and workers compensation leave. Captures absence type, start date, end date, duration in hours, approval status, and impact on crew coverage. Integrated with SAP HR absence management and used by ClickSoftware WFM to adjust available resource capacity for scheduling and storm response staffing.'
}

Table workforce.storm_event {
  storm_event_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique identifier for the storm or emergency event record. Primary key for the storm event entity.']
  incident_commander_employee_id varchar [note: 'Employee identifier of the designated Incident Commander responsible for overall storm response coordination and decision-making authority.']
  technician_id varchar [note: 'Employee identifier of the designated Incident Commander responsible for overall storm response coordination and decision-making authority.']
  actual_restoration_cost_usd decimal(15,2) [note: 'Final actual cost in US dollars incurred for storm restoration activities. Captured after event closure for regulatory rate case filing and insurance claims.']
  actual_restoration_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Actual date and time when full service restoration was completed and all customers were restored to service.']
  affected_customer_count varchar [note: 'Total number of customers who experienced service interruption during the storm event. Used for SAIDI/SAIFI reliability metric calculations and regulatory reporting.']
  affected_service_territory varchar [note: 'Geographic description of the service territory areas impacted by the storm event. May include multiple regions, districts, or the entire service territory.']
  closure_notes varchar [note: 'Free-text summary of final storm event outcomes, lessons learned, and any outstanding follow-up actions required. Used for after-action review and continuous improvement.']
  closure_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when the storm event was officially closed, indicating completion of all restoration activities, demobilization of crews, and final cost reconciliation.']
  contractor_crew_count varchar [note: 'Total number of contractor crews engaged for storm restoration work under existing or emergency procurement agreements.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'System timestamp when the storm event record was first created in the data management system.']
  damage_assessment_completed_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether comprehensive damage assessment of transmission and distribution infrastructure has been completed following the storm event.']
  damage_assessment_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when the initial comprehensive damage assessment was completed, enabling accurate restoration time estimates.']
  declaration_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when the storm event was officially declared by operations leadership, triggering emergency workforce mobilization protocols and mutual aid activation.']
  emergency_operations_center_location varchar [note: 'Physical location or facility name where the Emergency Operations Center was established for storm event coordination.']
  estimated_restoration_cost_usd decimal(15,2) [note: 'Projected total cost in US dollars for storm restoration activities including labor, materials, equipment, and mutual aid expenses. Updated as event progresses.']
  estimated_restoration_time timestamp [note: 'Projected date and time when full service restoration is expected to be completed across all affected areas. Updated throughout the event as conditions and resource availability change.']
  fema_declaration_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the storm event resulted in a federal disaster declaration by FEMA, enabling potential federal assistance and cost recovery.']
  fema_declaration_number varchar [note: 'Official FEMA disaster declaration number assigned to the event if federally declared. Used for tracking federal assistance and reimbursement claims.']
  incident_command_activated_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether formal Incident Command System (ICS) structure was activated for coordinated emergency response management.']
  internal_crew_count varchar [note: 'Total number of internal utility crews mobilized for storm response and restoration activities.']
  last_modified_timestamp timestamp [note: 'System timestamp when the storm event record was most recently updated, reflecting changes to status, estimates, or other event attributes.']
  media_inquiries_count varchar [note: 'Total number of media inquiries received from news organizations during the storm event, indicating public and media attention level.']
  mutual_aid_activated_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether mutual aid resources from other utilities were requested and activated for this storm event. True when external crews are mobilized.']
  mutual_aid_crew_count varchar [note: 'Total number of external mutual aid crews deployed to support restoration efforts during the storm event.']
  oms_event_external_code varchar [note: 'External system identifier from GE PowerOn Advanced OMS for linking storm event to outage records and restoration tracking.']
  peak_outage_count varchar [note: 'Maximum number of customers simultaneously without service at any point during the storm event. Key metric for assessing storm impact severity.']
  public_communications_issued_count varchar [note: 'Total number of public communications (press releases, social media updates, customer notifications) issued during the storm event for customer and stakeholder awareness.']
  regulatory_report_due_date date [note: 'Deadline date by which post-storm regulatory reports must be submitted to the Public Utility Commission per regulatory requirements.']
  regulatory_report_submitted_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether required post-storm regulatory reports have been submitted to the Public Utility Commission or other regulatory authorities.']
  saidi_exclusion_eligible_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this storm event qualifies for exclusion from SAIDI reliability metric calculations under IEEE 1366 major event day (MED) criteria or regulatory commission rules.']
  saifi_exclusion_eligible_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this storm event qualifies for exclusion from SAIFI reliability metric calculations under IEEE 1366 major event day (MED) criteria or regulatory commission rules.']
  state_emergency_declaration_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the state governor declared a state of emergency for this storm event, which may trigger regulatory reporting requirements and cost recovery provisions.']
  storm_end_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Actual or forecasted date and time when the storm conditions ended or are expected to end in the service territory.']
  storm_event_code varchar [note: 'Business identifier code assigned to the storm event for external reference and communication with mutual aid partners, regulatory agencies, and internal systems.']
  storm_name varchar [note: 'Official name assigned to the storm event (e.g., Hurricane Sandy, Winter Storm Jonas). May be assigned by National Weather Service or internal operations.']
  storm_severity_level varchar [note: 'Numeric severity classification from 1 (minor) to 5 (catastrophic) that determines the scale of workforce mobilization, mutual aid activation, and executive escalation. Aligns with company emergency response plan tiers.']
  storm_start_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Actual or forecasted date and time when the storm conditions began or are expected to begin impacting the service territory.']
  storm_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the storm event indicating the phase of emergency response and workforce mobilization.']
  storm_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the storm or emergency event type that determines response protocols and resource mobilization strategies. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: hurricane|tropical_storm|ice_storm|winter_storm|thunderstorm|tornado|derecho|noreaster|flood|wildfire|earthquake|other — 12 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  total_crew_hours decimal(12,2) [note: 'Cumulative labor hours worked by all crews (internal, mutual aid, and contractor) during the storm event. Used for cost tracking and resource utilization analysis.']
  weather_forecast_source varchar [note: 'Name of the meteorological service or vendor providing weather forecasting data for storm event planning and response (e.g., National Weather Service, DTN, Weather Company).']
  wfm_storm_event_external_code varchar [note: 'External system identifier from ClickSoftware Workforce Management system for cross-system reconciliation and integration.']

  Note: 'Master record for declared storm and emergency events that trigger emergency workforce mobilization protocols. Captures storm name, storm type (hurricane, ice storm, derecho, nor\'easter), declaration date/time, affected service territory, estimated restoration time (ERT), storm level (1-5 severity), mutual aid activation flag, and storm status (active, restoration, demobilization, closed). Drives storm crew scheduling, mutual aid crew tracking, and SAIDI/SAIFI storm exclusion reporting.'
}

Table workforce.storm_assignment {
  storm_assignment_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique identifier for the storm assignment record. Primary key.']

  double_time_hours decimal(8,2) [note: 'Number of hours worked at double-time pay rate during the storm assignment. Applied for extended shifts or specific high-priority restoration work under union agreements.']
  estimated_daily_cost decimal(12,2) [note: 'Estimated daily cost for the storm assignment including labor, equipment, lodging, and meals. Used for budget tracking and cost recovery planning. For mutual aid crews, based on EEI reimbursement rates.']
  is_mutual_aid_crew boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether this assignment is for a mutual aid crew from another utility under Edison Electric Institute (EEI) mutual aid agreements. True for external crews, False for internal utility crews.']
  last_modified_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when this storm assignment record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking throughout the assignment lifecycle.']
  lodging_location varchar [note: 'Name and address of the hotel or facility where lodging was provided. Used for expense tracking and mutual aid cost reimbursement.']
  lodging_provided boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether lodging accommodations were provided for the crew or technician during the storm assignment. Relevant for mutual aid crews and extended storm response operations.']
  meals_provided_count varchar [note: 'Total number of meals provided to the crew or technician during the storm assignment. Used for per diem calculation and mutual aid cost reimbursement under EEI agreements.']
  mobilization_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when the crew or technician physically mobilized to the storm response area. Distinct from assignment start; captures actual deployment time for logistics tracking.']
  mutual_aid_crew_size varchar [note: 'Number of personnel in the mutual aid crew. Used for lodging, meals, and logistics planning. Populated only for mutual aid assignments.']
  mutual_aid_equipment_description varchar [note: 'Description of equipment and vehicles brought by the mutual aid crew (e.g., bucket trucks, digger derricks, wire trailers). Used for asset tracking and cost reimbursement.']
  originating_utility_code varchar [note: 'Standard utility identifier code for the mutual aid provider. Follows EEI utility coding standards for mutual aid coordination and billing.']
  originating_utility_name varchar [note: 'Name of the utility company that provided the mutual aid crew. Populated only for mutual aid assignments. Used for cost reimbursement tracking and EEI mutual aid billing.']
  overtime_hours decimal(8,2) [note: 'Number of hours worked at overtime pay rate during the storm assignment. Typically hours beyond standard shift under IBEW storm pay provisions.']
  priority_level varchar [note: 'Priority classification for the storm assignment. Critical assignments address public safety hazards or critical infrastructure. Drives crew dispatch sequencing and resource allocation decisions.']
  regular_hours decimal(8,2) [note: 'Number of hours worked at regular pay rate during the storm assignment. Component of total hours worked for payroll and cost allocation.']
  reporting_depot_code varchar [note: 'Reference to the operations depot or staging area where the crew or technician reports for storm duty. Used for logistics coordination and resource deployment planning.']
  safety_incident_description varchar [note: 'Detailed description of any safety incident that occurred during the storm assignment. Populated only if safety_incident_flag is True. Used for OSHA reporting and safety analysis.']
  safety_incident_flag boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether a safety incident occurred during this storm assignment. Triggers Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) reporting and safety review processes.']
  sap_hr_assignment_code varchar [note: 'Assignment identifier from SAP HR system used for payroll processing and labor cost accounting. Links storm assignment to SAP HR time recording and payroll modules.']
  storm_pay_multiplier decimal(4,2) [note: 'Pay rate multiplier applied for storm duty under union agreement provisions. Typically ranges from 1.5x to 2.5x regular rate depending on conditions and duration. Used for payroll calculation.']
  total_hours_worked decimal(8,2) [note: 'Total number of hours worked during the storm assignment period. Used for storm pay calculation under IBEW provisions and cost recovery filings with Public Utility Commission (PUC).']
  union_agreement_code varchar [note: 'Code identifying the applicable union collective bargaining agreement governing pay rates and working conditions for this assignment. Typically references IBEW local agreement for utility workers.']
  wfm_assignment_external_code varchar [note: 'External identifier from the source Workforce Management system (ClickSoftware). Used for data integration and reconciliation between lakehouse and operational WFM system.']

  Note: 'Transactional record tracking crew and technician assignments during a declared storm event, including both internal utility crews and mutual aid crews from other utilities under EEI mutual aid agreements. Captures storm event reference, assigned crew or technician, assignment role (restoration, damage assessment, wire guard), reporting depot, mobilization and demobilization timestamps, and hours worked under storm pay provisions. For mutual aid crews: originating utility, crew composition, equipment brought, and cost reimbursement tracking. Supports IBEW storm pay calculation, EEI mutual aid billing, and post-storm cost recovery filings.'
}

Table workforce.on_call_rotation {

  employee_id varchar [note: 'User ID of the workforce scheduler or system user who created this rotation record.']
  last_modified_by_user_employee_id varchar [note: 'User ID of the workforce scheduler or system user who last modified this rotation record.']
  primary_on_technician_id varchar [note: 'Primary technician assigned to this on-call rotation period.']
  sap_hr_shift_id varchar [note: 'SAP HR shift plan identifier linked to this on-call rotation for payroll integration.']
  wbs_element_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to finance.wbs_element. Business justification: On‑call activities are charged to WBS elements to track project‑level labor effort and compliance.']
  actual_callouts_count varchar [note: 'Number of emergency callouts that occurred during this rotation period.']
  avg_response_time_minutes decimal(8,2) [note: 'Average response time in minutes for callouts during this rotation period.']
  backup_contact_phone varchar [note: 'Phone number to reach the backup technician during this rotation period.']
  callout_minimum_hours decimal(4,2) [note: 'Minimum billable hours guaranteed per union agreement when technician is called out (e.g., 4-hour minimum per CBA).']
  callout_radius_miles decimal(8,2) [note: 'Maximum distance in miles from technician home location or depot for emergency callout coverage.']
  cdl_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a valid CDL is required for this on-call rotation.']
  clicksoftware_rotation_code varchar [note: 'External identifier for this on-call rotation in the ClickSoftware Workforce Management system.']
  contact_phone varchar [note: 'Primary phone number to reach the on-call technician during this rotation period.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this on-call rotation record was first created in the system.']
  dispatch_center_code varchar [note: 'Code identifying the dispatch center responsible for activating this on-call rotation.']
  emergency_type_coverage varchar [note: 'Comma-separated list of emergency incident types covered by this rotation (e.g., outage, gas leak, downed wire, transformer failure).']
  gas_operator_qualified_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether DOT Pipeline and Hazardous Materials Safety Administration (PHMSA) gas operator qualification is required for this rotation.']
  last_modified_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this on-call rotation record was last updated.']
  mutual_aid_eligible boolean [note: 'Indicates whether technician/crew in this rotation can be deployed for mutual aid to other utilities during major events.']
  nerc_cip_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether NERC CIP security clearance is required for this on-call rotation due to critical infrastructure access.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text notes regarding special conditions, coverage changes, or incidents during this rotation period.']
  on_call_pay_provision varchar [note: 'Specific union CBA clause or company policy defining on-call compensation (e.g., standby pay rate, minimum call-in hours, overtime multiplier).']
  on_call_pay_rate decimal(10,2) [note: 'Hourly or daily standby pay rate for being on-call during this rotation period.']
  osha_qualification_required varchar [note: 'OSHA safety qualifications required for technicians in this rotation (e.g., OSHA 10, OSHA 30, confined space, arc flash).']
  overtime_multiplier decimal(4,2) [note: 'Overtime pay multiplier applied to callout work during on-call rotation (e.g., 1.5x, 2.0x for weekend/holiday).']
  priority_tier varchar [note: 'Priority tier for emergency dispatch escalation (Tier 1 = first responder, Tier 2 = backup, Tier 3 = management escalation).']
  response_time_sla_minutes varchar [note: 'Maximum number of minutes allowed for technician to respond to emergency callout during this rotation (e.g., 30-minute callout SLA).']
  rotation_end_datetime timestamp [note: 'Date and time when the on-call rotation period ends.']
  rotation_name varchar [note: 'Descriptive name for the on-call rotation schedule (e.g., Week 1 Gas Emergency, Storm Response Rotation A).']
  rotation_start_datetime timestamp [note: 'Date and time when the on-call rotation period begins.']
  rotation_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the on-call rotation schedule.']
  rotation_type varchar [note: 'Frequency pattern of the on-call rotation schedule.']
  service_territory_code varchar [note: 'Geographic service territory covered by this on-call rotation.']
  service_type varchar [note: 'Type of emergency service this on-call rotation covers.']
  sla_compliance_rate decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage of callouts during this rotation that met the response time SLA.']
  storm_response_eligible boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this rotation is eligible for storm emergency response activation.']
  union_agreement_code varchar [note: 'Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA) code governing on-call pay provisions and work rules for this rotation.']
  voltage_class_coverage varchar [note: 'Voltage classes this on-call rotation is qualified to handle (e.g., low voltage, medium voltage, high voltage, transmission).']

  Note: 'Defines the on-call rotation schedule for field technicians and crews responsible for after-hours emergency response including outage restoration, gas leak response, and downed wire calls. Captures rotation period (weekly, bi-weekly), technician assigned, backup technician, on-call start and end date/time, response time SLA (e.g., 30-minute callout), and union on-call pay provision. Supports 24/7 emergency dispatch readiness and union CBA on-call compensation compliance.'
}

  posting_status varchar [note: 'State of posting the verification result to the financial system.']

  receipt_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date‑time when the goods receipt was recorded in the system.']
  source_system varchar [note: 'Originating operational system for the invoice data.']
  tax_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Tax component captured on the invoice.']
  tax_code varchar [note: 'Code representing the tax jurisdiction and rate applied.']
  tax_exempt_code varchar [note: 'Code identifying the reason or authority for tax exemption.']
  tax_exempt_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the invoice is tax‑exempt.']

  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent update to the verification record.']

  verification_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the verification process.']
  verification_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Exact date‑time when the verification was performed.']

  Note: 'Logistics invoice verification records matching vendor invoices against purchase orders and goods receipts (three-way match). Captures invoice document number, vendor, invoice date, PO reference, GR reference, invoiced amount, tax amount, payment block status, discrepancy type, and posting status. Enables automated and manual matching for payment release. Distinct from financial AP invoices owned by the finance domain — this product owns the procurement-side matching logic and discrepancy resolution.'

  lifecycle_status varchar [note: 'Current processing state of the interconnection request.']
  max_export_capacity_kw decimal(10,2) [note: 'Maximum power the DER may export to the grid under the agreement.']

  Note: 'Tracks the full lifecycle of a customer or third-party application to interconnect a DER to the utility distribution grid, from initial application through technical studies to executed interconnection agreement.   reporting_period_start date [note: 'Start date of the reporting period covered by the filing.']
  responsible_unit varchar [note: 'Internal business unit or department responsible for the filing.']
  submission_method varchar [note: 'Channel through which the filing was submitted to the regulator.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent modification to the filing record.']
  version varchar [note: 'Version label or identifier for the filing document.']

  Note: 'Master record for every regulatory filing or submission made by the utility to any regulatory body (FERC, NERC, state PUCs, EPA, PHMSA, DOE, EIA). Encompasses rate case filings, IRP submissions, CPCN applications, NERC CIP self-certifications, environmental permit applications, FERC Forms (1, 2, 714), EIA surveys (860, 861, 923), and all other mandatory or voluntary regulatory submissions. Captures filing type, form number, docket reference, filing date, regulatory body, filing status, submission method, responsible organizational unit, reporting period, key reported metrics, financial data summaries, IRP planning horizon and resource mix details, and amendment history. Discriminated by filing_type (FERC_FORM, EIA_SURVEY, IRP, RATE_CASE_FILING, CPCN, CIP_CERTIFICATION, ENVIRONMENTAL, OTHER) to support form-specific attributes. Serves as the SSOT for all regulatory submission events and their lifecycle from draft through final disposition.'
}

Includes BES asset impact classifications: asset identifier, asset type (substation, control center, generation facility, transmission line), assigned impact level (high, medium, low), classification rationale, classification date, review cycle, and responsible engineer.   required_rec_quantity decimal(12,3) [note: 'Calculated number of RECs required to satisfy the RPS obligation for the year.']
  retirement_date date [note: 'Date the REC was retired or otherwise removed from the inventory.']
  rps_obligation_mwh decimal(12,3) [note: 'Total retail electricity sales (MWh) that determine the utility\'s RPS requirement for the compliance year.']
  rps_requirement_percentage decimal(5,2) [note: 'Statutory percentage of retail sales that must be met with renewable energy.']
  source_meter_reading_mwh decimal(12,3) [note: 'Metered generation volume that underlies the REC.']
  transfer_date date [note: 'Date the REC was transferred, if applicable.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent modification to the REC inventory record.']
  vintage_year varchar [note: 'Calendar year in which the renewable electricity was generated.']

  Note: 'Renewable energy compliance master tracking the utility\'s complete RPS position: RECs held, generated, purchased, retired, or transferred, together with RPS obligation positions by compliance year and jurisdiction. Captures REC serial numbers, generation source (solar, wind, hydro, biomass), generating facility, vintage, registry platform (WREGIS, NEPOOL GIS, PJM-EIS), acquisition/retirement dates, and compliance year assignment. RPS obligation tracking: total retail sales (MWh), RPS percentage requirement by tier (Tier 1, Tier 2, solar carve-out), required RECs, RECs retired to date, compliance gap or surplus, alternative compliance payment (ACP) rate and amounts, compliance filing date, and compliance status by jurisdiction. SSOT for the utility\'s complete renewable portfolio standard compliance position including both the certificate inventory and the obligation calculus.'
}

  Note: 'Individual findings, violations, and observations identified during a safety audit or regulatory inspection. Used in rate base (RAB) calculations and depreciation studies. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: steam_production|nuclear_production|hydraulic_production|other_production|transmission|distribution|general — promote to reference product]']
  posting_blocked boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether direct financial postings to this account are currently blocked in SAP FI/CO (field XSPEB). When True, the account cannot receive new journal entries until unblocked by an authorized finance administrator.']
  profit_center_relevant boolean [note: 'Indicates whether postings to this account require a profit center assignment in SAP CO. When True, all journal entries must carry a profit center, enabling segment-level P&L reporting for electric vs. gas operations and regulatory ring-fencing.']
  rab_inclusion_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this account contributes to the Regulatory Asset Base (RAB) used in rate-of-return calculations and ROE determination. RAB-included accounts form the basis for allowed revenue requirement in rate case filings.']
  rate_case_inclusion_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether balances in this account are included in the cost-of-service study for General Rate Case (GRC) or FERC rate case filings. Accounts flagged True are subject to regulatory scrutiny and must be supported by workpapers.']
  reconciliation_account_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this GL account is a reconciliation account (subledger control account) in SAP FI/CO. Reconciliation accounts aggregate balances from subledgers (AP, AR, asset accounting) and cannot receive direct manual postings.']
  reconciliation_account_type varchar [note: 'Specifies the subledger type for reconciliation accounts in SAP FI/CO (field MITKZ): accounts receivable, accounts payable, fixed assets, or not applicable for non-reconciliation accounts. Governs which subledger module posts to this control account.']
  regulatory_asset_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this account records a regulatory asset as defined under FASB ASC 980 Regulated Operations.   regulatory_liability_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this account records a regulatory liability as defined under FASB ASC 980 Regulated Operations. Regulatory liabilities represent obligations to return over-collected revenues or costs to customers through future rate reductions.']
  sort_key varchar [note: 'SAP FI/CO sort key (field ZUAWA) that determines the assignment field populated in line items for this account, controlling how line items are sorted and displayed in account statements. Common values include 001 (posting date), 012 (document number).']
  tax_category varchar [note: 'SAP FI/CO tax category indicator (field MWSKZ) specifying whether the account is relevant for input tax, output tax, or is tax-exempt.   useful_life_years decimal(5,2) [note: 'PUC-approved or FERC-approved estimated useful life in years for plant accounts subject to depreciation. Used in straight-line depreciation rate calculations for rate base recovery and FERC Form 1 depreciation schedules.']

  Note: 'Master repository of all general ledger account codes used by the utility, organized by account class (assets, liabilities, equity, revenues, expenses, O&M). Aligned with FERC Uniform System of Accounts (USoA) and FASB ASC 980 regulated operations classifications. Serves as the foundational reference for all financial postings across SAP FI/CO, rate case cost-of-service studies, and FERC Form 1 reporting.'

  ferc_account_code varchar [note: 'FERC Uniform System of Accounts account code to which the completed project assets will be classified upon capitalization (e.g., \'353\' for Station Equipment, \'376\' for Distribution Mains). Required for FERC Form 1 reporting and rate base determination.']

  is_afudc_eligible boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this project qualifies for AFUDC accrual (True) or not (False). Projects must meet FERC and FASB ASC 980-835 criteria for AFUDC eligibility, typically requiring a construction period exceeding one year and costs above a materiality threshold.']

  last_updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this capital project record was most recently modified in the source system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for incremental data loading, change detection, and audit trail maintenance.']

  ppa_reference_number varchar [note: 'Reference number of the associated Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) if this capital project is related to a renewable energy or generation procurement contract. Null for projects not associated with a PPA. Links capital investment to contracted energy supply.']
  priority_level varchar [note: 'Business priority classification of the capital project used in IRP capital planning and portfolio management. Critical projects are typically regulatory-mandated or safety-driven; high are strategic; medium are operational improvements; low are discretionary.']

  project_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known alphanumeric project identifier assigned by SAP PS/IM at project creation. Used in CPCN filings, IRP capital planning documents, and cross-system references. Corresponds to the SAP Project Definition number (PROJ-PSPNR).']

  project_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the capital project: proposed (under evaluation), authorized (board/management approved), active (construction/implementation in progress), on_hold (temporarily suspended), completed (work finished, pending capitalization), cancelled (project terminated), closed (fully capitalized and settled to fixed assets). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: proposed|authorized|active|on_hold|completed|cancelled|closed — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  project_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the capital project by investment type: new_construction (greenfield infrastructure), replacement (like-for-like asset replacement), upgrade (capacity or capability enhancement), maintenance (major maintenance capitalized), compliance (regulatory-mandated investment), technology (IT/OT systems). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: new_construction|replacement|upgrade|maintenance|compliance|technology — promote to reference product]']
  rec_program_code varchar [note: 'Code identifying the Renewable Energy Certificate (REC) program associated with this capital project, applicable for renewable generation projects (solar, wind, hydro).   regulatory_jurisdiction varchar [note: 'Regulatory jurisdiction governing this capital project for rate recovery and reporting purposes: ferc (FERC-jurisdictional transmission), state_puc (state-regulated distribution/generation), both (dual jurisdiction), exempt (non-regulated or exempt project).']
  revised_budget_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Most recent revised total CAPEX budget after approved budget amendments or scope changes, in USD. Null if no revisions have been made. Used to track budget overruns and variance analysis.']
  utility_division varchar [note: 'Utility business division responsible for this capital project, used for regulatory cost allocation between electric and gas operations and T&D functional separation in rate cases and FERC Form 1 reporting.']

WBS elements map to specific scopes of work and accumulate costs that settle to fixed assets upon project completion. Supports CPCN filings and IRP capital planning.'

Table finance.budget {
  budget_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for each budget record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Serves as the primary key for the budget data product.']
  approver_employee_id varchar [note: 'Employee identifier of the individual who approved this budget version. Supports governance audit trails, segregation of duties controls, and regulatory compliance documentation.']
  cost_center_id varchar [note: 'SAP CO cost center identifier to which this budget line is assigned (e.g., CC-TRANS-001 for Transmission Operations). Enables cost allocation by organizational unit for OPEX tracking and rate case cost-of-service studies.']
  employee_id varchar [note: 'Employee identifier of the budget owner or cost center manager responsible for this budget line. Supports accountability reporting, approval workflow routing, and variance investigation assignment.']
  gl_account_id varchar [note: 'FK to finance.gl_account']
  irp_cycle_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the IRP planning cycle this budget is associated with. Supports long-range financial planning for generation, transmission, and distribution capital programs as required by state PUC IRP filings.']
  profit_center_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Budget header should reference the authoritative Cost Center, Profit Center and WBS Element tables rather than storing duplicate codes.']
  rate_case_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the General Rate Case (GRC) proceeding this budget supports. Links budget data to the regulatory cost-of-service study for PUC rate case filings. Null if not associated with an active rate case.']
  wbs_element_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to finance.wbs_element. Business justification: Budget header should reference the authoritative Cost Center, Profit Center and WBS Element tables rather than storing duplicate codes.']
  approval_date date [note: 'The calendar date on which this budget version received final authorization. Null if not yet approved. Used for governance reporting and establishing the effective date of authorized spending limits.']
  approval_status varchar [note: 'Current workflow state of the budget record in the approval lifecycle: draft (in preparation), submitted (sent for review), under_review (being evaluated), approved (authorized), rejected (not approved), or withdrawn (recalled). Drives governance controls and rate case readiness.']
  asset_class varchar [note: 'For CAPEX budget lines, the ISO 55000 asset class of the capital investment (e.g., Substation Equipment, Transmission Lines, Distribution Transformers, Gas Mains, Generation Plant). Supports RAB valuation, depreciation scheduling, and FERC plant-in-service reporting. Null for OPEX lines.']
  budget_category varchar [note: 'Classifies the budget line as either Operating Expenditure (OPEX) — recurring operational costs — or Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) — investment in long-lived assets. Critical for RAB valuation, depreciation scheduling, and FERC Form 1 plant-in-service reporting.']
  budget_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known alphanumeric identifier assigned to the budget in SAP FI/CO (e.g., BUDG-2025-001). Used for cross-system reference and audit trail in rate case filings and FERC Form 1 reporting.']
  budget_type varchar [note: 'Further classifies the budget by accounting treatment: operating (standard O&M), capital (plant investment), regulatory_asset (deferred cost per FASB ASC 980), or regulatory_liability (deferred revenue/obligation per FASB ASC 980). Supports rate case cost-of-service studies.']
  business_area varchar [note: 'SAP FI business area representing an independent accounting unit within the utility (e.g., Electric, Gas, Corporate). Enables segment reporting and regulatory ring-fencing between electric and gas operations.']
  capex_program_code varchar [note: 'Identifies the capital investment program or portfolio this CAPEX budget line belongs to (e.g., Grid Modernization, AMI Deployment, Gas Main Replacement). Supports capital program-level reporting and CPCN regulatory filings. Null for OPEX lines.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp when this budget record was first created in the system (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Provides the audit trail creation anchor for governance, compliance, and data lineage purposes.']
  currency_code varchar [note: 'ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the planned amount (e.g., USD). Supports multi-currency reporting for utilities with cross-border operations or foreign-denominated PPAs and energy trading contracts.']
  department_code varchar [note: 'Organizational department code responsible for this budget line (e.g., DEPT-TRANS, DEPT-DIST, DEPT-GEN). Supports departmental budget ownership, accountability reporting, and workforce cost allocation.']
  depreciation_rate decimal(8,4) [note: 'Annual depreciation rate (as a decimal, e.g., 0.0333 for 3.33%) applied to CAPEX budget lines for RAB valuation and FASB ASC 980 regulatory accounting. Null for OPEX lines. Sourced from the utility\'s FERC-approved depreciation study.']
  effective_from date [note: 'The date from which this budget version becomes the active, binding financial plan. Supports version-controlled budget management and ensures the correct version is used for variance analysis in each period.']
  effective_until date [note: 'The date on which this budget version is superseded or expires. Null for the currently active version. Enables point-in-time budget reconstruction for audit and regulatory review.']
  energy_domain varchar [note: 'The utility operational domain to which this budget line belongs: generation (fossil/nuclear/renewable), transmission (bulk electric), distribution (last-mile electric), gas (natural gas procurement and distribution), customer_service, or corporate. Supports FERC functional classification and regulatory ring-fencing.']
  ferc_account_code varchar [note: 'FERC Uniform System of Accounts code mapped to this budget line (e.g., Account 353 for Station Equipment, Account 878 for Meter Expenses). Required for FERC Form 1 annual report filing and regulatory cost-of-service studies.']
  fiscal_period varchar [note: 'The fiscal period (month number 1–12) within the fiscal year to which this budget line applies. Enables period-level variance analysis between budgeted and actual costs in SAP FI/CO.']
  fiscal_year varchar [note: 'The four-digit fiscal year to which this budget applies (e.g., 2025). Aligns with the utility\'s regulatory fiscal calendar and supports multi-year IRP financial planning and GRC rate case cost-of-service studies.']
  functional_area varchar [note: 'SAP FI/CO functional area code classifying the budget by business function (e.g., Generation, Transmission, Distribution, Customer Service, Corporate). Supports FERC Form 1 functional classification and rate case cost allocation.']
  fund_code varchar [note: 'Identifies the funding source or appropriation fund for this budget line (e.g., general fund, capital improvement fund, rate case recovery fund). Supports regulatory fund accounting and restricted-use tracking.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for budget analysts to document assumptions, drivers, scope changes, or regulatory conditions associated with this budget line. Supports audit trail and rate case documentation.']
  planned_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The budgeted monetary amount for this line item in USD. Represents the authorized spending plan for the GL account, cost center, or WBS element for the specified fiscal period. Core field for variance analysis against actual costs.']
  planning_horizon_end date [note: 'The end date of the planning horizon covered by this budget record (e.g., 2029-12-31). Enables multi-year budget windows for capital programs, IRP cycles, and long-term rate case planning.']
  planning_horizon_start date [note: 'The start date of the planning horizon covered by this budget record (e.g., 2025-01-01). Supports multi-year IRP financial planning and long-range capital investment scheduling.']
  regulatory_asset_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this budget line relates to a FASB ASC 980 regulatory asset — a cost deferred for future recovery through rates. True = regulatory asset treatment applies. Supports rate base calculation and PUC rate case filings.']
  regulatory_liability_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this budget line relates to a FASB ASC 980 regulatory liability — an obligation to refund amounts to customers through future rate reductions. True = regulatory liability treatment applies.']
  source_system varchar [note: 'Identifies the originating system from which this budget record was sourced (e.g., SAP_FICO for SAP FI/CO module, MANUAL for analyst-entered records, SPREADSHEET for offline planning tools). Supports data lineage and Silver Layer provenance tracking.']
  submission_date date [note: 'The calendar date on which this budget version was formally submitted for review and approval. Supports governance audit trails and regulatory filing deadline tracking for GRC and FERC Form 1.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp of the most recent modification to this budget record (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports change tracking, audit compliance, and Silver Layer incremental load processing.']
  variance_threshold_pct decimal(5,2) [note: 'The allowable percentage variance between budgeted and actual costs before a management escalation or re-forecast is triggered (e.g., 10.00 for 10%). Supports automated variance monitoring and financial control governance.']
  version_number varchar [note: 'Sequential integer version counter within a given version_type, allowing multiple revisions of the same type (e.g., revised_forecast v1, v2). Supports audit trail and change management.']
  version_type varchar [note: 'Indicates the planning iteration of this budget record: initial_plan (original submission), revised_forecast (mid-year revision), final_approved (board/PUC-approved version), or supplemental (out-of-cycle amendment). Supports version-controlled budget management in SAP FI/CO.']

  Note: 'Annual and multi-year financial budget records including header-level plan metadata and granular line items for cost centers, profit centers, and capital projects covering both OPEX and CAPEX. Header stores budget version (initial plan, revised forecast, final approved), approval status, and planning horizon. Line items specify GL account, cost center or WBS element, fiscal period, budget category (OPEX/CAPEX), and planned amount. Supports GRC rate case cost-of-service studies, IRP financial planning, and variance analysis between budgeted and actual costs at the account and cost object level.'
}

Table finance.budget_line {
  budget_line_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for each budget line item within the enterprise data lakehouse. Primary key for the budget_line product.']
  budget_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the parent budget plan or budget version that this line item belongs to. Links the granular line to its overarching planning document.']
  budget_plan_budget_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the parent budget plan or budget version that this line item belongs to. Links the granular line to its overarching planning document.']
  ci_account_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to engagement.ci_account. Business justification: DETAILED BUDGET LINE reports break down allocations by individual key accounts to monitor performance.']
  cost_center_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the SAP CO cost center responsible for this budget line. Used for departmental cost allocation and management reporting.']
  facility_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to property.facility. Business justification: Budget allocations are often broken out by facility to manage capital and OPEX planning.']
  fund_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the funding source or fund associated with this budget line, such as a regulatory rider fund, capital fund, or operating fund.']
  gl_account_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the General Ledger (GL) account in the chart of accounts to which this budget line is assigned. Drives financial reporting and FERC Form 1 account mapping.']
  parcel_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to property.parcel. Business justification: Budget lines are allocated per parcel to support rate‑case analysis and asset‑level cost tracking.']
  portfolio_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to trading.trading_portfolio. Business justification: Needed for Annual Budget Allocation process to assign budget lines to specific trading portfolios for performance tracking.']
  profit_center_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the SAP CO profit center associated with this budget line. Enables profitability analysis by business segment (e.g., electric distribution, gas distribution).']
  wbs_element_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the SAP PS Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) element for capital project budget lines. Applicable when the budget line is associated with a CAPEX project rather than a cost center.']
  actual_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Actual expenditure or revenue posted to the GL account and cost object for the fiscal period. Sourced from SAP FI actual postings. Used for budget-to-actual variance analysis.']
  allocation_method varchar [note: 'Method used to allocate shared or indirect costs to this budget line (e.g., Direct, Proportional, Equal Split, Usage-Based, Headcount). Required for cost-of-service studies in rate case filings.']
  approval_status varchar [note: 'Approval workflow status for this budget line, tracking whether it has been reviewed and authorized by the appropriate budget authority. Distinct from overall line status.']
  approved_by varchar [note: 'Name or employee identifier of the budget authority who approved this budget line. Required for audit trail and delegation of authority compliance.']
  approved_date date [note: 'Date on which this budget line was formally approved by the designated budget authority.']
  asset_class_code varchar [note: 'SAP AM asset class code for CAPEX budget lines, indicating the type of fixed asset to be created (e.g., transmission lines, distribution transformers, meters). Drives depreciation rules and RAB classification.']
  budget_category varchar [note: 'Classifies the budget line as Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) or Operating Expenditure (OPEX). Critical for regulatory asset base (RAB) valuation, rate case filings, and FASB ASC 980 accounting treatment.']
  budget_control_active boolean [note: 'Indicates whether SAP CO budget availability control is active for this budget line, preventing expenditures from exceeding the approved budget amount.']
  budget_line_status varchar [note: 'Current workflow status of the budget line item. Controls editability and approval routing within the budget planning process.']
  budget_type varchar [note: 'Indicates whether this line represents the original approved budget, a revised budget, a rolling forecast, or a supplemental budget request. Supports variance analysis across budget versions.']
  business_unit_code varchar [note: 'Code identifying the business unit or operating division responsible for this budget line (e.g., Electric Generation, Electric Distribution, Gas Distribution, Corporate). Supports segment reporting.']
  committed_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Amount committed against this budget line through purchase orders, contracts, or work orders that have been approved but not yet invoiced. Derived from SAP MM/PM commitment management.']
  cost_type varchar [note: 'Distinguishes between direct costs attributable to a specific activity, indirect costs, allocated overhead, or shared service charges. Used in cost-of-service studies for rate case filings.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this budget line record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.']
  currency_code varchar [note: 'ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this budget line (e.g., USD). Supports multi-currency reporting for international operations or hedging activities.']
  depreciation_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Planned depreciation expense budgeted for this line item in the fiscal period. Applicable to CAPEX lines where asset depreciation is being planned. Supports EBITDA reporting and RAB calculations.']
  effective_end_date date [note: 'The date on which this budget line expires and no further expenditures may be charged against it. Typically aligns with fiscal period or fiscal year end.']
  effective_start_date date [note: 'The date from which this budget line becomes effective and expenditures may be incurred against it. Aligns with the fiscal period start.']
  expenditure_type varchar [note: 'Detailed classification of the expenditure nature (e.g., Labor, Materials, Contractor Services, Depreciation, Fuel, Transmission Charges). Supports O&M cost categorization for regulatory reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Labor|Materials|Contractor Services|Depreciation|Fuel|Transmission Charges|Other — promote to reference product]']
  ferc_account_code varchar [note: 'FERC Uniform System of Accounts code mapped to this budget line. Required for FERC Form 1 annual report filing and regulatory cost allocation.']
  fiscal_period varchar [note: 'The fiscal period (month 1–12 or 13 for year-end adjustments) within the fiscal year to which this budget line applies. Enables monthly budget-to-actual variance analysis.']
  fiscal_quarter varchar [note: 'The fiscal quarter (1–4) within the fiscal year. Supports quarterly financial reporting and regulatory filing schedules.']
  fiscal_year varchar [note: 'The fiscal year to which this budget line applies. Aligns with the utility\'s regulatory and financial reporting calendar year.']
  functional_area_code varchar [note: 'SAP CO functional area code classifying the budget line by business function (e.g., Generation, Transmission, Distribution, Customer Service, Administration). Used for functional cost reporting.']
  internal_order_number varchar [note: 'SAP CO internal order number used for temporary cost collection on specific projects or activities not managed as WBS elements. Supports granular cost tracking for O&M activities.']
  last_updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this budget line record was most recently modified. Used for incremental data loading, change tracking, and audit compliance.']
  line_description varchar [note: 'Free-text description of the budget line item, explaining the nature of the planned expenditure or revenue. Used in rate case cost-of-service studies and management reporting.']
  line_number varchar [note: 'Sequential line number within the parent budget plan, used for ordering and referencing individual line items in budget documents and reports.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text notes or justification comments entered by the budget owner or approver. Captures business rationale for the budget line, particularly for rate case cost justification.']
  planned_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The approved planned budget amount for this line item in the functional currency (USD). Represents the authorized spending or revenue target for the specified GL account, cost object, and fiscal period.']
  program_code varchar [note: 'Internal program or initiative code associated with this budget line (e.g., Grid Modernization, AMI Deployment, Demand Response Program). Enables cross-functional program cost tracking.']
  project_number varchar [note: 'The SAP PS or Maximo project number associated with this CAPEX budget line. Links the budget line to the capital project for CAPEX tracking and RAB valuation.']
  rate_case_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this budget line is included in a General Rate Case (GRC) or rate case cost-of-service study filing. True when the cost is subject to regulatory review for rate recovery.']
  rate_case_reference varchar [note: 'The docket number or reference identifier of the regulatory rate case (GRC) to which this budget line is associated. Enables traceability from budget to regulatory filing.']
  regulatory_asset_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this budget line relates to a regulatory asset or liability as defined under FASB ASC 980 Regulated Operations. True when the cost is expected to be recovered through future rates.']
  revised_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The revised or adjusted budget amount following a formal budget amendment or reforecast. Null if no revision has been made. Supports variance analysis between original and revised budgets.']
  source_system_key varchar [note: 'The natural key or document number from the originating SAP FI/CO system (e.g., SAP budget document number) that uniquely identifies this record in the source system. Supports data lineage and reconciliation.']
  variance_threshold_pct decimal(5,2) [note: 'The allowable percentage variance between planned and actual amounts before a budget exception alert is triggered. Used in management reporting and budget control processes.']

  Note: 'Granular budget line items within a budget plan, specifying the GL account, cost center or WBS element, fiscal period, budget category (OPEX/CAPEX), and planned amount. Enables variance analysis between budgeted and actual costs at the account and cost object level for management reporting and regulatory cost justification.'
}

Table finance.fixed_asset {
  fixed_asset_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for each fixed asset record in the utility plant accounting system. Primary key for the fixed_asset data product.']
  cost_center_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Fixed Asset must be linked to Cost Center, WBS Element, and GL Account for cost tracking and depreciation.']
  facility_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to property.facility. Business justification: Fixed assets are installed at specific facilities; linking supports depreciation schedules and regulatory asset registers.']
  gl_account_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Fixed Asset must be linked to GL Account for financial reporting.']
  parcel_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to property.parcel. Business justification: Fixed assets (transformers, meters) are physically located on parcels; linking enables asset‑location compliance and depreciation reporting.']
  accumulated_depreciation decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total depreciation charged against the asset from in-service date through the current reporting period for book (GAAP) purposes. Used to compute net book value and reported on FERC Form 1 Schedule of Accumulated Depreciation. Expressed in USD.']
  acquisition_date date [note: 'Date the asset was acquired or purchased, which may differ from the in-service date for assets requiring installation or construction. Used for asset age analysis and procurement tracking.']
  asset_category varchar [note: 'High-level functional category of the utility plant asset used for financial reporting segmentation and regulatory rate base grouping. Aligns with FERC functional classification of utility plant. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: generation|transmission|distribution|gas_pipeline|nuclear|renewable|land_rights|building|general_plant|intangible|right_of_use — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  asset_class varchar [note: 'SAP FI-AA asset class grouping assets by type for depreciation key assignment and balance sheet presentation (e.g., ELEC-GEN, ELEC-TRANS, ELEC-DIST, GAS-TRANS, GAS-DIST, NUCLEAR, RENEWABLE, LAND, BUILDING, VEHICLE, IT-EQUIP). Drives default depreciation parameters. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ELEC-GEN|ELEC-TRANS|ELEC-DIST|GAS-TRANS|GAS-DIST|NUCLEAR|RENEWABLE|LAND|BUILDING|VEHICLE|IT-EQUIP|OTHER — promote to reference product]']
  asset_description varchar [note: 'Short descriptive name of the fixed asset as recorded in the asset master (e.g., \'138kV Transmission Line Segment\', \'Gas Distribution Main 4-inch PE\', \'500MW Steam Turbine Unit 3\'). Used in financial reports and rate case exhibits.']
  asset_long_description varchar [note: 'Extended narrative description of the fixed asset providing additional technical and location context beyond the short description. Supports regulatory filings and depreciation study documentation.']
  asset_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known unique asset identifier assigned by SAP Asset Accounting (FI-AA) or Maximo EAM. Serves as the cross-system business key used in rate case filings, FERC Form 1 schedules, and work order references. Corresponds to the SAP Asset Master \'Asset Number\' field.']
