  asset_retirement_obligation decimal(18,2) [note: 'Present value of the legal obligation to retire the asset at end of useful life (e.g., nuclear decommissioning, PCB-contaminated equipment disposal, gas pipeline abandonment). Recorded as a liability under FASB ASC 410-20. Expressed in USD.']
  asset_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the fixed asset. \'in_service\' indicates the asset is placed in service and subject to depreciation. \'under_construction\' indicates construction work in progress (CWIP) not yet capitalized. \'retired\' indicates the asset has been removed from service. Critical for RAB inclusion determination and depreciation run eligibility. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: in_service|under_construction|retired|disposed|held_for_sale|impaired|transferred — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  asset_subnumber varchar [note: 'SAP FI-AA sub-number that identifies a component or sub-asset under the main asset number, enabling component-level depreciation tracking (e.g., turbine blades vs. turbine frame). Null for assets without sub-components.']
  asset_type varchar [note: 'Accounting classification distinguishing tangible utility plant, intangible plant (e.g., software, franchises), right-of-use assets under ASC 842 operating leases, and finance lease assets. Determines balance sheet presentation and applicable accounting standard.']
  bonus_depreciation_taken boolean [note: 'Indicates whether federal bonus depreciation (100% first-year expensing under Tax Cuts and Jobs Act or prior bonus depreciation provisions) was claimed for this asset. Affects deferred tax calculations and normalization requirements under FASB ASC 980-740 for regulated utilities.']
  book_depreciation_method varchar [note: 'Depreciation method applied for GAAP (book) financial reporting purposes. Regulated utilities predominantly use straight-line or group straight-line methods as approved by the PUC in depreciation studies. Corresponds to SAP FI-AA depreciation key for depreciation area 01.']
  book_depreciation_rate decimal(10,6) [note: 'Annual depreciation rate applied for GAAP book purposes, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.025000 = 2.5% per year). Derived from useful life and net salvage percentage. Used to compute annual book depreciation expense.']
  business_area varchar [note: 'SAP FI business area representing the utility segment (electric vs. gas) or functional division. Used for segment reporting, separate electric and gas rate case filings, and FERC Form 1 functional classification.']
  capitalized_interest decimal(18,2) [note: 'Allowance for Funds Used During Construction (AFUDC) or capitalized interest included in the original cost of the asset. For regulated utilities, AFUDC represents the cost of financing construction and is capitalized per FASB ASC 980-835 and FERC regulations. Expressed in USD.']
  company_code varchar [note: 'SAP FI company code identifying the legal entity that owns the asset. For multi-state utilities, different company codes may represent different regulated operating companies with separate rate cases and FERC filings.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when the fixed asset record was first created in the source system (SAP FI-AA). Used for audit trail, data lineage, and record age analysis.']
  current_period_depreciation decimal(18,2) [note: 'Depreciation expense charged for the current accounting period (month or year) for book purposes. Represents the periodic allocation of the depreciable base over the asset\'s useful life. Expressed in USD.']
  depreciable_base decimal(18,2) [note: 'The amount subject to depreciation, calculated as original cost minus net salvage value (salvage value minus removal cost estimate). This is the base used to compute periodic depreciation expense. Expressed in USD.']
  depreciation_area_01_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Accumulated depreciation in SAP FI-AA Depreciation Area 01, representing the GAAP book depreciation basis. This is the primary depreciation area used for financial statement reporting and FERC Form 1. Expressed in USD.']
  depreciation_area_15_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Accumulated depreciation in SAP FI-AA Depreciation Area 15, representing the federal income tax (MACRS) depreciation basis. The difference between Area 15 and Area 01 drives the deferred income tax liability calculation under FASB ASC 740. Expressed in USD.']
  depreciation_area_30_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Accumulated depreciation in SAP FI-AA Depreciation Area 30, representing the PUC-approved regulatory depreciation basis. Differences from Area 01 create regulatory assets or liabilities under FASB ASC 980. Expressed in USD.']
  depreciation_start_date date [note: 'Date from which depreciation began being calculated for this asset. Typically equals the in-service date but may differ for assets with deferred depreciation start (e.g., regulatory lag assets or assets with PUC-approved deferred depreciation treatment under FASB ASC 980).']
  disposal_proceeds decimal(18,2) [note: 'Actual proceeds received from the sale or salvage of the retired asset. Used to compute gain or loss on retirement and to update depreciation reserve accounts. Compared against salvage value estimate for depreciation study calibration. Expressed in USD.']
  ferc_jurisdictional boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the asset is subject to FERC jurisdiction (True) for transmission assets under FERC\'s Open Access Transmission Tariff (OATT) or wholesale rate regulation, versus state PUC jurisdiction only (False). Determines applicable regulatory accounting requirements and rate case venue.']
  ferc_plant_account varchar [note: 'FERC Uniform System of Accounts plant account number classifying the asset (e.g., Account 311 - Steam Production Land, Account 353 - Station Equipment, Account 376 - Distribution Mains, Account 376.1 - Gas Transmission Lines). Mandatory for FERC Form 1 reporting and rate case cost-of-service studies.']
  gis_feature_reference varchar [note: 'Cross-reference identifier linking this fixed asset to its spatial feature record in Esri ArcGIS. Enables geographic rate base analysis, storm damage assessment, and regulatory reporting by geographic area.']
  impairment_loss decimal(18,2) [note: 'Cumulative impairment loss recognized on the asset when its carrying amount exceeds its recoverable amount. For regulated utilities, impairment may be deferred as a regulatory asset if recovery through future rates is probable under FASB ASC 980. Expressed in USD.']
  in_service_date date [note: 'Date the asset was placed in service and depreciation commenced. This is the capitalization date used for depreciation calculation start, rate base inclusion, and FERC Form 1 reporting. Corresponds to SAP FI-AA \'Capitalization Date\'.']
  last_depreciation_run_date date [note: 'Date of the most recent depreciation calculation run executed in SAP FI-AA for this asset. Used to verify depreciation currency and identify assets that may have missed a depreciation posting period.']
  last_modified_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent modification to the fixed asset master record in the source system. Used for change detection in ETL processes and audit trail compliance.']
  macrs_property_class varchar [note: 'IRS MACRS property class determining the tax depreciation recovery period (e.g., 5-year, 7-year, 15-year, 20-year). Utility transmission and distribution assets typically fall in the 15-year or 20-year MACRS class. Drives deferred income tax calculations under FASB ASC 740.']
  maximo_asset_reference varchar [note: 'Cross-reference identifier linking this financial fixed asset record to the corresponding physical asset record in Maximo Enterprise Asset Management (EAM). Enables reconciliation between financial accounting (SAP FI-AA) and physical asset management (Maximo) for O&M cost allocation and maintenance history.']
  net_book_value decimal(18,2) [note: 'Current net book value of the asset computed as original cost minus accumulated depreciation (book basis). Represents the carrying amount on the balance sheet and is a key input to rate base (RAB) valuation. Expressed in USD.']
  original_cost decimal(18,2) [note: 'Original cost of the asset at the time of acquisition or construction completion, representing the gross plant investment recorded in the utility plant accounts. Basis for FERC Form 1 gross plant reporting, rate base (RAB) calculation, and depreciation base. Expressed in USD.']
  plant_location varchar [note: 'Physical location or facility where the asset is installed or operated (e.g., \'Riverside Generating Station\', \'Substation 47 - North District\', \'Gas Compressor Station 12\'). Used for geographic rate base allocation and GIS integration with Esri ArcGIS.']
  purchase_order_number varchar [note: 'SAP MM purchase order number associated with the procurement of this asset. Provides traceability from the capitalized asset back to the original procurement transaction for audit and CAPEX tracking purposes.']
  rab_exclusion_reason varchar [note: 'Reason code explaining why the asset is excluded from the Regulatory Asset Base (RAB) when rab_included is False. Used in rate case testimony and PUC filings to document plant disallowances or exclusions.']
  rab_included boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this asset is included in the Regulatory Asset Base (RAB) for rate case cost-of-service studies. Assets excluded from RAB (e.g., assets not used and useful, excess capacity, or disallowed plant) do not earn a return in rates. Critical for rate case preparation and PUC filings.']
  regulatory_accumulated_depreciation decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total depreciation accumulated using the PUC-approved regulatory depreciation rate from in-service date through current period. Differences between regulatory and book accumulated depreciation create regulatory assets or liabilities under FASB ASC 980. Expressed in USD.']
  regulatory_depreciation_method varchar [note: 'Depreciation method approved by the state PUC or FERC for regulatory ratemaking purposes. May differ from book depreciation method, creating regulatory assets or liabilities under FASB ASC 980. Used in rate case cost-of-service studies and FERC Form 1 regulatory depreciation schedules.']
  regulatory_depreciation_rate decimal(10,6) [note: 'Annual depreciation rate approved by the state PUC or FERC for ratemaking purposes, expressed as a decimal. May differ from book depreciation rate, creating regulatory timing differences. Filed in rate case depreciation studies and FERC Form 1.']
  remaining_useful_life_years decimal(6,2) [note: 'Estimated remaining service life of the asset in years as of the last depreciation study or reporting period. Used in remaining-life depreciation method calculations and impairment assessments. Key input for rate case depreciation expense projections.']
  removal_cost_estimate decimal(18,2) [note: 'Estimated cost of removing or retiring the asset at end of useful life (cost of removal). For regulated utilities, net salvage (salvage value minus removal cost) is used in depreciation rate calculations filed with the PUC. Expressed in USD.']
  retirement_cost decimal(18,2) [note: 'Actual cost incurred to retire and remove the asset from service, including demolition, dismantling, and site remediation costs. Compared against the removal cost estimate for depreciation study accuracy assessment. Expressed in USD.']
  retirement_date date [note: 'Date the asset was retired or removed from service. Triggers cessation of depreciation and initiates retirement accounting entries including removal of original cost and accumulated depreciation from plant accounts. Null for active assets.']
  retirement_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the asset retirement event. Normal retirements occur at end of useful life; abnormal retirements occur prematurely due to storm damage, obsolescence, or regulatory disallowance. Abandonment may trigger regulatory asset treatment under FASB ASC 980.']
  salvage_value decimal(18,2) [note: 'Estimated residual or salvage value of the asset at the end of its useful life, used to determine the depreciable base (original cost minus salvage value). Established through depreciation studies filed with state PUCs. Expressed in USD.']
  state_jurisdiction varchar [note: 'Two-letter US state code identifying the regulatory jurisdiction under which this asset is rate-based. Determines which state PUC has authority over the asset\'s inclusion in rates. Critical for multi-state utilities performing jurisdictional cost allocation.']
  tax_accumulated_depreciation decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total depreciation accumulated for federal income tax purposes (MACRS basis) from in-service date through current period. The difference between tax and book accumulated depreciation represents the temporary timing difference driving deferred income tax balances under FASB ASC 740 and ASC 980. Expressed in USD.']
  tax_depreciation_method varchar [note: 'Depreciation method applied for federal income tax purposes. Most utility assets use Modified Accelerated Cost Recovery System (MACRS) per IRS guidelines, creating timing differences between book and tax depreciation that generate deferred income tax liabilities tracked under FASB ASC 980. Corresponds to SAP FI-AA depreciation area 15.']
  useful_life_years decimal(6,2) [note: 'Estimated useful service life of the asset in years as established by the PUC-approved depreciation study. Drives the straight-line depreciation rate. For group depreciation, this represents the average service life of the asset group. Corresponds to SAP FI-AA \'Useful Life\' field.']
  vendor_number varchar [note: 'SAP MM vendor number identifying the supplier from whom the asset was procured. Used for procurement analytics, vendor performance tracking, and supply chain cost analysis for capital projects.']

  Note: 'Comprehensive fixed asset accounting record for all capitalized utility plant assets including generation equipment, transmission lines, distribution infrastructure, gas pipeline assets, and right-of-use assets from leases. Encompasses the asset master (original cost, in-service date, FERC plant account classification, RAB inclusion status), periodic depreciation calculations across all depreciation areas (book, tax, regulatory) with method and useful life parameters, accumulated depreciation, net book value, retirement/disposal tracking, and depreciation run history. Supports FASB ASC 980 regulatory depreciation studies, rate case depreciation expense justification, and FERC Form 1 accumulated depreciation reporting.'
}

Table finance.depreciation_run {
  depreciation_run_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for each depreciation run record in the SAP FI-AA periodic depreciation calculation. Serves as the primary key for this data product.']
  asset_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the fixed asset record in SAP FI-AA for which depreciation is being calculated. Links to the asset master data including asset class, useful life, and acquisition value.']
  asset_registry_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the fixed asset record in SAP FI-AA for which depreciation is being calculated. Links to the asset master data including asset class, useful life, and acquisition value.']
  depreciation_area_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the depreciation area definition record. SAP FI-AA supports multiple parallel depreciation areas (e.g., book/GAAP, tax, regulatory/FERC) for the same asset.']
  employee_id varchar [note: 'SAP user ID of the person who initiated and executed the depreciation run. Required for SOX internal controls, audit trail documentation, and segregation of duties compliance in the financial close process.']
  accumulated_depreciation_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total accumulated depreciation for the asset in the specified depreciation area as of the end of the fiscal period, including all prior period depreciation plus the current period posted amount. Key metric for FERC Form 1 balance sheet reporting and RAB valuation.']
  acquisition_value_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Original acquisition cost (gross plant value) of the asset in the specified depreciation area as of the depreciation run date. Serves as the depreciable base for depreciation calculations and FERC Form 1 plant-in-service reporting.']
  asset_class_code varchar [note: 'SAP FI-AA asset class code grouping assets by type for depreciation policy application (e.g., transmission lines, distribution transformers, generation equipment, gas mains, meters). Drives default depreciation parameters and FERC plant account mapping.']
  asset_number varchar [note: 'The SAP FI-AA asset number (main asset number) identifying the specific fixed asset. Used as the externally visible business identifier for cross-referencing with Maximo EAM and FERC plant account schedules.']
  asset_subnumber varchar [note: 'SAP FI-AA asset sub-number identifying a component or sub-asset within the main asset record. Supports component-level depreciation tracking for complex utility infrastructure assets.']
  company_code varchar [note: 'SAP FI company code identifying the legal entity for which the depreciation run is executed. Aligns with the regulated utility legal entity structure for FERC and state PUC reporting purposes.']
  cost_center_code varchar [note: 'SAP CO cost center to which the depreciation expense is allocated. Supports CAPEX/OPEX tracking, rate case cost-of-service studies, and departmental financial reporting.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this depreciation run record was first created in the source system (SAP FI-AA). Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.']
  currency_code varchar [note: 'ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this depreciation run record (e.g., \'USD\'). Power and Utilities operates primarily in USD; this field supports multi-currency consolidation for holding company structures.']
  deferred_tax_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Deferred income tax amount arising from the temporary difference between book depreciation and tax depreciation for the period. Calculated as the difference between tax and book depreciation multiplied by the applicable tax rate. Required for FASB ASC 740 and FERC Form 1 deferred tax reporting.']
  depreciation_area_code varchar [note: 'SAP FI-AA depreciation area code identifying the valuation basis for this depreciation calculation. Common utility values include \'01\' (book/GAAP), \'10\' (federal tax/MACRS), \'15\' (state tax), \'20\' (regulatory/FERC), \'30\' (cost-of-service/rate case). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 01|10|15|20|30|31|40 — promote to reference product]']
  depreciation_area_type varchar [note: 'Business classification of the depreciation area indicating the accounting basis. \'book\' is GAAP/FASB basis; \'tax_federal\' is IRS MACRS basis; \'tax_state\' is state tax basis; \'regulatory\' is FERC/PUC regulatory basis per ASC 980; \'cost_of_service\' is rate case study basis.']
  depreciation_end_date date [note: 'The planned end date of depreciation for the asset, representing the date when the asset will be fully depreciated based on its useful life and depreciation start date. Used for asset retirement planning and long-range financial forecasting.']
  depreciation_method_code varchar [note: 'SAP FI-AA depreciation key/method code defining the calculation algorithm applied (e.g., LINA for straight-line, DEGD for declining balance, MACS for MACRS, REGU for regulatory straight-line). Determines how the depreciable base is allocated over the asset useful life.']
  depreciation_method_name varchar [note: 'Human-readable name of the depreciation method applied in this run (e.g., \'Straight-Line\', \'Declining Balance\', \'MACRS 5-Year\', \'Regulatory Straight-Line\', \'Sum-of-Years-Digits\'). Supports rate case documentation and FERC Form 1 narrative disclosures.']
  depreciation_start_date date [note: 'The date on which depreciation commenced for the asset in the specified depreciation area. Typically the asset capitalization date or in-service date. Critical for calculating elapsed depreciation and verifying compliance with FERC capitalization policies.']
  document_number varchar [note: 'SAP FI accounting document number generated when depreciation amounts are posted to the general ledger. Provides the audit trail link between the depreciation run and the corresponding journal entry in the financial ledger.']
  error_message varchar [note: 'System-generated error or warning message from SAP FI-AA when the depreciation run encounters processing issues. Populated only when run_status is \'error\'. Used for operational troubleshooting and period-close exception management.']
  execution_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when the depreciation run was initiated and executed in SAP FI-AA. This is the principal business event timestamp representing when the periodic depreciation calculation was performed.']
  ferc_account_code varchar [note: 'FERC Uniform System of Accounts plant account code associated with the asset (e.g., 311 for Steam Production, 353 for Transmission Lines, 364 for Distribution Poles, 374 for Gas Mains). Required for FERC Form 1 accumulated depreciation schedule reporting.']
  fiscal_period varchar [note: 'The fiscal period (accounting period, typically 1–12 for monthly) within the fiscal year for which depreciation is calculated and posted. Aligns with SAP FI posting period control.']
  fiscal_year varchar [note: 'The fiscal year in which the depreciation run is executed and posted. Used for annual FERC Form 1 reporting, FASB ASC 980 regulatory asset/liability reconciliation, and rate case cost-of-service studies.']
  gl_account_code varchar [note: 'SAP FI general ledger account code to which the depreciation expense is posted (e.g., depreciation expense account or accumulated depreciation contra-asset account). Links the depreciation run to the chart of accounts for financial reporting.']
  is_catch_up_run boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this run includes catch-up depreciation for prior periods that were not previously posted (True). Catch-up runs occur when assets are capitalized retroactively or when depreciation parameters are corrected, requiring prior-period adjustments per FASB ASC 250.']
  is_test_run boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this depreciation run was executed in simulation/test mode (True) without posting to the general ledger, or as a live posting run (False). Test runs are used for period-close validation and rate case depreciation projections.']
  last_updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this depreciation run record was last modified in the source system. Tracks status changes, reversals, or corrections applied after initial creation.']
  net_book_value_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Net book value of the asset as of the end of the fiscal period, calculated as acquisition cost less accumulated depreciation in the specified depreciation area. Used for RAB valuation, rate case cost-of-service studies, and balance sheet reporting.']
  period_end_date date [note: 'The last calendar date of the fiscal period covered by this depreciation run. Defines the as-of date for accumulated depreciation balances and net book value calculations.']
  period_start_date date [note: 'The first calendar date of the fiscal period covered by this depreciation run. Used for period-over-period depreciation analysis and FERC Form 1 monthly reporting alignment.']
  planned_depreciation_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The calculated planned depreciation amount for the asset in the specified fiscal period and depreciation area, expressed in the company currency. Represents the depreciation expense as computed by the SAP FI-AA depreciation engine before posting.']
  posted_depreciation_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The actual depreciation amount posted to the general ledger for the asset in the fiscal period. May differ from planned amount due to manual adjustments, partial period calculations, or catch-up depreciation. Core field for FERC Form 1 accumulated depreciation reporting.']
  posting_date date [note: 'The date on which the depreciation amounts were posted to the SAP FI general ledger. May differ from the period end date in cases of late postings or period-close adjustments.']
  regulatory_depreciation_rate decimal(8,6) [note: 'The PUC/FERC-approved annual depreciation rate applied to the asset for regulatory cost-of-service purposes, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.033333 for 3.33% straight-line over 30 years). Used in rate case depreciation expense justification and FERC Form 1 reporting.']
  remaining_useful_life_years decimal(6,2) [note: 'Remaining useful life of the asset in years as of the depreciation run date, calculated as total useful life minus elapsed service life. Used in regulatory depreciation studies, IRP planning, and asset retirement obligation (ARO) calculations per FASB ASC 410.']
  reversal_document_number varchar [note: 'SAP FI accounting document number of the reversal entry if this depreciation run has been reversed. Populated only when run_status is \'reversed\'. Provides the audit trail for depreciation corrections and period-close adjustments.']
  run_number varchar [note: 'SAP FI-AA externally visible run identifier assigned by the system when the depreciation posting run is executed (e.g., DEPR-2024-001). Used as the business-facing reference number for audit trails and rate case documentation.']
  run_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the depreciation run. \'planned\' indicates scheduled but not yet executed; \'test\' indicates a simulation run without posting; \'posted\' indicates depreciation amounts have been posted to the general ledger; \'reversed\' indicates the run has been reversed; \'error\' indicates the run failed during processing.']
  run_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the depreciation run execution type as defined in SAP FI-AA. \'planned\' is the standard periodic run; \'unplanned\' covers out-of-cycle depreciation; \'repeat\' re-executes a prior period run; \'restart\' continues an interrupted run.']
  salvage_value_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Estimated residual/salvage value of the asset at the end of its useful life, used to reduce the depreciable base. Relevant for regulatory depreciation studies and rate case justification of depreciation rates.']
  tax_depreciation_method varchar [note: 'IRS tax depreciation method applied in the federal tax depreciation area (e.g., MACRS for Modified Accelerated Cost Recovery System, ADS for Alternative Depreciation System, SL for Straight-Line). Drives deferred income tax calculations and FASB ASC 740 income tax accounting.']
  unplanned_depreciation_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Additional unplanned (extraordinary) depreciation amount posted outside the standard periodic run, such as impairment write-downs, accelerated depreciation for regulatory purposes, or asset retirement adjustments per FASB ASC 410.']
  useful_life_years decimal(6,2) [note: 'The total estimated useful life of the asset in years as configured in SAP FI-AA for this depreciation area. Drives the straight-line depreciation rate and is a key input to regulatory depreciation studies and rate case filings.']
  wbs_element_code varchar [note: 'SAP PS Work Breakdown Structure element code linking the depreciation to a capital project. Supports CAPEX tracking and project-level depreciation analysis for infrastructure investment programs.']

  Note: 'SAP FI-AA periodic depreciation calculation run records capturing planned and posted depreciation amounts by asset, depreciation area (book, tax, regulatory), fiscal period, and depreciation method. Supports FASB ASC 980 regulatory depreciation studies, rate case depreciation expense justification, and FERC Form 1 accumulated depreciation reporting.'
}

Table finance.regulatory_asset {
  regulatory_asset_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for each regulatory asset or regulatory liability record in the FASB ASC 980 ledger. Primary key for this data product.']
  cost_center_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Regulatory Asset needs direct link to Cost Center for allocation tracking.']
  gl_account_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Regulatory Asset needs direct links to GL Account and Cost Center for regulatory reporting.']
  related_capital_project_finance_capex_project_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the capital project in the capital project accounting system (SAP PS) that originated the costs deferred into this regulatory asset. Enables traceability from the regulatory asset balance back to the underlying CAPEX project for rate base and depreciation analysis.']
  related_finance_capex_project_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the capital project in the capital project accounting system (SAP PS) that originated the costs deferred into this regulatory asset. Enables traceability from the regulatory asset balance back to the underlying CAPEX project for rate base and depreciation analysis.']
  accounting_period varchar [note: 'The fiscal accounting period (YYYY-MM) to which the current balance and amortization figures apply. Used for period-end close reporting, FERC Form 1 annual filing, and SAP FI/CO period-end postings.']
  accrued_carrying_charges decimal(18,2) [note: 'The cumulative carrying charges (interest on the deferred balance) accrued on this regulatory asset or liability to date (in USD). Included in the total balance subject to recovery or refund through rates.']
  amortization_method varchar [note: 'The method prescribed by the authorizing rate order for amortizing this regulatory asset or liability. \'straight_line\' is most common; \'regulatory_prescribed\' indicates a custom schedule mandated by the regulator; \'units_of_production\' may apply to fuel-related deferrals.']
  annual_amortization_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The annual dollar amount authorized for amortization (recovery or refund) of this regulatory asset or liability through customer rates (in USD). Derived from the approved amortization schedule in the rate order. Used for budgeting and CAPEX/OPEX tracking.']
  approved_by varchar [note: 'Name or employee identifier of the finance officer or regulatory accounting manager who approved the creation or material modification of this regulatory asset record. Required for SOX Section 302/404 internal controls over financial reporting.']
  asset_name varchar [note: 'Descriptive human-readable name of the regulatory asset or liability (e.g., \'Deferred Storm Restoration Costs\', \'Pension Regulatory Asset\', \'Fuel Adjustment Clause Deferral\'). Used in financial statements and rate case testimony.']
  asset_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known alphanumeric identifier assigned by the finance or regulatory accounting team to uniquely reference this regulatory asset or liability in rate case filings, FERC Form 1 schedules, and SAP FI/CO postings. Serves as the business-facing key across systems.']
  asset_type varchar [note: 'Indicates whether this record represents a regulatory asset (costs deferred for future recovery from ratepayers) or a regulatory liability (obligations deferred for future refund to ratepayers) under FASB ASC 980.']
  authorization_date date [note: 'The date on which the regulatory commission issued the rate order or decision authorizing the creation of this regulatory asset or liability. Establishes the FASB ASC 980 recognition date and the legal basis for deferral accounting.']
  authorizing_jurisdiction varchar [note: 'The regulatory jurisdiction that authorized this regulatory asset or liability — Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) for interstate transmission, state Public Utility Commission (PUC) or Public Service Commission (PSC) for distribution, or both for dual-jurisdiction items.']
  beginning_balance decimal(18,2) [note: 'The opening balance of the regulatory asset or liability at the start of the current accounting period (in USD). Used as the baseline for amortization calculations and period-over-period variance analysis in FERC Form 1 and rate case filings.']
  capitalization_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this regulatory asset is classified as a capital expenditure (CAPEX) item on the balance sheet (True) or an operating expenditure (OPEX) deferral (False). Affects rate base inclusion, depreciation treatment, and EBITDA reporting under FASB ASC 980 and FASB ASC 360.']
  carrying_charge_rate decimal(8,6) [note: 'The authorized carrying charge (interest) rate applied to the unamortized balance of this regulatory asset or liability between the deferral date and the recovery start date, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.060000 for 6.0%). Compensates the utility for the time value of money on deferred costs.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp when this regulatory asset record was first created in the system (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Provides the audit trail creation event for SOX compliance and data lineage tracking.']
  cumulative_amortization decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total amortization recognized to date against this regulatory asset or liability since its inception (in USD). Represents the portion already recovered from or refunded to ratepayers through rates. Used to reconcile the original authorized amount to the current balance.']
  current_balance decimal(18,2) [note: 'The current outstanding balance of the regulatory asset or liability as of the most recent accounting period close (in USD). Represents the net unamortized amount remaining for future recovery or refund through rates. Core field for RAB valuation and EBITDA reporting.']
  deferral_start_date date [note: 'The date on which costs or obligations began to be deferred into this regulatory asset or liability account. May differ from the authorization date if the regulator authorized retroactive deferral. Used for amortization period calculations.']
  disallowance_risk_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this regulatory asset carries a risk of partial or full disallowance by the regulator (True = at risk; False = recovery considered probable). Under FASB ASC 980, if recovery is no longer probable, the asset must be written off. Used for financial risk management and disclosure.']
  ferc_account_number varchar [note: 'The FERC Uniform System of Accounts account number to which this regulatory asset or liability is classified (e.g., Account 182.3 for Other Regulatory Assets, Account 254 for Other Regulatory Liabilities, Account 283 for Deferred Income Taxes). Required for FERC Form 1 reporting.']
  ferc_form1_schedule varchar [note: 'The specific FERC Form 1 schedule or page reference where this regulatory asset or liability is reported (e.g., \'Schedule 232 — Regulatory Assets\', \'Schedule 278 — Regulatory Liabilities\'). Supports automated FERC Form 1 report generation.']
  income_tax_effect decimal(18,2) [note: 'The deferred income tax amount associated with this regulatory asset or liability (in USD), arising from temporary differences between book and tax treatment of the deferred costs. Required for FASB ASC 740 and ASC 980 interaction disclosures and FERC Form 1 tax normalization schedules.']
  last_regulatory_review_date date [note: 'The date of the most recent regulatory commission review, audit, or order affecting this regulatory asset or liability. Used to track compliance with ongoing regulatory reporting obligations and to identify assets due for re-authorization.']
  last_updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp of the most recent modification to this regulatory asset record (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change tracking, SOX audit compliance, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks Silver Layer.']
  next_regulatory_review_date date [note: 'The scheduled date of the next regulatory commission review or rate case proceeding in which this regulatory asset or liability will be examined. Used for proactive regulatory compliance planning and rate case preparation.']
  original_authorized_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The total dollar amount of costs or obligations originally authorized by the regulator for deferral and future recovery or refund (in USD). Establishes the ceiling for the regulatory asset or liability as approved in the rate order.']
  originating_event_description varchar [note: 'Narrative description of the business event or circumstance that gave rise to this regulatory asset or liability (e.g., \'Hurricane Ida storm restoration costs incurred Q3 2021\', \'Pension obligation increase due to actuarial assumption change\', \'Nuclear decommissioning cost deferral per Order No. 2023-14\'). Supports audit trails and rate case testimony.']
  plant_function varchar [note: 'The utility plant function to which this regulatory asset or liability is associated, used for jurisdictional allocation and rate class assignment in cost-of-service studies. Aligns with FERC functional classification for T&D separation.']
  probability_of_recovery varchar [note: 'Management\'s assessment of the probability that this regulatory asset will be recovered through future rates, using the FASB ASC 450 contingency framework. \'probable\' supports continued recognition; \'reasonably_possible\' or \'remote\' may trigger impairment or write-off under ASC 980.']
  puc_docket_number varchar [note: 'The official docket or case number assigned by the state Public Utility Commission (PUC) or Public Service Commission (PSC) authorizing the deferral or recovery of this regulatory asset or liability. Essential for regulatory compliance tracking and rate case filings.']
  rate_base_eligible boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this regulatory asset is included in the Regulatory Asset Base (RAB) for rate-of-return calculations. True if the asset earns a return on investment in the rate base; False if it is a non-earning deferral. Critical for Return on Equity (ROE) and rate case calculations.']
  rate_case_reference varchar [note: 'Reference to the General Rate Case (GRC) or rate proceeding in which this regulatory asset or liability was established or most recently reviewed. Used to link financial records to the regulatory proceeding for cost-of-service study support and rate case testimony.']
  rate_order_number varchar [note: 'The specific rate order or commission order number issued by the PUC, PSC, or FERC that authorizes the creation, recovery, or refund of this regulatory asset or liability. Provides the legal basis for FASB ASC 980 recognition.']
  recovery_end_date date [note: 'The scheduled date on which full amortization (recovery or refund) of this regulatory asset or liability is expected to be completed. Defines the end of the authorized recovery period. Nullable for open-ended or indefinite-term regulatory assets.']
  recovery_mechanism varchar [note: 'The rate mechanism through which this regulatory asset is recovered from customers or the regulatory liability is refunded to customers. Examples include base rate inclusion, a specific rate rider, a surcharge, or a Fuel Adjustment Clause (FAC). Critical for revenue management and rate design.']
  recovery_period_years decimal(5,2) [note: 'The total authorized recovery or refund period in years as specified in the rate order. Used for straight-line amortization calculations and for projecting future rate impacts in Integrated Resource Plan (IRP) and rate case cost-of-service studies.']
  recovery_start_date date [note: 'The date on which amortization (recovery from customers or refund to customers) of this regulatory asset or liability commenced through rates. Marks the beginning of the authorized recovery period.']
  regulatory_asset_category varchar [note: 'Business classification grouping the regulatory asset into a standard category such as deferred fuel costs, storm damage costs, pension and OPEB, income taxes recoverable, environmental remediation, asset retirement obligations, or demand-side management program costs. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: deferred_fuel_costs|storm_damage|pension_opeb|income_tax_recoverable|environmental_remediation|asset_retirement_obligation|demand_side_management|rate_case_costs|other — promote to reference product]']
  regulatory_asset_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the regulatory asset or liability record. \'active\' indicates balance is being accumulated; \'amortizing\' indicates recovery or refund is in progress; \'fully_amortized\' indicates the balance has been fully recovered or refunded; \'pending_approval\' indicates awaiting regulatory authorization; \'suspended\' indicates recovery temporarily halted by order; \'written_off\' indicates disallowed by regulator.']
  return_on_equity_rate decimal(8,6) [note: 'The authorized Return on Equity (ROE) rate applied to this regulatory asset when it is included in the rate base. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.095000 for 9.5%). Set by the authorizing rate order. Applicable only when rate_base_eligible is True.']
  source_system varchar [note: 'Identifies the operational system of record from which this regulatory asset record was sourced (e.g., SAP FI/CO for automated postings, manual_entry for regulatory accounting team adjustments). Supports data lineage and Silver Layer reconciliation.']
  utility_service_type varchar [note: 'Identifies whether this regulatory asset or liability relates to the electric utility operations, natural gas utility operations, or both. Required for jurisdictional separation in rate case cost-of-service studies and FERC Form 1 vs. FERC Form 2 reporting.']

  Note: 'FASB ASC 980 regulatory asset and regulatory liability records representing costs or obligations that regulators have authorized for future recovery or refund through rates. Tracks the regulatory asset/liability balance, amortization schedule, authorizing rate order, PUC docket reference, and recovery period. Essential for regulated utility financial reporting and rate base calculations.'
}

Table finance.rate_base {
  rate_base_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for each rate base record in the regulatory asset base (RAB) calculation dataset. Primary key for the rate_base data product.']
  regulatory_asset_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to finance.regulatory_asset. Business justification: Rate Base calculations depend on regulatory asset data; linking provides direct access.']
  accumulated_depreciation_amt decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total accumulated depreciation on utility plant in service as of the test year end date. Subtracted from gross plant in service to arrive at net utility plant in the rate base calculation. Sourced from SAP FI/CO asset accounting module.']
  adit_amt decimal(18,2) [note: 'Accumulated Deferred Income Taxes (ADIT) balance that reduces the rate base. ADIT represents the cumulative timing differences between book and tax depreciation, which are treated as a cost-free source of capital that offsets the rate base per IRS normalization rules and FERC/PUC requirements.']
  afudc_rate decimal(8,4) [note: 'The Allowance for Funds Used During Construction (AFUDC) rate applied to Construction Work in Progress (CWIP) balances, expressed as a decimal. AFUDC represents the cost of financing capital projects during construction and is capitalized to the plant account per FERC Uniform System of Accounts.']
  allowed_roe_rate decimal(8,4) [note: 'The authorized Return on Equity (ROE) rate approved by the regulatory commission for this rate case, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0950 for 9.50%). Used to calculate the equity return component of the revenue requirement in cost-of-service studies.']
  commission_approval_date date [note: 'The date on which the regulatory commission issued its final order approving the rate base for tariff purposes. Nullable until the commission issues its decision following the rate case proceeding.']
  cost_of_debt_rate decimal(8,4) [note: 'The embedded cost of long-term debt used in the capital structure for rate base return calculations, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0450 for 4.50%). Calculated from the utility\'s outstanding long-term debt instruments as filed with the regulatory commission.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp when this rate base record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Provides audit trail for record origination in the Databricks Silver Layer.']
  currency_code varchar [note: 'ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this rate base record. Typically USD for U.S. utility operations. Supports multi-currency reporting for utilities with cross-border operations.']
  customer_deposits_amt decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total customer deposit balances that reduce the rate base. Customer deposits are treated as a cost-free source of capital provided by customers, which offsets the utility\'s rate base investment in cost-of-service studies.']
  cwip_amt decimal(18,2) [note: 'Dollar value of capital projects currently under construction that are included in the rate base per regulatory authorization. CWIP inclusion in rate base is subject to PUC approval and AFUDC (Allowance for Funds Used During Construction) accounting treatment under FASB ASC 980.']
  debt_ratio decimal(8,4) [note: 'The proportion of long-term debt in the approved or proposed capital structure used for rate base return calculations, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.5000 for 50%). Together with equity ratio, defines the capital structure for revenue requirement calculations.']
  depreciation_rate decimal(8,4) [note: 'The composite depreciation rate applied to utility plant in service for rate base and revenue requirement calculations, expressed as a decimal. Established through a depreciation study approved by the regulatory commission.']
  effective_date date [note: 'The date on which the approved rate base becomes effective for tariff and rate-setting purposes. Established by commission order following a General Rate Case (GRC) proceeding.']
  equity_ratio decimal(8,4) [note: 'The proportion of equity in the approved or proposed capital structure used for rate base return calculations, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.5000 for 50%). Determined by the regulatory commission in the rate case proceeding.']
  expiration_date date [note: 'The date on which the approved rate base record expires or is superseded by a new rate case determination. Nullable for open-ended rate base records that remain in effect until a new rate case is filed.']
  ferc_account_code varchar [note: 'The FERC Uniform System of Accounts code associated with the primary plant account category driving this rate base record. Used for FERC Form 1 reporting and regulatory cost allocation studies.']
  filing_date date [note: 'The date on which the rate base data was formally filed with the regulatory commission (PUC or FERC) as part of the rate case application. Establishes the official record date for regulatory proceedings.']
  fuel_type_code varchar [note: 'Identifies the fuel or energy source type associated with generation plant assets included in this rate base record. Used for Integrated Resource Plan (IRP) reporting, Renewable Energy Certificate (REC) tracking, and environmental compliance cost allocation.']
  gross_plant_in_service_amt decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total gross value of utility plant in service (before accumulated depreciation) included in the rate base calculation. Represents the original cost of all depreciable utility assets used and useful in providing regulated service, per FERC Uniform System of Accounts.']
  is_cwip_included boolean [note: 'Indicates whether Construction Work in Progress (CWIP) is included in the rate base (True) per regulatory authorization, or excluded (False) with AFUDC capitalized instead. CWIP inclusion requires specific PUC or FERC authorization.']
  is_ferc_jurisdictional boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this rate base record falls under FERC jurisdiction (True) for interstate transmission and wholesale power sales, or under state PUC jurisdiction (False) for retail distribution and local gas distribution. Determines applicable regulatory accounting and reporting requirements.']
  jurisdiction_code varchar [note: 'Code identifying the regulatory jurisdiction (state or federal) under which this rate base record is filed. Used to segregate rate base components by PUC or FERC jurisdiction for cost-of-service studies and rate case filings.']
  net_utility_plant_amt decimal(18,2) [note: 'Net book value of utility plant in service, calculated as gross plant in service minus accumulated depreciation. Represents the primary component of the regulatory asset base (RAB) used in cost-of-service studies and Return on Equity (ROE) calculations.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for regulatory analysts and financial planners to document material adjustments, commission-ordered modifications, stipulations, or other explanatory notes associated with this rate base record. Supports audit trail and regulatory proceeding documentation.']
  plant_function_code varchar [note: 'Functional classification of the utility plant included in this rate base record per FERC Uniform System of Accounts. Distinguishes between generation, transmission, distribution, general plant, and intangible plant for cost allocation and rate design purposes.']
  plant_in_service_date date [note: 'The date as of which the utility plant in service balance is measured for inclusion in the rate base. Typically the last day of the test year or a specific date established by the regulatory commission for the cost-of-service study.']
  rate_base_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known business identifier for the rate base record, used in regulatory filings, cost-of-service studies, and rate case submissions to the Public Utility Commission (PUC). Typically formatted as a combination of jurisdiction code, rate class, and test year (e.g., CA-RES-2024).']
  rate_base_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the rate base record within the regulatory filing process. Tracks progression from internal draft preparation through regulatory filing, commission approval, and potential supersession by a subsequent rate case.']
  rate_case_docket_number varchar [note: 'Official docket or case number assigned by the regulatory commission (PUC or FERC) to the rate case proceeding in which this rate base record is submitted. Used for regulatory tracking and cross-referencing with commission orders.']
  rate_class_code varchar [note: 'Code identifying the customer rate class (e.g., residential, commercial, industrial, agricultural) to which this rate base component is allocated. Supports cost-of-service allocation studies and rate design for General Rate Case (GRC) filings.']
  regulatory_assets_amt decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total value of regulatory assets included in the rate base. Regulatory assets represent costs deferred for future recovery in rates as authorized by the PUC under FASB ASC 980, including deferred storm costs, deferred pension costs, and other commission-approved deferrals.']
  regulatory_liabilities_amt decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total value of regulatory liabilities that reduce the rate base. Regulatory liabilities represent obligations to return amounts to customers in future rates, such as excess deferred income taxes from tax reform or over-collected revenues, as authorized under FASB ASC 980.']
  return_on_rate_base_amt decimal(18,2) [note: 'The dollar amount of authorized return on the rate base, calculated as total rate base multiplied by the weighted average cost of capital (WACC). Represents the equity and debt return component of the revenue requirement.']
  revenue_requirement_amt decimal(18,2) [note: 'The total annual revenue requirement associated with this rate base record, representing the amount the utility is authorized to collect from customers to recover its costs and earn a fair return. Calculated as return on rate base plus operating expenses plus depreciation plus taxes.']
  sap_cost_center_code varchar [note: 'The SAP FI/CO cost center code associated with this rate base record, enabling linkage to the SAP ERP general ledger for financial reconciliation and cost-of-service allocation. Sourced from SAP Controlling (CO) module.']
  sap_wbs_element varchar [note: 'The SAP Project System Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) element code associated with capital projects contributing to this rate base record. Used to track CAPEX project costs from SAP PS module through to rate base inclusion.']
  service_territory_code varchar [note: 'Code identifying the geographic service territory or operating division to which this rate base record applies. Used for multi-territory utilities to allocate rate base components by service area for cost-of-service studies.']
  test_year varchar [note: 'The calendar or fiscal year used as the basis for the rate case cost-of-service study. The test year establishes the period for which rate base, revenues, and expenses are measured to determine revenue requirements in a General Rate Case (GRC) filing.']
  test_year_type varchar [note: 'Indicates whether the test year is based on historical actuals, a projected future period, or a hybrid combination of both. Regulatory commissions may require different test year types depending on jurisdiction rules.']
  total_rate_base_amt decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total regulatory asset base (RAB) amount, representing the net investment on which the utility is entitled to earn a return. Calculated as net utility plant plus CWIP plus working capital allowance plus regulatory assets minus regulatory liabilities minus ADIT minus customer deposits. Used as the basis for ROE and revenue requirement calculations in rate cases.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp when this rate base record was most recently modified, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Tracks the last update for data lineage, audit compliance, and change management in the Databricks Silver Layer.']
  utility_type varchar [note: 'Identifies whether the rate base record pertains to the electric utility operations, natural gas utility operations, or a combined electric and gas utility. Supports separate rate base tracking for electric and gas jurisdictions.']
  weighted_avg_cost_of_capital_rate decimal(8,4) [note: 'The overall weighted average cost of capital (WACC) approved or proposed for this rate base, blending the cost of debt and equity weighted by their respective proportions in the capital structure. Used to calculate the total return on rate base in revenue requirement studies.']
  working_capital_allowance_amt decimal(18,2) [note: 'Allowance for working capital included in the rate base, representing the utility\'s investment in cash and materials needed to operate between billing cycles. Typically calculated using the lead-lag method or a fixed percentage of operating expenses as approved by the PUC.']

  Note: 'Regulatory rate base (RAB) calculation records supporting GRC and rate case filings. Captures the components of rate base including net utility plant, working capital allowance, regulatory assets/liabilities, accumulated deferred income taxes (ADIT), and customer deposits. Tracks rate base by jurisdiction, rate class, and test year for PUC cost-of-service studies and ROE calculations.'
}

Table finance.cost_allocation {
  cost_allocation_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for each SAP CO cost allocation or assessment cycle record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for this data product.']
  portfolio_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to trading.trading_portfolio. Business justification: Enables Cost Allocation process to allocate costs directly to trading portfolios, required for portfolio profitability analysis.']
  primary_sender_cost_center_id varchar [note: 'Surrogate identifier referencing the cost center from which costs are being distributed (the sender/source in the SAP CO allocation). Typically represents corporate overhead, shared services, or common plant cost centers.']
  allocated_amount decimal(18,4) [note: 'The gross monetary amount of cost allocated from the sender to the receiver in the company code currency. This is the primary financial fact of the allocation record, used in cost-of-service studies, CAPEX/OPEX tracking, and FERC Form 1 reporting.']
  allocated_amount_usd decimal(18,4) [note: 'The allocated cost amount translated to US Dollars (USD) using the exchange rate applicable at the time of posting. Enables consistent cross-currency financial reporting and FERC Form 1 submissions which require USD denomination.']
  allocation_basis_type varchar [note: 'The method or driver used to determine the proportion of costs allocated to each receiver. Common bases include statistical key figures (e.g., kWh consumed), headcount, square footage, revenue, direct cost ratios, or fixed percentages. Critical for rate case cost-of-service justification. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: statistical_key_figure|headcount|square_footage|revenue|direct_cost|fixed_percentage|machine_hours|mwh_generated — promote to reference product]']
  allocation_basis_value decimal(18,6) [note: 'The numeric value of the allocation driver/basis for this receiver (e.g., 1,500 kWh, 45 headcount, 2,000 square feet). Used to verify the proportional split of costs and to support rate case cost-of-service documentation.']
  allocation_doc_number varchar [note: 'The externally-known SAP CO document number uniquely identifying the allocation posting (e.g., assessment cycle run document). Serves as the business identifier traceable back to the source system.']
  allocation_notes varchar [note: 'Free-text notes or comments entered by the cost accountant or financial analyst describing the rationale for the allocation, any manual adjustments, or regulatory compliance notes. Supports audit and rate case documentation.']
  allocation_percentage decimal(8,6) [note: 'The percentage of the sender cost center\'s total cost allocated to this specific receiver, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.125000 = 12.5%). Derived from the allocation basis but stored for audit and rate case transparency.']
  allocation_run_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when the SAP CO assessment or distribution cycle was executed to generate this allocation record. Distinguishes between multiple runs of the same cycle within a period (e.g., preliminary vs. final close runs).']
  allocation_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the allocation record. \'posted\' indicates the allocation has been finalized in SAP CO; \'reversed\' indicates a reversal document exists; \'simulated\' indicates a test run not yet posted; \'blocked\' indicates held for review; \'error\' indicates a processing failure.']
  allocation_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the SAP CO allocation method used: assessment (allocates cost using statistical key figures), distribution (reallocates primary costs), indirect activity allocation, manual reposting, or settlement from internal orders/WBS elements.']
  business_area_code varchar [note: 'SAP FI business area code representing the organizational segment (e.g., Electric Distribution, Gas Transmission, Corporate) to which the allocated cost belongs. Supports multi-jurisdictional cost separation required by state PUC filings.']
  capex_opex_indicator varchar [note: 'Indicates whether the allocated cost is classified as Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) or Operating Expenditure (OPEX). Critical for regulatory asset base (RAB) valuation, rate case cost-of-service studies, and FERC Form 1 reporting under FASB ASC 980.']
  company_code varchar [note: 'SAP FI company code identifying the legal entity within which the allocation is posted. Essential for inter-company cost allocation in multi-jurisdictional utility holding structures and for FERC Form 1 entity-level reporting.']
  controlling_area_code varchar [note: 'SAP CO controlling area code that defines the organizational scope of cost management. A single controlling area may span multiple company codes in a utility holding company structure.']
  cost_element_code varchar [note: 'SAP CO cost element code representing the nature of the cost being allocated (e.g., labor, depreciation, overhead). Maps to the GL account in SAP FI and is used for cost-of-service studies in rate cases.']
  cost_element_name varchar [note: 'Human-readable description of the SAP CO cost element (e.g., \'Salaries and Wages\', \'IT Infrastructure Depreciation\', \'Fleet O&M\'). Supports self-service reporting without requiring a join.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this cost allocation record was first captured in the SAP CO system. Used for audit trail and data lineage in the Silver Layer lakehouse.']
  currency_code varchar [note: 'ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the allocated_amount (e.g., \'USD\'). Supports multi-currency reporting for utilities operating across jurisdictions.']
  cycle_name varchar [note: 'Human-readable name of the SAP CO assessment or distribution cycle (e.g., \'Corporate Overhead Allocation\', \'Shared Services Assessment\', \'Common Plant Distribution\'). Supports reporting and audit without requiring a join.']
  document_date date [note: 'The date of the originating allocation document as recorded in SAP CO. May differ from posting_date when allocations are backdated or adjusted for prior periods.']
  fiscal_period varchar [note: 'The accounting period (1–12 for monthly, or 13–16 for special periods) within the fiscal year in which this allocation was posted. Aligns with SAP FI/CO period-end close cycles.']
  fiscal_year varchar [note: 'The fiscal year (e.g., 2024) in which this cost allocation was executed. Used for period-end close, annual CAPEX/OPEX reporting, and FERC Form 1 filing alignment.']
  functional_area_code varchar [note: 'SAP CO functional area code classifying the nature of the cost (e.g., production, administration, sales, R&D). Used for income statement reporting by function and FERC Form 1 functional classification of utility costs.']
  gl_account_code varchar [note: 'The SAP FI general ledger account code to which the allocated cost is posted. Aligns with the FERC Uniform System of Accounts (e.g., Account 920 for administrative and general salaries, Account 921 for office supplies). Critical for FERC Form 1 reporting.']
  intercompany_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this allocation crosses legal entity boundaries (True = inter-company allocation between affiliates in a utility holding company). Inter-company allocations require additional regulatory scrutiny under FERC affiliate transaction rules and state PUC standards.']
  jurisdiction_code varchar [note: 'Code identifying the regulatory jurisdiction (e.g., state abbreviation or FERC) to which the allocated cost is attributable. Critical for multi-jurisdictional utilities to separate costs for individual state PUC rate cases and FERC wholesale rate filings.']
  last_updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent modification to this cost allocation record, including reversals, corrections, or status changes. Supports incremental data loading and change tracking in the lakehouse.']
  posting_date date [note: 'The date on which the cost allocation was posted to the SAP CO ledger. This is the principal business event date used for period assignment and financial reporting.']
  rate_case_reference varchar [note: 'Reference number of the General Rate Case (GRC) or FERC rate proceeding for which this allocation is being tracked. Enables direct linkage of cost allocation records to specific regulatory filings and cost-of-service studies.']
  receiver_profit_center_code varchar [note: 'SAP CO profit center code receiving the allocated costs when receiver_type is \'profit_center\'. Used for segment-level profitability reporting and inter-company allocations in multi-jurisdictional utility structures.']
  receiver_type varchar [note: 'Discriminator indicating the type of SAP CO object receiving the allocated costs: cost_center (another cost center), profit_center (a profit center for segment reporting), wbs_element (a capital project WBS element for CAPEX tracking), or internal_order.']
  receiver_wbs_element_code varchar [note: 'SAP PS Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) element code receiving allocated costs when receiver_type is \'wbs_element\'. Used for CAPEX project cost tracking, regulatory asset base (RAB) valuation, and CPCN project accounting.']
  regulatory_asset_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the allocated cost contributes to a regulatory asset or liability as defined under FASB ASC 980 (Regulated Operations). True when the allocation feeds a deferred cost that is recoverable through future rates approved by the PUC or FERC.']
  reversal_date date [note: 'The date on which the reversal of this allocation was posted in SAP CO. Null when no reversal exists. Used for period-end close reconciliation and audit trail.']
  reversal_doc_number varchar [note: 'SAP CO document number of the reversal posting if this allocation has been reversed. Null when no reversal exists. Used for audit trail and period-end reconciliation.']
  run_type varchar [note: 'Indicates whether the allocation was executed against actual costs, planned/budget costs, or as a simulation. \'actual\' postings feed financial statements; \'plan\' allocations support budgeting and CAPEX/OPEX planning; \'simulation\' records are not posted to the ledger.']
  sender_total_cost decimal(18,4) [note: 'The total cost balance of the sender cost center prior to allocation for the fiscal period. Used to verify that the sum of all allocated_amount values equals the sender\'s total cost, ensuring full cost recovery in the allocation cycle.']
  utility_function varchar [note: 'Classifies the allocated cost by utility function per FERC Uniform System of Accounts: generation, transmission, distribution, gas distribution, common (shared across functions), or corporate. Directly supports cost-of-service studies and rate case filings.']

  Note: 'SAP CO cost allocation and assessment cycle records distributing shared costs (e.g., corporate overhead, shared services, common plant) from sender cost centers to receiver cost centers, profit centers, or WBS elements. Supports fully-allocated cost-of-service studies for rate cases and inter-company cost allocation for multi-jurisdictional utilities.'
}

Table finance.ap_invoice {
  ap_invoice_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for the accounts payable invoice record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for this entity.']
  bank_account_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the company bank account from which payment was disbursed. Corresponds to the SAP house bank and account ID (HBKID/HKTID) used in the F110 payment run. Supports bank reconciliation and treasury cash position management.']
  cost_center_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the SAP CO cost center (KOSTL) to which the invoice expenditure is allocated. Enables OPEX tracking by organizational unit, department, or functional area for rate case cost-of-service studies and internal management reporting.']
  facility_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to property.facility. Business justification: AP invoices for facility upgrades or maintenance need facility reference for cost allocation and audit.']
  gl_account_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the SAP FI general ledger account (HKONT/SAKNR) to which the invoice expense is posted. Determines FERC Uniform System of Accounts classification, CAPEX vs. OPEX treatment, and regulatory asset/liability designation under FASB ASC 980.']
  goods_receipt_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the SAP MM goods receipt document (MBLNR) confirming physical receipt of materials or services. Required for three-way match (PO/GR/IR) validation before invoice approval and payment release.']
  parcel_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to property.parcel. Business justification: AP invoices for property improvements must be tied to the parcel receiving the work for cost tracking and audit.']
  payment_run_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the SAP F110 Automatic Payment Program batch run (identified by run date + run ID) that processed this invoice for payment. Links the invoice to the batch disbursement execution record for bank reconciliation and payment audit trail.']
  purchase_order_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the originating SAP MM purchase order (EBELN) against which this invoice is matched. Supports three-way match validation (PO / Goods Receipt / Invoice Receipt) for procurement controls and CAPEX/OPEX authorization.']
  vendor_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the vendor (supplier) master record who issued this invoice. Corresponds to the SAP vendor account (LIFNR). Covers fuel suppliers, materials vendors, contractors, equipment providers, and employee expense reimbursement accounts.']
  wbs_element_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the SAP PS Work Breakdown Structure element (POSID) for capital project cost assignment. Used for CAPEX tracking, regulatory asset base (RAB) valuation, and plant-in-service accounting under FERC Uniform System of Accounts.']
  approval_status varchar [note: 'Current status of the invoice in the approval workflow (SAP FI workflow or external approval system). Tracks whether the invoice has been reviewed and approved by the designated cost center owner or project manager before payment release. Supports SOX internal control compliance.']
  approval_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when the invoice was approved for payment in the workflow system. Used for cycle time analysis (invoice receipt to approval), SLA monitoring, and SOX audit trail documentation.']
  approved_by varchar [note: 'The SAP user ID or employee identifier of the person who approved the invoice for payment. Provides audit trail for SOX compliance and internal control documentation. Null if invoice is pending approval or auto-approved within tolerance.']
  check_ach_reference varchar [note: 'The check number (for paper check payments) or ACH/EFT transaction reference number assigned by the bank or SAP payment program. Used for bank statement reconciliation, payment tracing, and stop-payment processing.']
  company_code varchar [note: 'The SAP FI company code (BUKRS) representing the legal entity or regulated utility subsidiary that owns this invoice. Supports multi-entity financial consolidation, separate regulatory filings per utility operating company, and FERC jurisdictional reporting.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp when this AP invoice record was first created in the source system (SAP FI). Provides the audit trail creation marker for data lineage, SOX compliance, and Silver Layer ingestion tracking.']
  currency_code varchar [note: 'ISO 4217 three-letter currency code of the invoice (WAERS in SAP). Typically USD for domestic utility operations but may be foreign currency for international equipment purchases, PPA agreements with foreign counterparties, or LNG fuel procurement contracts.']
  discount_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The cash discount amount available if payment is made within the early payment discount period (SKFBT in SAP). Supports working capital optimization by identifying invoices eligible for early payment discounts (e.g., 2/10 net 30 terms).']
  discount_due_date date [note: 'The last date by which payment must be made to qualify for the early payment cash discount (SKFDT in SAP). Used by treasury to prioritize payments and capture available discounts for working capital optimization.']
  due_date date [note: 'The date by which payment must be made to the vendor to avoid late payment penalties (FAEDT in SAP). Calculated from the invoice date and payment terms. Critical for cash flow management, AP aging analysis, and avoiding late payment interest charges.']
  exchange_rate decimal(12,6) [note: 'The exchange rate applied to convert the invoice currency to the company\'s functional currency (USD) at the time of posting (KURSF in SAP). Applicable for foreign currency invoices (e.g., international equipment, LNG procurement). Null for USD-denominated invoices.']
  expenditure_category varchar [note: 'Designates whether the invoice expenditure is capitalized (CAPEX — added to the regulatory asset base and plant-in-service) or expensed (OPEX — charged to the income statement in the current period). Critical for rate case cost-of-service studies, RAB valuation, and FERC Form 1 reporting.']
  ferc_account_code varchar [note: 'The FERC Uniform System of Accounts (USOA) account code to which this invoice expenditure is classified (e.g., Account 501 for fuel, Account 920 for administrative salaries, Account 107 for construction work in progress). Mandatory for FERC Form 1 annual report filing and rate case cost-of-service studies.']
  fiscal_period varchar [note: 'The accounting period (MONAT, 1–16 including special periods) within the fiscal year in which the invoice is posted in SAP FI. Used for monthly close, period-end accruals, and regulatory reporting.']
  fiscal_year varchar [note: 'The fiscal year (GJAHR) in which this invoice is recorded in SAP FI. Used for annual financial reporting, FERC Form 1 submissions, rate case cost-of-service studies, and CAPEX/OPEX budget tracking.']
  gross_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The total gross amount of the invoice before tax deductions or discounts, as stated on the vendor\'s invoice (WRBTR in SAP). Represents the base amount for payment terms calculation, CAPEX/OPEX budget consumption, and cash flow planning.']
  invoice_description varchar [note: 'Free-text description of the goods or services invoiced, as entered in the SAP invoice header text (SGTXT). Provides context for the expenditure, supports spend analytics, and aids in dispute resolution and audit inquiries.']
  invoice_number varchar [note: 'The externally-assigned invoice document number as provided by the vendor or generated by SAP FI (BELNR field). Serves as the primary business identifier for cross-referencing with vendor remittance and payment advice documents.']
  invoice_receipt_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when the vendor invoice was received and entered into SAP (CPUDT/CPUTM in RBKP). Marks the start of the AP invoice lifecycle. Used for cycle time measurement (receipt to payment), early payment discount eligibility, and accrual management.']
  invoice_status varchar [note: 'Current workflow state of the AP invoice through its full lifecycle: received (entered into SAP), under_review (three-way match or approval in progress), approved (cleared for payment), blocked (payment block set — e.g., price variance, quantity discrepancy), paid (payment executed), cancelled (voided). Drives AP aging, cash flow forecasting, and audit trails.']
  invoice_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the invoice document type in SAP FI (BLART). Distinguishes standard vendor invoices, credit memos (vendor returns/adjustments), debit memos, recurring invoices (e.g., lease payments), prepayments, and employee expense reimbursements. Drives accounting treatment and payment processing logic.']
  is_intercompany boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this invoice represents a transaction between two legal entities within the same utility holding company group (e.g., shared services charges, intercompany fuel transfers, corporate allocations). True = intercompany invoice requiring elimination in consolidated financial statements.']
  is_recurring boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this invoice is part of a recurring payment schedule (e.g., monthly lease payments, standing purchase orders for O&M services, recurring software subscriptions). True = recurring invoice generated from an SAP recurring document template. Supports cash flow forecasting and accrual automation.']
  last_updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp of the most recent modification to this AP invoice record in the source system. Tracks changes such as payment block updates, approval status changes, or payment clearing. Used for incremental data pipeline processing and audit trail.']
  net_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The net payable amount after tax and any applicable discounts (gross_amount minus discounts, plus tax where applicable). Represents the actual cash outflow obligation to the vendor. Used for payment execution, cash flow management, and bank reconciliation.']
  payment_block_code varchar [note: 'SAP payment block indicator (ZLSPR) that prevents the invoice from being selected in the automatic payment program run. Common block reasons: price variance exceeds tolerance, quantity discrepancy, missing goods receipt, manual hold pending approval, disputed invoice. Null if no block is set. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: price_variance|quantity_discrepancy|missing_gr|manual_hold|disputed|duplicate_check — promote to reference product]']
  payment_date date [note: 'The date on which payment was executed and the invoice was cleared in SAP FI (AUGDT). Used for cash flow reporting, bank reconciliation, days payable outstanding (DPO) calculation, and FERC Form 1 cash disbursement reporting.']
  payment_document_number varchar [note: 'The SAP FI accounting document number generated upon payment execution (clearing document AUGBL). Used to link the open AP invoice item to its clearing payment entry in the general ledger for bank reconciliation and audit trail.']
  payment_method varchar [note: 'The method used to disburse payment to the vendor (ZLSCH in SAP Automatic Payment Program): ACH (Automated Clearing House electronic transfer), check (paper check), wire (domestic/international wire transfer), virtual_card (single-use virtual procurement card), eft (electronic funds transfer). Drives bank reconciliation and payment run configuration.']
  payment_terms_code varchar [note: 'The SAP payment terms key (ZTERM) defining the payment due date calculation, early payment discount periods, and installment schedules (e.g., NT30 = net 30 days, 2/10NT30 = 2% discount if paid within 10 days, net 30). Drives due date calculation and cash flow forecasting.']
  posting_date date [note: 'The date on which the invoice was posted to the SAP general ledger (BUDAT). Determines the fiscal period and year for CAPEX/OPEX recognition, regulatory asset accounting under FASB ASC 980, and FERC Form 1 period reporting.']
  procurement_category varchar [note: 'Business category of goods or services procured, aligned to the utility\'s spend taxonomy: fuel procurement (coal, gas, nuclear fuel), T&D materials, contractor/construction services, equipment purchases, IT services, professional services, O&M supplies, etc. Supports spend analytics, supplier management, and regulatory cost allocation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: fuel|materials|contractor_services|equipment|it_services|professional_services|om_supplies|employee_expense — promote to reference product]']
  sap_document_number varchar [note: 'The internal SAP FI accounting document number (BELNR) assigned upon invoice posting in the general ledger. Used for reconciliation between the AP subledger and the general ledger in SAP FI/CO.']
  tax_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The total tax amount (sales tax, use tax, VAT) calculated on the invoice (WMWST in SAP). Tracked separately for tax compliance reporting, recoverable vs. non-recoverable tax treatment, and regulatory cost allocation in rate cases.']
