  tax_code varchar [note: 'The SAP tax code (MWSKZ) applied to the invoice for sales/use tax calculation. Determines the applicable tax rate, tax jurisdiction, and whether the tax is recoverable or non-recoverable. Relevant for state and local tax compliance in utility operations.']
  three_way_match_status varchar [note: 'Result of the three-way match validation between the Purchase Order (PO), Goods Receipt (GR), and Invoice Receipt (IR) in SAP MM/FI. Indicates whether the invoice quantity and price align within tolerance to the PO and GR. Drives automatic payment release or block assignment. \'not_applicable\' for non-PO invoices (e.g., utilities, rent, employee expenses).']
  vendor_invoice_date date [note: 'The date printed on the vendor\'s invoice document (BLDAT in SAP). Represents the principal real-world business event date — when the vendor issued the invoice. Used for payment terms calculation and aging analysis.']

  Note: 'Accounts payable full lifecycle record covering vendor invoice receipt, validation (three-way match with PO/GR/IR), approval, payment execution, and batch payment run processing. Tracks invoice details (vendor, amount, tax, payment terms, due date), payment processing (payment method, payment date, bank account, check/ACH reference, batch payment run parameters), and settlement status. Covers fuel procurement, materials, contractor services, equipment purchases, and employee expense reimbursements. Includes automatic payment program run records for batch disbursement execution. Supports OPEX/CAPEX expenditure tracking, cash flow management, and bank reconciliation.'
}

Table finance.ar_transaction {
  ar_transaction_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for each accounts receivable transaction record in the finance domain. Primary key for the ar_transaction data product.']
  contract_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the underlying commercial contract, Power Purchase Agreement (PPA), transmission service agreement, or inter-company agreement that governs this AR transaction. Links to the contract master for terms and pricing validation.']
  cost_center_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the SAP CO cost center responsible for the revenue stream associated with this AR transaction. Used for internal cost-of-service allocation and rate case studies.']
  counterparty_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the counterparty (customer, wholesale buyer, inter-company entity, or transmission service customer) that owes the receivable. Maps to the SAP FI-AR customer account (KUNNR) for non-retail revenue streams including wholesale energy, REC sales, and FERC-jurisdictional wheeling charges.']
  facility_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to property.facility. Business justification: Revenue from customers served by a specific facility is tracked per facility for performance reporting.']
  gl_account_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the general ledger account to which this AR transaction is posted. Determines the revenue or receivable classification in the chart of accounts for FERC Form 1 reporting and FASB ASC 980 regulatory accounting.']
  parcel_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to property.parcel. Business justification: Revenue transactions are associated with service parcels to support revenue analysis and rate‑case filings.']
  adjustment_amount decimal(18,4) [note: 'Net value of credits, discounts, or billing corrections applied to this AR transaction after initial invoicing. Negative values represent credits issued to the counterparty; positive values represent additional charges. Supports dispute resolution and revenue true-up processes.']
  aging_bucket varchar [note: 'Aging classification of the outstanding AR balance based on the number of days past the due date. Used for bad debt provisioning, collection prioritization, and AR aging reports required for FERC Form 1 and internal financial reporting.']
  business_unit_code varchar [note: 'SAP organizational unit code identifying the business unit (e.g., Electric Transmission, Gas Distribution, Generation) responsible for the revenue stream associated with this AR transaction. Used for segment reporting and FERC Form 1 functional classification.']
  clearing_document_number varchar [note: 'SAP FI-AR clearing document number assigned when this AR transaction is fully or partially settled against an incoming payment. Enables reconciliation between the AR open item and the corresponding bank receipt or inter-company settlement.']
  contract_reference_number varchar [note: 'External contract or agreement reference number (e.g., PPA number, transmission service agreement number, FERC tariff rate schedule reference) associated with this AR transaction. Used for counterparty reconciliation without requiring a join to the contract master.']
  counterparty_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the counterparty category for this AR transaction. Distinguishes wholesale energy buyers, inter-company entities, RTO/ISO settlement parties, transmission service customers, REC buyers, and miscellaneous non-retail receivables. Drives reporting segmentation for FERC Form 1 and rate case cost-of-service studies.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this AR transaction record was first created in the system of record (SAP FI-AR). Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.']
  currency_code varchar [note: 'ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this AR transaction (e.g., USD for US Dollar). Supports multi-currency reporting for cross-border wholesale energy transactions and PPA settlements.']
  days_past_due varchar [note: 'Number of calendar days elapsed since the payment due date for overdue AR transactions. Zero or negative values indicate the transaction is current. Used for collection escalation triggers and bad debt reserve calculations.']
  dispute_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the counterparty has formally disputed this AR transaction. True = active dispute in progress; False = no dispute. Triggers dispute management workflow and suspends dunning activity in SAP FI-AR.']
  dispute_reason varchar [note: 'Categorized reason code for the counterparty dispute on this AR transaction. Used for dispute root cause analysis and resolution tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: billing_error|quantity_dispute|price_dispute|service_not_rendered|contract_terms|duplicate_invoice|other — promote to reference product]']
  due_date date [note: 'Contractual date by which the counterparty is required to remit payment for this AR transaction. Basis for aging bucket assignment, overdue status determination, and late payment interest calculations per contract terms.']
  dunning_date date [note: 'Date on which the most recent dunning (collection notice) was issued to the counterparty for this AR transaction. Used to enforce dunning intervals and track collection activity history.']
  dunning_level varchar [note: 'Current dunning (collection notice) level assigned to this AR transaction in SAP FI-AR, ranging from 0 (no dunning) to the maximum configured level. Higher levels indicate escalating collection actions. Used to track collection effort intensity.']
  energy_volume_mwh decimal(18,4) [note: 'Quantity of electrical energy in Megawatt-Hours (MWh) associated with this AR transaction for wholesale energy sales, RTO/ISO settlements, or PPA deliveries. Null for non-energy revenue streams such as REC sales or inter-company charges.']
  ferc_account_code varchar [note: 'FERC Uniform System of Accounts code applicable to this AR transaction for regulatory financial reporting. Required for FERC Form 1 electric and gas revenue classification (e.g., Account 440 – Sales of Electricity, Account 456 – Other Electric Revenues).']
  fiscal_period varchar [note: 'Fiscal accounting period (1–12 for monthly, or 1–4 for quarterly) within the fiscal year in which this AR transaction is posted. Aligns with SAP FI posting period (MONAT) for period-end close and regulatory reporting.']
  fiscal_year varchar [note: 'Fiscal year in which this AR transaction is recognized for financial reporting purposes. Used for period-end close, FERC Form 1 annual reporting, and EBITDA analysis. Aligns with the SAP FI posting period (GJAHR).']
  intercompany_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this AR transaction represents an inter-company charge between affiliated entities within the utility holding company structure. True = inter-company; False = third-party. Required for inter-company elimination in consolidated financial statements.']
  invoice_amount decimal(18,4) [note: 'Gross billed amount on the AR invoice before any adjustments, credits, or taxes. Represents the total amount owed by the counterparty at the time of invoice issuance. Denominated in the currency specified by currency_code.']
  invoice_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known invoice document number assigned to this AR transaction, used for counterparty reconciliation and audit trail. Corresponds to the SAP FI-AR document number (BELNR) for non-retail receivables such as wholesale energy sales, FERC wheeling charges, and inter-company settlements.']
  lmp_price decimal(18,6) [note: 'Locational Marginal Price (LMP) in $/MWh used to value wholesale energy transactions settled through the RTO/ISO Day-Ahead Market (DAM) or Real-Time Market (RTM). Sourced from the applicable RTO/ISO settlement statement.']
  net_amount decimal(18,4) [note: 'Net receivable amount after applying all adjustments and taxes to the invoice amount (invoice_amount + tax_amount + adjustment_amount). Represents the actual amount expected to be collected from the counterparty. Used for aging analysis and collection reporting.']
  outstanding_balance decimal(18,4) [note: 'Remaining unpaid balance on this AR transaction (net_amount minus paid_amount). Represents the current exposure for collection management and bad debt provisioning. Refreshed upon each payment or adjustment posting.']
  paid_amount decimal(18,4) [note: 'Cumulative amount received from the counterparty against this AR transaction to date. Used to calculate the outstanding balance and determine partial payment status. Updated upon each payment posting in SAP FI-AR.']
  payment_date date [note: 'Date on which full or final payment was received and posted for this AR transaction. Null if the transaction remains open or partially paid. Used for cash flow reporting and days sales outstanding (DSO) analysis.']
  payment_terms_code varchar [note: 'SAP payment terms key (e.g., NT30, NT45, NT60) defining the contractual payment schedule, discount periods, and due date calculation rules for this AR transaction. Drives automated due date computation in SAP FI-AR.']
  rate_case_reference varchar [note: 'Reference to the applicable General Rate Case (GRC) or FERC rate case docket number under which the revenue rate for this AR transaction was authorized. Used for cost-of-service study support and regulatory compliance documentation.']
  rec_quantity decimal(18,4) [note: 'Number of Renewable Energy Certificates (RECs) sold and invoiced in this AR transaction. One REC represents one MWh of electricity generated from a qualifying renewable source. Applicable only to REC sales revenue streams.']
  regulatory_asset_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this AR transaction is associated with a FERC or state PUC-approved regulatory asset or deferred revenue mechanism under FASB ASC 980. True = subject to regulatory accounting treatment; False = standard commercial receivable.']
  revenue_category varchar [note: 'Business classification of the revenue type driving this AR transaction. Supports segmented revenue reporting for FERC Form 1, rate case cost-of-service studies, and EBITDA analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: wholesale_energy_sales|transmission_wheeling|rec_sales|intercompany_charge|ppa_settlement|ancillary_services|miscellaneous — promote to reference product]']
  service_period_end date [note: 'End date of the billing period or service delivery period covered by this AR transaction. Paired with service_period_start to define the revenue recognition window under FASB ASC 606.']
  service_period_start date [note: 'Start date of the billing period or service delivery period covered by this AR transaction. For wholesale energy sales, this is the start of the energy delivery interval. For transmission wheeling, it is the start of the reservation period. Required for revenue recognition under FASB ASC 606.']
  tax_amount decimal(18,4) [note: 'Total tax charges applied to this AR transaction, including applicable state and federal taxes on wholesale energy sales or transmission services. Part of the monetary triplet supporting net amount calculation.']
  transaction_date date [note: 'The principal business event date on which the AR transaction was originated — i.e., the date the revenue was earned or the invoice was issued. Used as the basis for aging calculations and revenue recognition under FASB ASC 606.']
  transaction_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the AR transaction indicating collection progress. Open = unpaid and within terms; partially_paid = partial payment received; paid = fully settled; overdue = past due date; disputed = counterparty has raised a formal dispute; written_off = deemed uncollectible and removed from active AR.']
  transmission_zone varchar [note: 'RTO/ISO transmission pricing zone or load zone associated with this AR transaction for wheeling charges and transmission service revenues. Used for FERC-jurisdictional revenue allocation and FERC Form 1 reporting.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent modification to this AR transaction record, including status changes, payment postings, dispute updates, or write-off actions. Supports change data capture in the Databricks Silver layer.']
  write_off_amount decimal(18,4) [note: 'Amount written off as uncollectible for this AR transaction. May be less than the full outstanding balance if a partial write-off was applied. Used for bad debt reserve reconciliation and FERC Form 1 reporting.']
  write_off_date date [note: 'Date on which this AR transaction was written off as uncollectible and the bad debt expense was recognized. Null if the transaction has not been written off. Required for FASB ASC 310 impairment disclosure.']
  write_off_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this AR transaction has been written off as uncollectible. True = written off and removed from active AR; False = still active. Triggers bad debt expense recognition under FASB ASC 310-10.']

  Note: 'Accounts receivable transaction records for non-retail-billing receivables including inter-company charges, wholesale energy sales settlements, REC sales proceeds, transmission service revenues, FERC-jurisdictional wheeling charges, and miscellaneous revenue. Tracks counterparty, invoice amount, due date, collection status, aging bucket, and write-off history. Complements the billing domain\'s customer AR for non-retail revenue streams.'
}

Table finance.payment_run {
  payment_run_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for each SAP FI automatic payment program run record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for this entity.']
  approved_by_user_employee_id varchar [note: 'SAP user ID of the supervisor or treasury manager who approved the payment proposal before posting. Enforces dual-control requirements for disbursements above threshold amounts per internal controls policy.']
  bank_account_id varchar [note: 'SAP FI bank account identifier (account ID within the house bank) from which disbursements are made. Identifies the specific checking or disbursement account used for this payment run. Classified confidential due to financial account sensitivity.']
  cost_center_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the primary SAP CO cost center associated with this payment run, used for OPEX allocation and cost-of-service studies. Relevant for payment runs covering operational expenditures such as fuel procurement, O&M vendor payments, and workforce expenses.']
  employee_id varchar [note: 'SAP user ID of the AP/treasury staff member who initiated (scheduled or executed) the payment run in SAP F110. Required for segregation-of-duties controls and SOX audit trail.']
  gl_account_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the primary GL clearing account used for this payment run\'s disbursements (e.g., bank clearing account, outgoing payment account). Supports general ledger reconciliation and FERC account mapping.']
  house_bank_bank_account_id varchar [note: 'SAP FI house bank identifier representing the utility\'s internal bank master record from which payments are disbursed. Links to the specific bank account used for this payment run, supporting bank reconciliation and cash position reporting.']

  reversed_run_payment_run_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the original payment_run_id that this run reverses, if reversal_flag is True. Enables traceability between reversal runs and their originating payment runs for audit and reconciliation purposes.']
  approval_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when the payment proposal was approved by the authorized approver. Supports segregation-of-duties audit trail and turnaround time analysis for AP processing efficiency.']
  bank_account_number_masked varchar [note: 'Masked representation of the utility\'s disbursement bank account number, showing only the last four digits for identification and reconciliation purposes without exposing the full account number. Used in audit reports and bank reconciliation statements.']
  bank_file_generated_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the payment medium file (e.g., ACH NACHA file, SWIFT MT103, check print file) was successfully generated and transmitted to the bank for this payment run. False indicates a file generation failure requiring investigation.']
  bank_file_transmission_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when the payment medium file was transmitted to the bank or payment processor. Used for bank reconciliation cutoff determination and exception investigation when payments are not reflected in bank statements.']
  bank_routing_number varchar [note: 'American Bankers Association (ABA) routing transit number of the utility\'s disbursement bank. Required for ACH and wire payment file generation and bank reconciliation. Nine-digit numeric code.']
  capex_opex_indicator varchar [note: 'Indicates whether the disbursements in this payment run are classified as capital expenditures (CAPEX), operating expenditures (OPEX), or a mix of both. Critical for regulatory asset base (RAB) valuation, rate case cost-of-service studies, and FERC Form 1 plant account reporting.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this payment run record was first captured in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and record management.']
  currency_code varchar [note: 'ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this payment run (e.g., \'USD\'). Utility operations are predominantly USD; this field supports multi-currency scenarios for cross-border energy trading settlements or foreign vendor payments.']
  discount_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total cash discount amount captured across all payment documents in this run, representing early payment discounts (e.g., 2/10 net 30 terms) taken from vendor invoices. Reduces the net payment amount and is posted to a discount revenue GL account.']
  docs_entered_up_to_date date [note: 'SAP F110 parameter specifying the latest document entry date for invoices to be considered in this payment run. Ensures only invoices entered into SAP by this cutoff date are included, supporting period-close controls.']
  document_count varchar [note: 'Total number of individual payment documents (FI payment postings) generated by this payment run. Each document represents a payment to a single vendor or employee. Used for run validation, exception monitoring, and audit completeness checks.']
  exception_count varchar [note: 'Number of vendor invoices or payment items that were excluded from this payment run due to exceptions (e.g., payment block, missing bank details, duplicate invoice flag, credit hold). Drives AP exception resolution workflow.']
  ferc_account_code varchar [note: 'FERC Uniform System of Accounts code associated with the primary expenditure category of this payment run (e.g., Account 920 for administrative salaries, Account 151 for fuel stock). Supports FERC Form 1 regulatory reporting and rate case cost allocation.']
  fiscal_period varchar [note: 'SAP FI fiscal period (1–12 for monthly, or 1–13 for 13-period calendars) within the fiscal year in which this payment run is posted. Supports period-close cash disbursement reporting and budget-to-actual variance analysis.']
  fiscal_year varchar [note: 'SAP FI fiscal year in which this payment run\'s disbursements are recorded. Used for annual financial reporting, FERC Form 1 filing, and CAPEX/OPEX budget variance analysis.']
  gross_payment_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total gross disbursement amount for all payment documents included in this payment run before application of discounts or deductions. Represents the sum of all vendor invoice and expense reimbursement amounts selected for payment. Used for cash flow forecasting and bank reconciliation.']
  invoice_count varchar [note: 'Total number of vendor invoices and expense reimbursement line items cleared (paid) by this payment run. A single payment document may clear multiple invoices; this count reflects the total open items settled.']
  last_updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent modification to this payment run record in the Silver Layer. Tracks status changes, corrections, and reversals for audit and data quality monitoring.']
  net_payment_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Net total amount actually disbursed in this payment run after deducting cash discounts and other adjustments from the gross payment amount. This is the actual cash outflow recorded in the treasury cash position and bank statement.']
  next_payment_date date [note: 'The \'next payment date\' parameter used in the SAP F110 payment proposal to determine which open invoices are due for payment. Invoices with a due date on or before this date are selected for inclusion in the run.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text notes entered by the AP/treasury team describing special circumstances, exceptions, or instructions for this payment run (e.g., \'Emergency payment for critical grid equipment supplier\', \'Held pending PO approval\'). Supports operational communication and audit documentation.']
  paying_company_code varchar [note: 'SAP FI company code of the legal entity initiating the payment run. For a utility with multiple regulated subsidiaries (electric vs. gas), this identifies which legal entity\'s bank account and chart of accounts are used. Aligns with FERC jurisdictional entity reporting.']
  payment_method_code varchar [note: 'SAP FI payment method code indicating the instrument used to disburse funds (e.g., ACH for Automated Clearing House, CHECK for paper check, WIRE for wire transfer, EFT for electronic funds transfer). Drives bank file format generation and clearing account determination.']
  payment_posted_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when the payment documents were posted in SAP FI, creating the actual accounting entries and clearing the open vendor items. This is the principal business event timestamp for the payment run lifecycle.']
  payment_program_variant varchar [note: 'SAP FI F110 program variant name that defines the selection parameters for this payment run (e.g., company codes, payment methods, next payment date, vendor selection criteria). Stored for audit traceability and run reproducibility.']
  payment_run_category varchar [note: 'Business category of the payables being settled in this run. Distinguishes vendor invoice payments (CAPEX/OPEX procurement), employee expense reimbursements, intercompany settlements, tax remittances, and regulatory fee payments (e.g., FERC filing fees, PUC assessments).']
  payment_run_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the payment run by its business purpose. \'regular\' denotes scheduled weekly/bi-weekly AP runs; \'off_cycle\' denotes ad-hoc runs outside the standard schedule; \'emergency\' denotes urgent disbursements; \'reversal\' denotes runs created to reverse prior payments.']
  posting_date date [note: 'SAP FI accounting posting date for the payment documents generated by this run. Determines the fiscal period in which the cash disbursement is recorded in the general ledger. May differ from run_date for period-end processing.']
  proposal_created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when the SAP F110 payment proposal was generated. The proposal lists all invoices selected for payment before final posting. Supports audit trail and approval workflow timing.']
  reversal_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this payment run has been reversed (voided) in SAP FI. A reversal cancels the original payment postings and reopens the cleared vendor invoices. Critical for bank reconciliation and fraud detection.']
  run_date date [note: 'The calendar date on which the SAP FI automatic payment program (F110) was executed. This is the principal business event date used for treasury cash management, bank reconciliation, and period-close reporting.']
  run_identification_key varchar [note: 'SAP FI run identification key (Identification field in F110) that, together with run_date, uniquely identifies the payment run within SAP. Typically a short alphanumeric code assigned by the AP/treasury team (e.g., \'AP01\', \'WIRE1\').']
  run_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known SAP FI payment run identifier, typically composed of the run date and run identification key (e.g., \'20240115-AP01\'). Used for cross-system reconciliation and audit trail references.']
  run_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the payment run, tracking progression from scheduling through proposal creation, approval, posting, and completion. Supports treasury workflow monitoring and exception management. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: scheduled|proposal_created|proposal_approved|payment_posted|payment_completed|cancelled|error — promote to reference product]']
  utility_type varchar [note: 'Identifies whether this payment run relates to the electric utility operations, gas utility operations, or combined operations. Supports jurisdictional cost separation required for separate electric and gas rate cases filed with state PUCs and FERC.']
  value_date date [note: 'Bank value date (settlement date) on which funds are expected to be debited from the utility\'s bank account. Used for cash position management and bank reconciliation. For ACH, typically one business day after run_date; for wire, same day.']
  vendor_count varchar [note: 'Number of distinct vendors (and/or employees for expense reimbursements) included in this payment run. Used for payment run sizing analysis, bank file validation, and AP workload reporting.']

  Note: 'SAP FI automatic payment program run records capturing batch payment executions for vendor invoices and employee expense reimbursements. Tracks payment run date, payment method (ACH, check, wire), total payment amount, bank account, and individual payment documents generated. Supports treasury cash management and bank reconciliation.'
}

  jurisdiction_code varchar [note: 'Code identifying the regulatory jurisdiction under which this statement is filed (e.g., FERC for federal, or state abbreviation such as CA, TX, NY for state PUC filings).   operating_cash_flow_amt decimal(18,2) [note: 'Net cash provided by (used in) operating activities as reported on the statement of cash flows. Reflects the utility\'s ability to generate cash from core operations to fund capital investment and debt service.']
  period_end_date date [note: 'The last calendar date of the reporting period covered by this financial statement (e.g., 2024-12-31 for an annual statement). For balance sheets, this is the as-of date for all reported balances.']
  period_start_date date [note: 'The first calendar date of the reporting period covered by this financial statement (e.g., 2024-01-01 for an annual statement). Used to define the precise time window for income statement and cash flow statement line items.']
  period_type varchar [note: 'Specifies the duration and aggregation type of the reporting period covered by this statement. Distinguishes between periodic snapshots (monthly, quarterly, annual) and cumulative views (year-to-date, trailing twelve months) used in management reporting.']
  prepared_by varchar [note: 'Name or employee ID of the financial analyst or accountant who prepared this financial statement. Supports audit trail and SOX internal control documentation requirements.']
  rate_case_docket_number varchar [note: 'The regulatory docket or case number assigned by the PUC or FERC to the rate case proceeding for which this financial statement serves as supporting evidence.   regulatory_assets_amt decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total regulatory assets recognized on the balance sheet under FASB ASC 980 rate-regulated accounting. Represents costs deferred for future recovery in rates (e.g., deferred storm costs, pension regulatory assets, unamortized debt issuance costs). Key component of the Regulatory Asset Base (RAB).']
  regulatory_liabilities_amt decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total regulatory liabilities recognized on the balance sheet under FASB ASC 980, representing amounts collected in rates that are owed back to customers (e.g., excess deferred income taxes from Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, over-collected fuel costs). Offsets rate base in regulatory proceedings.']
  reporting_basis varchar [note: 'Indicates the accounting basis under which the statement is prepared. GAAP = U.S. Generally Accepted Accounting Principles; regulatory = rate-regulated basis per FASB ASC 980 (includes regulatory assets/liabilities); IFRS = International Financial Reporting Standards; management = internal management reporting basis. Critical for distinguishing FERC regulatory filings from SEC GAAP filings.']
  reporting_unit varchar [note: 'Specifies the unit in which monetary amounts are expressed in this statement (e.g., dollars, thousands, millions). FERC Form 1 requires reporting in thousands of dollars; SEC filings may use millions. Prevents misinterpretation of reported figures.']
  restatement_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this financial statement is a restatement of a previously filed statement (True) due to a material error correction or accounting change. Triggers additional disclosure requirements under FASB ASC 250 and SEC restatement reporting rules.']
  restatement_reason varchar [note: 'Narrative description of the reason for restatement when restatement_flag is True (e.g., correction of regulatory asset classification error, change in depreciation method, prior period adjustment). Required for FASB ASC 250 disclosure and SEC restatement filings. Null when restatement_flag is False.']
  reviewed_by varchar [note: 'Name or employee ID of the controller, CFO, or designated reviewer who reviewed and approved this financial statement. Required for SOX Section 302 CEO/CFO certification and internal control documentation.']
  sap_company_code varchar [note: 'The SAP FI/CO company code corresponding to the legal entity for which this financial statement is prepared. Enables direct traceability from the lakehouse silver layer back to the SAP general ledger source system.']
  statement_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known business identifier for the financial statement, typically assigned by the financial reporting system (e.g., SAP FI document number or reporting package reference). Used for traceability across reporting cycles.']
  statement_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the financial statement. Draft = in preparation; under_review = submitted for internal review; approved = signed off by management/board; filed = submitted to regulatory body (FERC, PUC, SEC); restated = previously filed statement that has been corrected; superseded = replaced by a newer version.']
  statement_type varchar [note: 'Classifies the financial statement as one of the four primary financial statement types: balance sheet (statement of financial position), income statement (statement of operations), statement of cash flows, or statement of changes in equity. Drives downstream report formatting and validation rules.']
  total_assets_amt decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total assets as reported on the balance sheet for this entity and period. Represents the sum of all utility plant (net), current assets, regulatory assets, and other assets. Key metric for Regulatory Asset Base (RAB) valuation and rate case filings.']
  total_equity_amt decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total shareholders equity (common equity plus preferred equity) as reported on the balance sheet. Used in Return on Equity (ROE) calculations for rate case filings and board financial reporting.']
  total_liabilities_amt decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total liabilities as reported on the balance sheet, including long-term debt, current liabilities, regulatory liabilities, deferred income taxes (ADIT), and other obligations. Used in capital structure analysis for rate case ROE and WACC calculations.']
  total_opex_amt decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total operating and maintenance (O&M) expenses as reported on the income statement, including fuel costs, purchased power, transmission, distribution, customer service, and administrative expenses. Key input for OPEX tracking and rate case cost-of-service studies.']
  total_revenue_amt decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total operating revenues as reported on the income statement, including electric revenues, gas revenues, and other operating revenues. Primary top-line metric for EBITDA reporting, rate case revenue requirement studies, and FERC Form 1 Schedule of Revenues.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp when this financial statement record was last modified in the lakehouse silver layer. Tracks revisions during the review and approval workflow and supports incremental data pipeline processing.']
  utility_plant_net_amt decimal(18,2) [note: 'Net utility plant in service (gross plant less accumulated depreciation) as reported on the balance sheet. The largest asset category for a regulated utility and the primary driver of the Regulatory Asset Base (RAB) and rate base calculations.']
  utility_type varchar [note: 'Identifies the utility service type covered by this financial statement: electric, gas, combined electric and gas, or other. Supports FERC Form 1 (electric) vs. FERC Form 2 (gas) filing segregation and state PUC rate case cost-of-service studies by utility segment.']

  Note: 'Periodic financial statement records (balance sheet, income statement, statement of cash flows) prepared for internal management reporting, board reporting, SEC filings, and regulatory submissions including FERC Form 1 and state PUC annual reports. Captures statement type, reporting period, entity/segment, and GAAP vs. regulatory basis indicators.'
}

Table finance.tax_provision {
  tax_provision_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for each income tax provision record in the lakehouse Silver layer. Primary key for the tax_provision data product.']
  gl_account_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Tax Provision references GL Account for tax calculations; FK replaces code.']
  adit_beginning_balance_amt decimal(18,2) [note: 'Opening balance of accumulated deferred income taxes (ADIT) for the period. ADIT is a regulatory liability/asset on the rate base that offsets the utility\'s rate base per PUC orders. Critical for rate case revenue requirement and FERC Form 1 reporting.']
  adit_ending_balance_amt decimal(18,2) [note: 'Closing balance of accumulated deferred income taxes (ADIT) for the period after current-period deferred tax expense/benefit and ARAM amortization. Used directly in rate base calculations as a rate base offset per PUC-ordered treatment.']
  approved_by varchar [note: 'Name or employee ID of the tax department manager or controller who approved this tax provision record. Required for SOX Section 404 internal control documentation and audit trail.']
  approved_date date [note: 'The date on which the tax provision record received final approval from the authorized approver. Part of the SOX-compliant review and approval workflow for income tax accounting.']
  aram_amortization_amt decimal(18,2) [note: 'The period amortization of excess ADIT under the Average Rate Assumption Method (ARAM) as required by IRS normalization rules and FERC Order 849. Represents the amount of excess ADIT returned to customers through rate reductions in the current period.']
  bonus_depreciation_amt decimal(18,2) [note: 'Additional first-year bonus depreciation claimed under IRC §168(k) for qualifying utility property placed in service during the period. Creates large temporary differences and accelerates ADIT accumulation. Subject to IRS normalization rules for regulated utilities.']
  book_depreciation_amt decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total GAAP straight-line depreciation for the period as recorded in SAP FI/CO asset accounting. Compared against tax depreciation to compute the accelerated depreciation temporary difference driving the deferred tax liability.']
  calculation_method varchar [note: 'The accounting method used to compute the income tax provision: asset_liability (balance sheet approach per ASC 740), deferred (income statement approach, legacy), or flow_through (used for certain regulatory assets per ASC 980-740). Regulated utilities may use flow-through for specific items per PUC order.']
  cost_center_code varchar [note: 'SAP FI/CO cost center code to which the income tax expense is allocated. Used for segment-level tax expense reporting and rate case cost-of-service allocation by utility function (electric, gas, common).']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp when this tax provision record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX internal control requirements. Sourced from SAP FI/CO document creation timestamp.']
  currency_code varchar [note: 'Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this record (e.g., USD). Supports multi-currency consolidation for entities with foreign operations.']
  current_tax_expense_amt decimal(18,2) [note: 'The portion of total income tax expense attributable to taxes currently payable or refundable for the period. Represents the estimated tax liability on the current-year tax return before deferred items.']
  deferred_tax_asset_amt decimal(18,2) [note: 'Gross deferred tax asset balance representing future tax benefits from deductible temporary differences (e.g., pension obligations, asset retirement obligations, regulatory liabilities). Before valuation allowance offset.']
  deferred_tax_expense_amt decimal(18,2) [note: 'The portion of total income tax expense attributable to temporary differences between book and tax basis of assets and liabilities. Positive value indicates deferred tax expense; negative indicates deferred tax benefit.']
  deferred_tax_liability_amt decimal(18,2) [note: 'Gross deferred tax liability balance representing future tax obligations from taxable temporary differences (e.g., accelerated MACRS depreciation on utility plant, AFUDC equity). Primary driver of ADIT balance for regulated utilities.']
  effective_tax_rate decimal(8,6) [note: 'The ratio of total income tax expense to pre-tax book income, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.2100 for 21%). Used in rate case cost-of-service studies and investor reporting. Computed as total_tax_expense_amt / pretax_income_amt.']
  excess_adit_amt decimal(18,2) [note: 'The excess ADIT balance arising from the reduction in the federal corporate tax rate under the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act (TCJA) of 2017. Subject to ARAM (Average Rate Assumption Method) amortization and must be returned to customers per IRS normalization rules and PUC orders.']
  ferc_account_code varchar [note: 'FERC Uniform System of Accounts code associated with this tax provision record (e.g., Account 190 for deferred income taxes — other, Account 281/282/283 for accumulated deferred income taxes). Required for FERC Form 1 annual report filing.']
  fiscal_period varchar [note: 'The accounting period (1–12 for monthly, or 1–4 for quarterly) within the fiscal year to which this provision record applies. Supports interim period tax accounting per FASB ASC 740-270.']
  fiscal_year varchar [note: 'The fiscal year (e.g., 2024) to which this tax provision record applies. Used for period-over-period comparison, rate case cost-of-service studies, and FERC Form 1 annual reporting.']
  interest_on_utp_amt decimal(18,2) [note: 'Accrued interest expense on uncertain tax position reserves. Classified as income tax expense or interest expense per the entity\'s accounting policy election under ASC 740-10-45-25.']
  investment_tax_credit_amt decimal(18,2) [note: 'Deferred investment tax credit balance for regulated utilities that defer and amortize ITC over the life of the related asset per the deferral method (FASB ASC 980-740). Distinct from current-period ITC flow-through. Tracked separately for normalization compliance.']
  jurisdiction_code varchar [note: 'Code identifying the taxing jurisdiction (e.g., US-FED for federal, US-CA for California, US-TX for Texas). Drives apportionment factor application and state/federal tax rate differentiation.']
  jurisdiction_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the taxing authority level: federal (IRS), state (state revenue department), local (municipal), or foreign. Determines applicable tax code, rate schedules, and regulatory reporting requirements.']
  last_updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp when this tax provision record was most recently modified. Tracks revisions to provision calculations, true-up adjustments, and amended filings. Essential for Silver layer incremental load processing and audit trail.']
  legal_entity_code varchar [note: 'Code identifying the legal entity (subsidiary or consolidated parent) for which the tax provision is computed. Aligns with SAP company code structure and FERC Form 1 respondent entity.']
  net_operating_loss_carryforward_amt decimal(18,2) [note: 'Cumulative net operating loss carryforward balance available to offset future taxable income. Post-TCJA, federal NOLs are carried forward indefinitely but limited to 80% of taxable income. Generates a deferred tax asset subject to valuation allowance assessment.']
  normalization_compliance_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this tax provision record is in compliance with IRS normalization requirements for regulated utilities (IRC §168(i)(9)). Non-compliance can result in loss of accelerated depreciation benefits. Monitored for FERC and PUC regulatory filings.']
  penalties_on_utp_amt decimal(18,2) [note: 'Accrued tax penalties associated with uncertain tax positions. Classified as income tax expense per the entity\'s accounting policy election. Monitored for rate case disallowance risk.']
  permanent_difference_amt decimal(18,2) [note: 'Net permanent differences between book income and taxable income that never reverse (e.g., tax-exempt interest, non-deductible penalties, AFUDC equity component). Key reconciling item in the effective tax rate reconciliation schedule.']
  pretax_income_amt decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total book income (GAAP) before income tax expense for the period and jurisdiction. Starting point for the effective tax rate reconciliation and current/deferred tax expense computation. Sourced from SAP FI/CO profit center reporting.']
  provision_date date [note: 'The business date on which the income tax provision was calculated and recorded. Represents the principal business event date for this transaction record. Typically the last day of the fiscal period.']
  provision_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known business identifier for the tax provision record, typically sourced from SAP FI/CO tax calculation run (e.g., TP-2024-FED-Q4). Used for cross-system reconciliation and audit trail.']
  provision_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the tax provision record: draft (initial calculation), under_review (tax department review), approved (CFO/controller sign-off), filed (included in tax return), amended (restated), or closed (finalized and archived).']
  provision_type varchar [note: 'Classifies the nature of the provision calculation: annual (year-end), interim quarterly or monthly (ASC 740-270 estimated annual effective tax rate), true-up (post-filing adjustment), or amended (restated provision). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: annual|interim_quarterly|interim_monthly|true_up|amended — promote to reference product]']
  rate_case_docket_number varchar [note: 'The PUC or FERC docket number of the rate case in which this tax provision data is used as supporting evidence for the revenue requirement calculation. Links tax provision to the regulatory proceeding.']
  regulatory_liability_tax_effect_amt decimal(18,2) [note: 'The income tax effect of regulatory liabilities (e.g., excess ADIT returned to customers, over-recovered revenues) recognized under FASB ASC 980. Represents the deferred tax component of regulatory liabilities on the balance sheet.']
  state_apportionment_factor decimal(8,6) [note: 'The blended apportionment factor (sales/receipts, payroll, property — weighted per state formula) used to allocate multi-state income to a specific state jurisdiction. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.4523 for 45.23%). Required for state income tax provision calculations.']
  statutory_tax_rate decimal(8,6) [note: 'The enacted statutory income tax rate applicable to the legal entity for the jurisdiction and fiscal year (e.g., 0.2100 for 21% federal corporate rate post-TCJA). Used as the baseline for effective tax rate reconciliation.']
  tax_credit_amt decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total income tax credits recognized in the period, including production tax credits (PTC) for wind/solar generation, investment tax credits (ITC) for renewable energy assets, and R&D credits. Reduces current tax expense dollar-for-dollar.']
  tax_depreciation_amt decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total tax depreciation claimed for the period under IRS Modified Accelerated Cost Recovery System (MACRS). Typically exceeds book depreciation for utility plant, creating the primary taxable temporary difference and deferred tax liability for regulated utilities.']
  tax_return_type varchar [note: 'Indicates whether the provision is computed on a consolidated federal return, separate company basis, combined state return, or unitary state return. Critical for apportionment factor allocation and intercompany tax sharing agreement calculations.']
  temporary_difference_amt decimal(18,2) [note: 'Net aggregate temporary difference between book and tax basis of assets and liabilities for the period and jurisdiction. Drives the deferred tax expense/benefit calculation. Includes accelerated depreciation, regulatory assets/liabilities, and pension timing differences.']
  total_tax_expense_amt decimal(18,2) [note: 'Sum of current and deferred income tax expense for the period. Equals the total provision for income taxes reported on the GAAP income statement. Used in EBITDA reconciliation and rate case revenue requirement calculations.']
  uncertain_tax_position_amt decimal(18,2) [note: 'Reserve for uncertain tax positions (UTPs) under the more-likely-than-not recognition threshold. Represents the cumulative liability for tax positions that may not be sustained upon IRS or state examination. Disclosed in financial statement footnotes.']
  utility_service_type varchar [note: 'The regulated utility service type to which this tax provision is attributed: electric, gas, common (shared), water, or steam. Required for functional separation in rate case cost-of-service studies and FERC Form 1 reporting.']
  valuation_allowance_amt decimal(18,2) [note: 'Valuation allowance recorded against gross deferred tax assets when it is more likely than not that some portion will not be realized. Reduces net deferred tax asset on the balance sheet per ASC 740 realizability assessment.']

  Note: 'Income tax provision and deferred tax records capturing current tax expense, deferred tax expense, effective tax rate reconciliation, and accumulated deferred income taxes (ADIT) by jurisdiction and legal entity. Tracks IRS normalization requirements for regulated utilities, excess ADIT balances subject to ARAM (Average Rate Assumption Method) amortization per Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, state/federal tax apportionment factors, and PUC-ordered rate base ADIT offsets. Essential for rate case revenue requirement calculations and FERC Form 1 tax reporting.'
}

Table finance.profit_center {

  Note: 'Record of energy audits conducted for C&I customers as part of demand-side management (DSM) and energy efficiency programs.   Note: 'Master record for license agreements where the utility grants third parties the right to use utility-owned property for compatible uses such as cell tower colocation, fiber optic attachments, billboard placements, agricultural licenses, and pipeline crossings. Captures licensee name, license type, licensed area description, associated parcel or easement ID, license term, annual license fee, revenue share terms, insurance requirements, and license status.   vendor_advisory_reference varchar [note: 'Vendor‑specific advisory or bulletin identifier.']
  vulnerability_name varchar [note: 'Human‑readable name or title describing the vulnerability.']
  vulnerability_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the vulnerability by its nature or origin.']

  Note: 'Master record for cybersecurity vulnerabilities identified across IT and OT assets through vulnerability scanning, penetration testing, threat intelligence feeds, and vendor advisories.   release_version varchar [note: 'Semantic version string (e.g., 1.2.3) representing the release.']
  risk_level varchar [note: 'Assessed risk associated with the release.']
  rollback_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a rollback was required for this release.']
  rollback_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when the rollback was executed, if applicable.']
  security_classification varchar [note: 'Security classification assigned to the release artifact.']
  source_control_branch varchar [note: 'Version control branch from which the release was built.']
  source_control_commit_hash varchar [note: 'Commit hash or identifier associated with the release build.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent update to the release record.']
  validation_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when post‑deployment validation was performed.']

  Note: 'Transactional record for each software release, deployment, or version update for digital platforms and enterprise applications. Captures release identifier, associated application or platform, release version, release type (major, minor, patch, hotfix), planned deployment date, actual deployment date, deployment environment (dev, test, staging, production), release notes summary, change request reference, deployment status, and post-deployment validation outcome. Supports application lifecycle management and release governance.'
}

Table technology.tech_spend {
  tech_spend_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate key for each technology spend record.']
  adjustment_of_tech_spend_id varchar [note: 'Self-referencing FK on tech_spend (adjustment_of_tech_spend_id)']
  approver_employee_id varchar [note: 'Identifier of the employee who approved the spend.']
  created_by_user_employee_id varchar [note: 'Identifier of the user who created the spend record.']
  employee_id varchar [note: 'Identifier of the employee who approved the spend.']
  tech_project_id varchar [note: 'Identifier of the technology project or initiative associated with the spend.']
  updated_by_user_employee_id varchar [note: 'Identifier of the user who last updated the spend record.']
  vendor_id varchar [note: 'Identifier of the external vendor providing the technology product or service.']
  allocation_percentage decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage of the spend allocated to the primary cost center when using percentage allocation.']
  amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total gross amount of the spend before taxes or adjustments.']
  approval_date date [note: 'Date the spend was approved.']
  approval_status varchar [note: 'State of the internal approval workflow for the spend.']
  capex_flag boolean [note: 'True if the spend is capitalized (CAPEX); False if it is operating expense (OPEX).']
  compliance_requirement varchar [note: 'Regulatory or compliance regime that applies to the spend (e.g., NERC CIP).']
  cost_allocation_method varchar [note: 'Method used to allocate the spend across cost centers or projects.']
  cost_center_code varchar [note: 'Internal cost‑center identifier to which the spend is charged.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when the spend record was first created in the system.']
  currency_code varchar [note: 'Three‑letter ISO 4217 code of the currency used for the spend.']
  internal_comments varchar [note: 'Internal notes or remarks about the spend record.']
  invoice_date date [note: 'Date the vendor issued the invoice.']
  invoice_number varchar [note: 'Number of the vendor invoice associated with the spend.']
  is_recurring boolean [note: 'True if the spend is part of a recurring contract or subscription.']
  lifecycle_status varchar [note: 'Current processing status of the spend record.']
  net_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Net amount after tax and any discounts.']
  payment_due_date date [note: 'Date by which payment must be made to the vendor.']
  payment_method varchar [note: 'Method used to settle the invoice.']
  payment_status varchar [note: 'Current payment settlement status.']
  purchase_order_number varchar [note: 'Internal purchase order reference linked to the spend.']
  recurring_frequency varchar [note: 'Interval at which recurring spend occurs.']
  related_application varchar [note: 'Name of the application or system that benefits from the spend.']
  related_technology_project varchar [note: 'Business identifier of the technology project linked to this spend.']
  spend_category varchar [note: 'High‑level classification of the spend (e.g., hardware, software, cloud).']
  spend_date date [note: 'Date the spend was incurred or recognized.']
  spend_number varchar [note: 'External reference number assigned to the spend transaction for tracking.']
  spend_period_end date [note: 'End date of the accounting period the spend belongs to.']
  spend_period_start date [note: 'Start date of the accounting period the spend belongs to.']
  spend_subcategory varchar [note: 'More detailed classification within the spend category.']
  tax_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Tax component of the spend, if applicable.']
  tech_spend_description varchar [note: 'Free‑form text describing the purpose or nature of the spend.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent modification to the spend record.']

  Note: 'Technology expenditure record tracking actual IT and OT spending by category, cost center, and project for internal technology financial management. Captures spend record identifier, spend category (hardware, software licenses, telecom, managed services, professional services, cloud), vendor, invoice reference, amount, currency, spend period, associated tech project or application, cost center, and capitalization flag (CAPEX vs OPEX). Supports technology total cost of ownership (TCO) analysis and IT budget management distinct from the finance domain\'s general ledger.'
}
